zh: ：「{PARTY}加入隊伍。」
en: {PARTY} has joined the party.

zh: ：「{HERO}得到{GOLD}個{ITEM}。」
en: {HERO} obtained {GOLD} {ITEM}.

zh: ：「{HERO}來的好！先賞你{GOLD}個金幣。」
en: Well met, {HERO}! Take these {GOLD} gold coins as your reward.

zh: ：「這{ITEM}要{GOLD}個金幣，您不夠錢購買東西。」
en: This {ITEM} costs {GOLD} gold. You lack the coins to purchase it.

zh: ：「謝謝您購買這樣物品。」
en: Thank you for your purchase!

zh: ：「您需要那一種合適的物品。」
en: What kind of wares are you looking for?

zh: ：「{HERO}您身上放不下那樣東西。」
en: {HERO}, your inventory is already full.

zh: ：「{HERO}這是您身上的東西。」
en: {HERO}, here are your belongings.

zh: ：「{HERO}，你想買東西或賣東西？」
en: Welcome, {HERO}! Looking to buy or sell today?

zh: ：「這{ITEM}要{GOLD}個金幣，你是否要購買？」
en: This {ITEM} costs {GOLD} gold. Would you like to buy it?

zh: ：「這{ITEM}，我出{GOLD}個金幣，你是否要賣？」
en: I can offer {GOLD} gold for your {ITEM}. Will you sell it?

zh: ：「這麼好的價格竟然不賣，真可惜？」
en: Passing on such a fine price? What a pity!

zh: ：「謝謝你！」
en: Much obliged! Thank you!

zh: ：「{HERO}您需要什麼樣的服務？」
en: Welcome, {HERO}! How can we serve you today?

zh: ：「{HERO}住宿一次需要{GOLD}個金幣，您是否要住宿？」
en: A night's stay is {GOLD} gold. Would you like to rest, {HERO}?

zh: ：「謝謝您，請好好休息？」
en: Thank you! Have a restful night.

zh: ：「{HERO}全體隊員體力恢復。」
en: {HERO} and the party are fully refreshed!

zh: ：「{HERO}你身上的金幣不夠付住宿費用。」
en: {HERO}, you don't have enough gold for lodging.

zh: ：「喔！不休息隊員體力是沒法恢復的。」
en: Without rest, your weary travelers cannot recover stamina.

zh: ：「萬能的天神，請用您偉大的力量幫助世上的人們。」
en: Almighty Lord, bless Thy people with divine light.

zh: ：「萬能的天神，請用您偉大的力量幫助世上的人們。孩子，有那些人須要療傷？」
en: Almighty Lord, bless Thy children. Who among you seeks healing?

zh: ：「萬能的天神，請用您偉大的力量幫助世上的人們。孩子，要取用那些檔案？」
en: Almighty Lord, bless Thy children. Which record shall be loaded?

zh: ：「萬能的天神，請用您偉大的力量幫助世上的人們。孩子，要存入那些檔案？」
en: Almighty Lord, bless Thy children. Which record shall be saved?

zh: ：「萬能的天神，請用您偉大的力量幫助世上的人們。孩子，沒有人需要療傷。」
en: Almighty Lord, bless Thy children. None among you require healing.

zh: ：「萬能的天神，請用您偉大的力量幫助世上的人們。孩子，沒有錢是不能療傷。」
en: Almighty Lord, bless Thy children. A donation is needed for healing.

zh: ：「萬能的天神，請用您偉大的力量幫助世上的人們。孩子，{CHAR3}身體傷勢恢復活了。」
en: Almighty Lord, bless Thy children. {CHAR3}'s body has been revived!

zh: ：「萬能的天神，請用您偉大的力量幫助世上的人們。孩子，要{CHAR3}復活需要{GOLD}個金幣。」
en: Almighty Lord, bless Thy children. Reviving {CHAR3} requires {GOLD} gold.

zh: ：「萬能的天神，請用您偉大的力量幫助世上的人們。孩子，檔案取出成功？」
en: Almighty Lord, bless Thy children. Your record has been loaded.

zh: ：「萬能的天神，請用您偉大的力量幫助世上的人們。孩子，檔案存入成功？」
en: Almighty Lord, bless Thy children. Your record has been saved.

zh: ：「萬能的天神，請用您偉大的力量幫助世上的人們。孩子，要銷除那些檔案？」
en: Almighty Lord, bless Thy children. Which record shall be erased?

zh: ：「萬能的天神，請用您偉大的力量幫助世上的人們。孩子，檔案銷除成功？」
en: Almighty Lord, bless Thy children. The record has been erased.

zh: ：「萬能的天神，請用您偉大的力量幫助世上的人們。孩子，確定要取用這檔案嗎？」
en: Almighty Lord, bless Thy children. Do you wish to load this record?

zh: ：「萬能的天神，請用您偉大的力量幫助世上的人們。孩子，確定要存入這檔案嗎？」
en: Almighty Lord, bless Thy children. Do you wish to save to this record?

zh: ：「萬能的天神，請用您偉大的力量幫助世上的人們。孩子，確定要銷除這檔案嗎？」
en: Almighty Lord, bless Thy children. Do you wish to erase this record?

zh: ：「萬能的天神，請用您偉大的力量幫助世上的人們。孩子，這是空的檔案你不能載入？」
en: Almighty Lord, bless Thy children. That record is empty and cannot be loaded.

en: {CHAR3} used {ITEM}, but nothing happened.

en: {CHAR1} used {ITEM}. {CHAR2} fled from battle!

en: {CHAR1} used {ITEM} on {CHAR2}. The party fled!

en: {CHAR1} used {ITEM}. Cured {CHAR2} of petrification!

en: {CHAR1} handed {ITEM} to {CHAR2}.

en: {CHAR1} rested.

en: {CHAR1} advanced to Level {GOLD}!

zh: ：「生命增加{GOLD}點。」

en: AGI increased by {GOLD}!

zh: ：「這裡是聖克魯茲城，也就是聖騎土軍團的所在地。」
en: This is Santa Cruz Castle, headquarters of the Holy Knights.

zh: ：「{HERO}，又有新的任務嗎？聽說到古代神殿那裡常有怪物出沒，要去之前最好先買一些藥草。」
en: {HERO}, on another mission? Monsters are prowling near the Ancient Shrine. Best stock up on herbs before you go.

zh: ：「你不是{HERO}嗎，國王在召見你！快點進去吧。」
en: Ah, {HERO}! His Majesty summons you to the throne room. Hurry inside!

zh: ：「這裡是聖克魯茲城，也就是聖騎土軍團的所在地。」
en: This is Santa Cruz Castle, headquarters of the Holy Knights.

zh: ：「南方馬蘭村好久沒人來，可能是路上常出現怪物攻擊商人，所以一般村民不敢來了。」
en: No travelers have arrived from Maran Village in the south. Monsters must be ambushing the merchant roads.

zh: ：「現在聖克魯茲城流傳著一個令人害怕的傳聞，好像是說古時候的邪惡魔王就要復活了，希望不是真的。」
en: A chilling rumor spreads through the castle... They say the ancient Archdemon is stirring. I pray it isn't true.

zh: ：「{HERO}騎土隊長，之前國王曾派一名衛士去古代神殿，不知道回來了沒有？」
en: Captain {HERO}, the King sent a guard to investigate the Ancient Shrine. Has he returned yet?

zh: ：「好像聽國王殿下說過，但我不太清楚耶。」
en: I believe His Majesty mentioned it, but I haven't heard any report.

zh: ：「喔・・・對了！國王好像在召見你，你快點去，不要讓國王等久了。」
en: Oh, right! The King has summoned you. Make haste, don't keep His Majesty waiting.

zh: ：「{HERO}，找尋失落在大陸上的寶珠的重任就在你身上。」
en: {HERO}, the fate of the realm and the lost sacred orbs rests upon your shoulders.

zh: ：「{HERO}呀，我跟你說過聖克魯茲城的事情了嗎？」
en: {HERO}, my boy! Have I ever told you the history of Santa Cruz Castle?

zh: ：「老爺爺，您說過了。」
en: You have, grandfather. Several times.

zh: ：「真的嗎？沒騙我？我看再說一次好了。我們國家位於・・・」
en: Truly? You're not jesting with me? Well, no harm in hearing it once more! Our great kingdom lies upon...

zh: ：「老爺爺，我下次再聽吧。」
en: Perhaps another time, grandfather!

zh: ：「{HERO}你過來，我有話跟你說。」
en: {HERO}, come closer! I have something important to tell you.

zh: ：「老爺爺，我就站在您前面啊！」
en: Grandfather, I am standing right in front of you!

zh: ：「{HERO}你明知道老爺爺我的眼睛不好，你還這麼說。」
en: Now don't get cheeky with me, {HERO}! You know my old eyes aren't what they used to be.

zh: ：「對不起・・老爺爺我不是有意的。」
en: Forgive me, grandfather. I didn't mean any disrespect.

zh: ：「算了！我現在所要說是聖克魯茲城的事情。{HERO}你知道我們國家位於這大陸的大草原上，王國主要是以商業為主，而且在這大陸上它的歷史是非常悠久的。」
en: Water under the bridge! Now then, listen well, {HERO}. Our kingdom was founded upon these vast continental plains, built on commerce and ancient heritage.
I see.

zh: ：「傳說有位勇者帶著三名夥伴，打倒一個名叫洛馬的魔王，之後勇者被封為光明聖騎士。過了數年後，就很少有人看到這位勇者與他的夥伴們。」
en: Legend tells of a hero and three brave companions who vanquished an archdemon named Loma, earning the title of Holy Knight of Light. Years later, they vanished from history.

zh: ：「那後來呢？」
en: And what became of them?

zh: ：「這位打倒魔王的勇者，就是建立我們這個國家的英雄。而你在城內聽到的傳聞中那個邪惡魔王就是洛馬。」
en: That very hero founded our kingdom. And the ancient evil you hear whispered in castle corridors... is Loma himself.

zh: ：「呵呵・・{HERO}你來了，城裡好像有件事要你去辦，是什麼呢・・・？天啊！一時忘了！不過好像很重要・・・想不起來了。對了！就這麼辦！你去城門口時問衛士，衛士他可能知道。」
en: Ho ho! {HERO}, you've arrived. The castle has a task for you... Now what was it again? Blast it, it slipped my mind! It seemed dreadfully important, too... Ah! Ask the guard at the castle gates, he's sure to know!

zh: ：「這裡是聖克魯茲城。」
en: This is Santa Cruz Castle.

zh: ：「在東南方有一個叫作吉普賽的地方。」
en: Far to the southeast lies the land of the Nomads.

zh: ：「從前有許多人到古代神殿盜取神殿內的東西，但因神殿被封閉，所以都沒辦法進入。」
en: Many tried to plunder the Ancient Shrine in times past, but its sacred seal kept all intruders out.

zh: ：「聖騎士小隊長{HERO}，國王在召見你。」
en: Captain {HERO}, the King has summoned you to the throne room.

zh: ：「這裡是聖克魯茲城。」
en: This is Santa Cruz Castle.

zh: ：「西南方有個生產鐵礦的地方叫艾隆鎮。」
en: To the southwest lies Iron Town, famous for its rich iron mines.

zh: ：「北方古代神殿是個很早就被國王封閉起來的聖地。」
en: The Ancient Shrine to the north is a sacred sanctuary sealed long ago by royal decree.

zh: ：「有位衛士說他被國王派到北方古代神殿裡查看神殿內的安全。」
en: One of our guards was dispatched to the northern shrine to inspect its defenses.

zh: ：「這裡是聖克魯茲城。」
en: This is Santa Cruz Castle.

zh: ：「以前人類、妖精、魔物和矮人，大家都守著自己本份和平相處。現在怪物到處攻擊人，希望能回復往日和平。」
en: Humans, elves, beastfolk, and dwarves once lived in harmony. Now beasts roam wild everywhere. I pray peace returns.

zh: ：「向北方走約半天會來到一個森林，走出森林會看到一座古老建築，那就是古代神殿，應該是很好找的。」
en: Head north for half a day to reach the woods. Beyond the trees stands an ancient ruin—that is the Ancient Shrine.

zh: ：「在王宮內住者一位知識學問很豐富的老先生，但是他的記憶力卻很差。」
en: An old scholar of boundless wisdom lives in the palace, though his memory is like a sieve.

zh: ：「這裡是聖克魯茲城。」
en: This is Santa Cruz Castle.

zh: ：「向西方走會看到皇家大聖堂。」
en: Head west and you will reach the Royal Cathedral.

zh: ：「你回來了。國王正在等你。」
en: You've returned! His Majesty awaits your report.

zh: ：「原來那名衛士是來告訴國王怪物攻擊古代神殿的事情，那麼這是很嚴重的問題。國王不是派你去北方神殿調查嗎？」
en: So the scout reported monsters assaulting the Ancient Shrine? That is grave news indeed. Did the King dispatch you to investigate?

zh: ：「國王召集城內所有的聖騎士隊長，好像發生了什麼事情？」
en: The King has summoned all Holy Knight captains. Something dire must have occurred.
Zzz... Zzz... Zzz...
No... monster... stay back... don't take me... Zzz...

zh: ：「這位小姐她好像在作惡夢。」
en: This poor lady seems to be trapped in a dreadful nightmare.

zh: ：「大魔王洛馬的魔力實在是太可怕了，你們一定要小心。」
en: Archdemon Loma's dark magic is terrifying. You must proceed with utmost caution.

zh: ：「沒想到大魔王洛馬的力量這麼的可怕，居然可以控制人的心智，這麼說・・・當初我下令保留這些書籍是錯誤的。」
en: To think Loma's sorcery could enslave the minds of men... It seems preserving those forbidden tomes was a grave mistake.

zh: ：「我早在第一次翻閱這些書籍的時候，就發現了這些書有些奇怪，於是我才會建議要毀掉這些書，但是您卻反對。」
en: I sensed an unnatural aura the first time I perused those forbidden manuscripts.

zh: ：「唉・・・我真的是錯了，真是對不起妳。您願意再回到王城嗎？我願意為當初所犯的錯懺悔。」
en: I was foolish to believe we could comprehend and control such dark power.

zh: ：「娜塔夏，再回到王城來吧。我將授妳皇室腎者的名號。」
en: Don't blame yourself, Master. No one foresaw Sil Fox falling into darkness.

zh: ：「國王陛下，謝謝您的好意。但是現在最重要的事就是防止大魔王洛馬的復活，我想一切等到這事結束之後再說吧。」
en: Alas, what is done is done.

zh: ：「好，本王期待各位能夠安全的回來。這裡有一些稀世之寶，就送給各位吧。」
en: A profound darkness gathers on the horizon. The peace we fought so hard to protect is slipping away.

zh: ：「艾隆鎮最近突然沒有消息了，我實在是很擔心，請你們跑一趟吧。」
en: There has been no news from Iron Town recently, and I am deeply worried. Please make the journey and investigate.

zh: ：「稟告陛下，放置在皇家大聖堂的寶珠恐怕已經被妖魔奪走了，這都是屬下的錯。」
en: I pray you are right. May the heavens watch over us.

zh: ：「艾魯，這不能怪你。只能怪妖魔們的行動實在是太快了。」
en: Master Orsia, where should we direct our search next?

zh: ：「陛下，這些妖魔為什麼能夠這麼清楚的知道這些封印寶珠的下落？」
en: According to the ancient riddles, each orb was sealed in a distinct domain. We must follow every clue.

zh: ：「唉・・・若是我的猜測沒有錯，我想最有問題的可能是當初皇室裡的另一名魔法師～席爾・福克斯吧。」
en: Understood. We will not let Sil Fox resurrect the Archdemon.

zh: ：「您是說皇室魔法師的問題？」
en: Go with courage, my friends.

zh: ：「這個事情我讓大法師來說明吧。」
en: The fate of the Grand Duchy rests in your hands.

zh: ：「咳・・・咳・・・咳・・・以下所說的事可說是王室最大的醜聞，請你們記住不要和外人談論這件事。」
en: Ahem... What I am about to disclose is the royal family's darkest secret. Swear that it will not leave this chamber.
We swear it, Your Eminence.

zh: ：「數年以前在王宮中除了我，還有另一名魔法師，他的名字叫做席爾・福克斯。」
en: Years ago, there was another court sorcerer beside myself. His name was Sil Fox.

zh: ：「福克斯是個相當厲害的魔法師，而他的一生也都是為了探索魔法的更高層次而不斷的吸收新的知識。」
en: Fox was a prodigy of magic, spending his life in relentless pursuit of higher mystical realms.

zh: ：「某一天，他在王室圖書館中看到了一本敘述大魔王洛馬事蹟的書籍後，他就對大魔王那種可以使晝夜顛倒的可怕力量所迷惑了。他認為自己的能力根本就無法和大魔王所擁有的力量相比，所以開始找尋各種和大魔王有關的資料。」
en: One day, in the royal archives, he unearthed a forbidden chronicle of Archdemon Loma. He was enchanted by Loma's godlike power to turn day into night, and became obsessed with unearthing every trace of the Archdemon.

zh: ：「我雖然一再的勸他不要為了這種邪惡的力量而放棄了自己的心，但是在專心追求新力量的他的心卻完全聽不到我所說的。」
en: I pleaded with him not to surrender his soul to such darkness, but his thirst for power blinded him to all reason.

zh: ：「直到有一天晚上，在他的房裡發生一場爆炸，等我們趕到他的房間時，只看到所有的東西都被燒成黑炭，而他也就這樣子消失了。」
en: Then, one fateful night, an explosion rocked his chamber. When we rushed in, the room was charred to ash, and Fox had vanished without a trace.

zh: ：「從這一連串的事件看來，我認為他可能已經找到獲得大魔王力量的辦法，所以才會開始收集這些封印的寶珠，我們一定要阻止他的行動，不能讓他將大魔王喚醒。」
en: Looking at recent events, he must have found the ritual to claim Loma's dark power. He is gathering the sealed orbs—we must stop him before he awakens the Archdemon!

zh: ：「{HERO}，你的任務越來越重了，應該沒有問題吧！」
en: {HERO}, your burden grows heavier by the hour. Are you ready for this?

zh: ：「國王陛下您放心吧。」
en: Have no fear, Your Majesty. We will see this through.

zh: ：「對了，在丹托鎮不遠的地方有個艾隆鎮，是王國裡生產重金屬的地方。但是最近卻突然沒有消息了，我實在是很擔心，請你們跑一趟吧。」
en: Near Danto Town lies Iron Town, our realm's chief source of heavy ores. But contact has suddenly ceased. Go investigate at once!
At once, Your Majesty!

zh: ：「{HERO}呀，整個王國未來的命運就掌握在你的手中了。」
en: {HERO}, the future of the entire kingdom rests in your hands.

zh: ：「陛下，我會盡力的。」
en: Sire, I shall give my all.

zh: ：「古代神殿怎麼樣了？」
en: What news of the Ancient Shrine?

zh: ：「稟告陛下，古代神殿已經被妖魔破壞了，就屬下的判斷，神殿裡的某件物品可能也被妖魔帶走了。」
en: Sire, the shrine has been ransacked by fiends. I fear the sacred relic kept within has been stolen.

zh: ：「嗯・・・我所擔心的事終於發生了。{HERO}，我將要給你一個新的任務。」
en: Alas... What I dreaded most has come to pass. {HERO}, I bestow upon you a new mission.

zh: ：「新的任務？」
en: A new mission, Sire?

zh: ：「就讓大法師歐魯西亞來說明吧！」
en: Let Grand Mage Orsia explain the details.

zh: ：「關於這件事的來龍去脈要從五百年前的一場大戰說起・・・・・・」
en: To understand this crisis, we must look back five hundred years to the Great Cataclysm...

zh: ：「五百年前！？」
en: Five hundred years ago?!

zh: ：「不要插嘴！安靜的聽我說。」
en: Silence! Do not interrupt while I speak.
Forgive me, Master.

zh: ：「五百年前，四名勇士進入了大魔王洛馬所在的地下魔宮，在激烈的戰鬥後四名勇士終於打敗了大魔王，但是他們卻沒有能力將大魔王消滅。」
en: Five centuries ago, four champions descended into Archdemon Loma's nether citadel. After a grueling battle, they struck the demon down, yet lacked the power to destroy his immortal spirit.

zh: ：「這個時候，勇者取出了它身上所帶的六顆寶珠，將魔王的力量封住。為了使這六顆寶珠不被人破壞，勇者將這六顆寶珠分別藏在王國的六個地方，然後就消失了。」
en: The hero then drew forth six sacred orbs, binding the Archdemon's essence. To keep them safe, the orbs were hidden in six secret corners of the continent, and the champions vanished from the world.

zh: ：「這麼說古代神殿中也藏有一顆神聖的寶珠嗎？」
en: Then the Ancient Shrine held one of those sacred seals?

zh: ：「是的，你們所前往的古代神殿就藏有其中的一個封印，不過在封印被取走的情況下，現在這個封印已經被打開了，若是不能阻止魔軍的行動，大魔王洛馬真的會被喚醒的。」
en: Indeed. The seal in the northern shrine has been broken. If we fail to halt the enemy, Archdemon Loma will awaken to plunge the world into darkness once more.

zh: ：「那麼現在我們該怎麼辦？其他的封印又在那裡呢？」
en: What must we do? Where are the remaining seals hidden?

zh: ：「嗯・・・經過了這麼久的時間，當初知道的人大多已經去逝了，我翻遍了王城裡的所有書籍，只找到了一段謎般的文字。」
en: Centuries have passed, and those who knew the locations have long departed. After scouring the royal archives, I found only a cryptic verse.

zh: ：「上面怎麼寫？」
en: What does the verse say?

zh: ：「神秘之紅、神聖之黃、深海之藍、飛翔之紫、遠古之綠・・・・後面的部份字跡就看不清楚了。」
en: Mystic Red, Holy Yellow, Abyssal Blue, Soaring Purple, Ancient Green... Alas, the final lines have faded with age.

zh: ：「{HERO}，你的新任務就是前往王國的其他地區找尋封印寶珠的下落，並且保護它們不被妖魔破壞。」
en: {HERO}, your new quest is to journey across the realm, locate the sealed orbs, and defend them from the demon army.
By your command, Sire!
Nina.

zh: ：「妮娜在此！」
en: Here, Your Majesty!

zh: ：「妳也和{HERO}他們一起去。」
en: You shall accompany {HERO} and the knights on this quest.
It shall be done, Sire!

zh: ：「{HERO}，這個任務就交給你了。」
en: {HERO}, the hopes of our people ride with you.
I will not fail you, Sire!

zh: ：「{HERO}，你怎麼回來了！我給你的命令是前往古代神殿阻止妖魔的破壞，不要在這裡浪費時間。」
en: Why have you returned, {HERO}? Your order is to march on the Ancient Shrine and repel the fiends. Make haste!

zh: ：「不要在這裡浪費時間了，古代神殿就在城外的西北方，有什麼問題等到消滅它們回來再說。」
en: Waste no time here! The Ancient Shrine lies northwest of the castle walls. Slay the monsters first, then report back.

zh: ：「今天召集各位來是為了一件緊急的事。最近在王國各處又開始出現可怕的妖魔，這些妖魔應該早在數百年以前就已經被消滅了才對。而現在它們的出現，正表示邪惡的勢力開始崛起，也許將會危害到整個王國的存亡。」
en: I have gathered you all for an urgent crisis. Ancient fiends thought vanquished centuries ago have reappeared across our lands. The forces of darkness are rising to threaten the very survival of our realm.

zh: ：「為了防止邪惡勢力的危害，決定再次動員聖騎士團進行鏟除妖魔的任務。這件任務相當的危險，但是我相信各位聖騎士團的成員都早有心理準備了。」
en: To counter the rising demonic threat, I have decreed the full mobilization of the Holy Knights. This mission is perilous, but I trust every knight is prepared.

zh: ：「國王陛下您請放心，我們聖騎士的成員為了達成這個任務絕對是不怕犧牲的。」
en: Rest assured, Your Majesty. The Holy Knights will not hesitate to give our lives for the realm.

zh: ：「嗯・・・不愧是我旗下的聖騎士團，有了你們就不需要耽心了。」
en: Well spoken. Under my royal banner, with knights like you, I have no fear.

zh: ：「不好了！不好了！」
en: Your Majesty! Urgent report!

zh: ：「發生什麼事了？」
en: What has happened?

zh: ：「一批妖魔出現在城外的西北方，朝著古代神殿前進，看情況這些妖魔是要對古代神殿發動攻擊。」
en: A legion of fiends has appeared northwest of the city walls, marching upon the Ancient Shrine. They intend to sack the sanctuary!

zh: ：「有這種事？{HERO}！」
en: What?! Captain {HERO}!

zh: ：「是，國王陛下請吩附。」
en: Sire! Awaiting your command.

zh: ：「我命你立刻率領凱伊、多爾卡、索菲亞、羅伊、以及吉斯去阻止妖魔的攻擊，無論如何都不能讓它們破壞古代神殿。」
en: Lead Kai, Doruka, Sophia, Roy, and Keith to intercept the enemy at once! You must not let them desecrate the Ancient Shrine!
By your command, Sire!

zh: ：「大魔王洛馬的魔力實在是太可怕了，你們一定要小心。」
en: Archdemon Loma's dark sorcery is terrifying. Proceed with the utmost vigilance.

zh: ：「要記住，若是福克斯真的獲得了大魔王洛馬的力量，那麼他將是相當可怕的。」
en: Never forget: if Sil Fox truly inherits the Archdemon's power, he will be an adversary beyond imagination.

zh: ：「{HERO}，快去找尋失落在大陸上的六顆寶珠的下落，不要再被魔物奪去了。」
en: {HERO}, search out the six sacred orbs across the continent before the fiends claim them all.

zh: ：「先去向國王報告古代神殿的情形吧。」
en: Make haste to the King and deliver your report on the Ancient Shrine.

zh: ：「{HERO}，快前往古代神殿調查．．．真令人擔心，不知是不是那件事。」
en: {HERO}, make haste to the Ancient Shrine... I have an ominous premonition about this.

zh: ：「{HERO}，最近通往西北方古代神殿，常常聽一些旅客談起說在路上看到有一小群魔物出沒，所以你們要小心。」
en: {HERO}, travelers on the northwest road have reported roaming packs of fiends. Keep your guard up.

zh: ：「快向國王報告古代神殿的情形。」
en: Report to the King at once regarding the Ancient Shrine.

zh: ：「{HERO}，我記得國王不是交代你去調查北方神殿，你現在怎麼還在這裡？快點去。」
en: {HERO}, weren't you ordered to investigate the northern shrine? Why are you still idling here? Move out!

zh: ：「呀．．．{HERO}，記得調查北方神殿後，一定要回到聖克魯茲城向國王報告神殿所發生的事情。」
en: {HERO}, remember: once you scout the northern shrine, return to the castle immediately to inform His Majesty.

zh: ：「耶！打贏了。」
en: Hurrah! Victory is ours!

zh: ：「別這麼早高興，依這個看況看來古代神殿恐怕早就被妖魔們攻陷了。」
en: Hold your celebration. Judging by their movement, the Ancient Shrine was likely breached before we even arrived.

zh: ：「多爾卡，你怎麼對妖魔們的行動方式這麼的清楚？」
en: Doruka, how do you know so much about demon tactics?

zh: ：「這是我的事，你們不要管！」
en: That's my business. Keep your nose out of it!

zh: ：「現在我們的下一步該怎麼做？」
en: What is our next move?

zh: ：「{HERO}，你決定一下吧！」
en: {HERO}, give the order!

zh: ：「嗯・・・雖然看這樣子古代神殿恐怕早就被攻陷了，但這是國王陛下的命令。不管怎麼樣我們還是應該過去看看狀況。」
en: Even if the shrine has fallen, we have royal orders. We must press forward and survey the site.

zh: ：「那我們就走吧！」
en: Then let's move out!

zh: ：「這是國王陛下所交待的任務，我們一定要盡力完成。」
en: His Majesty entrusted this duty to us. We will see it through to the end.

zh: ：「大家小心點，若是古代神殿已經遭到妖魔的攻擊，那就表示這裡也有妖魔出現的可能，快提高警覺。」
en: Stay sharp, everyone. If fiends are raiding the shrine, they could ambush us here at any second.

zh: ：「哈哈哈・・・有什麼好怕的呢，若是有什麼妖怪出現我就用美拉咒文把它們燒成焦炭就好。」
en: Hahaha! What's there to be afraid of? Any monster that shows its ugly face gets roasted to a crisp by my fire magic!

zh: ：「放心好了，有我王國第一神射手在這裡，有什麼好怕的。」
en: Relax! You have the realm's greatest marksman by your side. What could possibly go wrong?

zh: ：「你們兩個沒有經歷過戰爭的小鬼聽著，這次的任務可不像你們所想像的那麼輕鬆。憑我的直覺，這次事件後面一定有著可怕的陰謀，我們還是多加小心的是。」
en: Listen up, you greenhorns who've never tasted real war: this campaign is no walk in the park. My gut says there's a sinister plot behind this. Keep your eyes peeled.

zh: ：「安靜一下，前面是什麼？」
en: Quiet, all of you! What's that ahead?

zh: ：「好像是一群妖魔，依這個隊形看來應該是一支巡邏隊的樣子。」
en: A squad of fiends. Judging by their formation, it looks like a scouting patrol.

zh: ：「巡邏隊？這麼說・・・這些妖魔已經被人有組織的組合起來了？」
en: A patrol? You mean... the monsters are organized under a central command?

zh: ：「嗯・・・我所擔心的就是這件事。通常妖魔若是落單的話相當的好對付，但是當它們被組織起來之後，就不太妙了。{HERO}，現在該怎麼辦？」
en: Aye... That is precisely what I feared. Stray monsters are easy prey, but an organized army is another beast entirely. {HERO}, what's the plan?

zh: ：「看這一隊巡邏隊的妖魔數量並不多，這是我們的好機會，我們上吧！」
en: Their patrol is small. This is our chance—strike now!
Right behind you!
Charge!
Let's take 'em down!
Move!

zh: ：「它們到底在找些什麼？」
en: What in the world were they searching for?

zh: ：「羅伊，你對這個古代神殿知道些什麼嗎？也許可以有什麼線索。」
en: Roy, do you know anything about this shrine? Any clues might help.

zh: ：「嗯・・・這個嘛，我一直認為這個神殿早就荒廢了，但是看這個樣子又不像。」
en: Well... I always thought this temple was abandoned, but this doesn't look like mere ruin.

zh: ：「快過來呀！」
en: Over here, quickly!

zh: ：「索菲亞妳找到什麼了？」
en: What did you find, Sophia?

zh: ：「在這裡有個台子，上面應該曾經放著些什麼，但是現在卻什麼都沒有了。」
en: There's an altar here. Something was clearly enshrined atop it, but it's completely empty now.

zh: ：「糟了！我們中計了。」
en: Blast it! We've been played.

zh: ：「中計了？」
en: Played?!

zh: ：「剛才我們認為這一隊妖魔是在這裡找東西，但這是緩兵之計，對方只是想靠這一批妖魔擋住我們的行動。」
en: We thought that patrol was searching for the relic, but they were just a decoy to stall our advance.

zh: ：「你是說有人已經把古代神殿裡藏的東西拿走了？」
en: You mean... someone already took the sacred treasure from the shrine?

zh: ：「我認為是這樣。」
en: Without a doubt.

zh: ：「好了，現在我們應該回城裡向國王陛下稟告這一切的事情，有什麼問題就回去再說吧！」
en: We must return to the castle and report this to His Majesty. We can deliberate once we're back!

zh: ：「糟了，妖魔果然已經佔領這個地點了，現在我們該怎麼辦？是要回城裡向國王陛下稟告，還是要將這些妖魔消滅？」
en: Disaster! The fiends have fortified the shrine. Do we pull back to report to the King, or clear them out first?

zh: ：「讓我想想・・・多爾卡，它們好像在找什麼似的，你認為呢？」
en: Let me think... Doruka, they seem to be scouring the place. What do you reckon?

zh: ：「嗯・・・這個神殿裡應該藏有什麼東西是它們要找的，看樣子它們還沒有找到。事不宜遲，我們趕快去阻止它們！」
en: Aye... There's an artifact hidden here, and it looks like they haven't unearthed it yet. We must strike before they find it!

zh: ：「吉斯，要走了唷！」
en: Keith, ready your bow!

zh: ：「沒問題，就看我的了。」
en: Leave it to me, Captain. Right between the eyes!

zh: ：「索菲亞，沒問題吧？」
en: Sophia, are you ready?

zh: ：「放心好了！」
en: My spells are primed and waiting!

zh: ：「好，讓我們去消滅它們！」
en: For the Kingdom! Slay the monsters!

zh: ：「是誰在那裡？」
en: Who goes there?!

zh: ：「這句話應該是我來問才對，你是什麼人？在這裡做什麼？」
en: I should be asking you that! Who are you, and what are you doing skulking around here?

zh: ：「索菲亞不要這樣，讓我來問吧。」
en: Easy, Sophia. Let me handle this.

zh: ：「我們是聖克魯茲王手下的騎士團，目前在國王陛下的命令下要到大陸上執行一項任務，請問您是？」
en: We are the Holy Knights of Santa Cruz, dispatched on a royal mission across the realm. May we have your name, friend?

zh: ：「我的名字叫虎，是一名武鬥家，目前在這裡修行。」
en: The name's Tora. I'm a wandering martial artist, training in these wilds.

zh: ：「有沒有搞錯呀！什麼時代了還在搞特訓這一套，真是笑死人了。」
en: You've got to be kidding me! Mountain training in this day and age? What a joke!

zh: ：「妳・・・想打架是不是？」
en: You... looking for a knuckle sandwich, little lady?!

zh: ：「對不起，我這個夥伴就是這樣嘴很壞，我在這裡向你道歉。」
en: Pardon my companion, she's got a sharp tongue. I apologize on her behalf.

zh: ：「小女孩我也不想和她一般見識，你剛才說你們要到大陸上執行任務？」
en: Hmph. I won't waste my breath bickering with a brat. You said you're on a realm-wide quest?

zh: ：「是的，怎麼樣？」
en: Indeed we are. What of it?

zh: ：「是這樣的，若是你們不嫌棄的話，我想和你們一起走。我身為練武之人，總想要有更新的挑戰，但是在這個地方訓練自己總是少了些真實感，所以・・・・・・」
en: Well, if you'll have me, I'd like to join your company. As a martial artist, I yearn for real battle, but training alone in these mountains lacks true grit...
Hmm... Well...

zh: ：「{HERO}！我想讓他和我們一起走也沒有什麼關係，再怎麼說他也是個練武的人，至少不會拖累我們。」
en: {HERO}! I say let him tag along. He's a warrior through and through—at the very least, he won't slow us down.

zh: ：「好，就這麼決定了。我們出發吧！」
en: Agreed. Welcome aboard, Tora! Let's move out!

zh: ：「現在妖魔的部隊已經出現到這裡了，我看前面一定會有更多的凶險的。羅伊，你認為呢？」
en: Fiends have advanced this far already... The road ahead will only grow more treacherous. What do you think, Roy?

zh: ：「這情況我也明白，不過要我相信他們投靠妖魔我是怎麼樣也不相信的。」
en: I understand the danger, but I will never believe the villagers turned traitor and sided with monsters.

zh: ：「我看這樣好了，我們還是照計劃前往馬蘭村，不過大家要提高警覺，若真的是圈套的話也可以有個心理準備。」
en: Let us stick to the plan and advance on Maran Village. But keep your wits about you in case it's an ambush.

zh: ：「好，就這麼辦！」
en: Understood. Forward!

zh: ：「現在我們的下個目標是那裡？」
en: Where to next, Captain?

zh: ：「羅伊，你有什麼意見？」
en: Roy, what's your take?

zh: ：「出城這麼久我想大家一定都累了，我看我們就到不遠的馬蘭村去休息一下好了，那裡我有一個朋友是在教會中認識的。」
en: We've been marching for hours, everyone must be weary. Maran Village is just ahead—let's rest there. A good friend of mine from the clergy lives in the village.
Maran Village? Hmm...

zh: ：「怎麼了，有什麼問題嗎？」
en: What is it, Doruka? Something wrong?

zh: ：「我曾經在鎮上的酒店裡聽到一些奇怪的消息，據說馬蘭村的村長已經投靠了妖魔，那我們這一去不是自投羅網嗎？」
en: I heard dark rumors at the tavern: they say the village elder of Maran bent the knee to the demon army. If we walk in there, we might be marching straight into a trap.

zh: ：「不會的，我那個朋友的父親就是村長，我不相信有這樣的事！」
en: Nonsense! That friend's father is the elder! He is a man of god, he would never betray the realm!

zh: ：「可是這個消息已經流傳很久了，我相信它應該不是空穴來風。」
en: The rumor has been circulating for weeks. Where there's smoke, there's fire.

zh: ：「這怎麼可能。」
en: That's impossible!

zh: ：「對了！武器店的老闆不是也說他訂的貨也在馬蘭村失蹤了嗎，也許・・・・・・」
en: Come to think of it, didn't the blacksmith say his shipment vanished near Maran as well? Maybe...

zh: ：「這是不可能的！」
en: I won't hear of it!

zh: ：「先不要爭論這些了，我們有朋友來了。」
en: Stop arguing, both of you! We have company.

zh: ：「大家提高警覺，先消滅這些敵人我們再研究之後的事！」
en: Weapons ready! Slay these foes first, we'll settle the debate after!

zh: ：「你們終於來了，我還以為你們放我鴿子了呢。」
en: You finally showed up! I was beginning to think you stood me up!

zh: ：「怎麼會呢？我們只不過是路上多耽擱了一下子。」
en: Perish the thought! We were just delayed on the road by a few unwelcome pests.

zh: ：「謝謝你們救了我的女兒，這樣子我就放心了。」
en: Thank heavens you saved my daughter! My heart can finally rest at ease.

zh: ：「老伯您客氣了，這是我們應該做的。」
en: Think nothing of it, elder. Protecting the realm's people is our solemn oath.

zh: ：「現在我們的下一個地點是那裡？你們有任何建議嗎？」
en: Where should we strike next? Any recommendations?

zh: ：「幸好你們沒有放我鴿子，那些押送我的妖魔有一些早就前往皇家大聖堂了，據說它們要將大聖堂夷為平地。」
en: It's a mercy you arrived when you did! Some of the demons holding me set off for the Royal Cathedral—they plan to raze it to ash!

zh: ：「那就糟了！我們快走。」
en: Then there's no time to lose! To the Royal Cathedral!

zh: ：「琪琪妳要小心啊！」
en: Kiki, my child, stay safe out there!

zh: ：「你放心吧，我會照顧自己的。」
en: Don't you worry about me, father. I can look after myself!

zh: ：「琪琪妳要小心啊！」
en: Kiki, my dear girl, please take care!

zh: ：「拜託你們一定要救出我的女兒。」
en: I beg of you, noble knights, please rescue my daughter!

zh: ：「終於將它們打敗了。」
en: Phew! We finally beat 'em all!

zh: ：「現在應該是弄清楚這一切事情的時候了，羅伊這就交給你了。」
en: Now it's time to get to the bottom of this. Roy, over to you.

zh: ：「老伯，這是怎麼一回事？你怎麼會投靠妖魔呢？」
en: Elder, what happened here? Why would a righteous man like you collaborate with monsters?

zh: ：「請你們原諒我，要不是妖魔們先抓走了我的女兒，我也不會就這樣投靠它們的。」
en: Forgive me, I beg of you! If those vile fiends hadn't taken my daughter hostage, I would have died before yielding to them!

zh: ：「琪琪被抓走了，怎麼一回事？」
en: They took Kiki?! When did this happen?

zh: ：「一個月以前，一群妖魔在我們毫無心理準備的情況下來到家裡，你也知道我們村子裡沒有什麼抵抗的能力，琪琪又是個沒有戰鬥能力的僧侶，所以就這樣子被它們抓走了。」
en: A month ago, a horde of demons stormed my home without warning. You know our village has no garrison, and Kiki is just a gentle cleric. They dragged her off into the night...

zh: ：「它們威脅我和它們合作，不然琪琪就會遭到不幸，我就只有琪琪這一個女兒，所以就只好和它們合作了。」
en: They swore they would torture her if I didn't comply. She is my only child, my whole world! What choice did I have?

zh: ：「那麼琪琪被抓到那裡去了？」
en: Where did they take her?

zh: ：「那一隊妖魔後來是向著巴魯薩城去了，我想琪琪也被帶去那裡了。」
en: The fiends marched south toward Barusa Castle. I fear Kiki was taken there.

zh: ：「好，那我們就去巴魯薩城。」
en: Then to Barusa Castle we go!

zh: ：「喂，喂，你們忘記我的存在啦！」
en: Hey, hey! Did you lot forget I'm standing right here?

zh: ：「你是什麼人？」
en: And who might you be, stranger?

zh: ：「說起我的大名一定會嚇妳一跳，我就是有名的義賊甘達特。」
en: Prepare to be amazed, my lady! I am the renowned chivalrous bandit, Gandat!

zh: ：「甘達特？是新產品嗎？好不好吃？好不好玩？」
en: Gandat? Is that some new pastry? Is it crunchy? Can you eat it?

zh: ：「我的祖先就是王國歷史上最有名的盜賊，但是自從某個事件之後，他就改行成為義賊。」
en: For your information, my ancestor was the most legendary thief in kingdom history! But after a certain turning point, our family swore to steal only for justice.

zh: ：「你們剛才所說的巴魯薩城我去過好幾次，也許可以幫上一些忙，怎麼樣？」
en: I've slipped in and out of Barusa Castle dozens of times. I could be your guide—what do you say?

zh: ：「好吧！希望你不要鬧事就好。」
en: Very well, Gandat. Just make sure you keep your hands to yourself.

zh: ：「放心好了。」
en: Cross my heart, Captain!

zh: ：「拜託你們一定要救出我的女兒。」
en: Please, brave knights, bring my sweet Kiki back safely!

zh: ：「老伯你放心好了。」
en: Rest easy, elder. We give you our word.

zh: ：「你們是什麼人！」
en: Halt! Who goes there?!

zh: ：「老伯，您不認識我了嗎？我是羅伊，以前和琪琪一起在教會中見習的呀！」
en: Elder, don't you recognize me? It's Roy! We studied together at the abbey when Kiki and I were novices!

zh: ：「什麼羅伊，我不認識你。」
en: Roy? I know no Roy! Begone with you!

zh: ：「老伯，這是怎麼一回事？」
en: Elder, what has come over you?

zh: ：「糟糕了，外面來了一大隊的妖魔，你們就是不聽我的勸告早點離開，現在果然出事了吧！」
en: Disaster! A massive legion of fiends is surrounding the village! I told you to clear out earlier, but did you listen? Now look at the mess we're in!

zh: ：「什麼，大家快出去看看！」
en: What?! Everyone outside, now!

zh: ：「那傢伙說得沒錯，外面是有了一大群的妖魔包圍了這裡。」
en: The rogue wasn't lying. A swarm of monsters has completely encircled the perimeter.

zh: ：「什麼那傢伙，我可是有名有姓的。」
en: Hey, I have a name! It's Gandat, not 'the rogue'!

zh: ：「沒有時間爭論這些了，現在我們應該先對付外面的那一堆再說。」
en: Save your bickering for later! Draw your weapons and clear the perimeter first!

zh: ：「好，大家小心了。」
en: On your guard, everyone! Engage!

zh: ：「不知道艾隆鎮那裡是出了什麼事？我訂的貨到現在還沒有送來。」
en: I wonder what happened up in Iron Town? My ore shipment is weeks overdue.

zh: ：「現在本店還在休業中，請您不要一再的來打擾我的休息好嗎？」
en: The shop is closed right now. Please stop pestering an old merchant in his off hours.

zh: ：「哎呀！這不是甘達特嗎？你怎麼和這些人在一起呀！」
en: Well bless my soul, Gandat! What are you doing keeping company with royal knights?

zh: ：「沒有辦法呀，這些人需要一個好的嚮導，我又想要離開這裡，所以就・・・」
en: What can I say? These fine folks needed an expert guide, and I was itching for a change of scenery.

zh: ：「那可真是太好了，以後我就不用擔心店裡的東西被偷了。」
en: Wonderful news! That means I won't have to worry about my inventory sprouting legs and walking out the door!

zh: ：「老闆你可別開玩笑了，我可是從來都沒有動過你店裡的任何東西呀！」
en: Come now, shopkeep, that hurts! I've never pinched a single trinket from your humble store!

zh: ：「別緊張，開個小玩笑罷了。」
en: Relax, boy, just an old man's jest.

zh: ：「你的店怎麼現在還不開張？」
en: Why haven't you reopened your doors yet?

zh: ：「沒有辦法呀！貨到現在還沒有送到。原本來了一批貨以為是我的，結果卻是要送到王城的。」
en: No stock! My supply cart never arrived. A shipment came in earlier and I thought it was mine, but it was addressed to the royal palace.

zh: ：「好了，我要走了。」
en: Well, we must be off.
Farewell, and watch your backs!

zh: ：「各位客人真是對不起，本店最近正在休業中，沒有辦法做生意。」
en: Terribly sorry, travelers. We are currently closed for business.

zh: ：「沒有武器要賣嗎？」
en: No weapons for sale at all?

zh: ：「對不起，店裡什麼都沒有了。」
en: Empty racks, sir. Not a dagger to spare.

zh: ：「對不起，真是招待不周呀。希望您不要計較本店的服務不周呀！」
en: Welcome to our humble inn. Please excuse our modest accommodations!

zh: ：「唷！客人您真是運氣好呀，本店一共就只有一間客房，目前剛好是空的，您的運氣真的不錯。」
en: You're in luck, travelers! We only have one guest room, and it just became vacant. Lucky day!

zh: ：「客人真抱歉，由於本店一共就只有一間客房，目前剛好有人住，所以無法招待各位希望您不要介意。」
en: Deepest apologies, travelers. Our single guest room is currently occupied. We cannot lodge you tonight.

zh: ：「能走就快走喔，不要浪費自己的生命，到時候走不了就麻煩了。」
en: If you value your skin, get moving! Stick around here and you'll find an early grave.

zh: ：「你說這話是什麼意思？」
en: What is that supposed to mean?

zh: ：「你們自己去想想吧，不要浪費自己的生命了，這裡可不是個休息的好地方，能夠早點離開還是早點離開的好。」
en: Figure it out yourselves! This village is a death trap right now. If you have any sense, leave while you still have two legs.

zh: ：「現在這個世界就需要你們這樣子的英雄。」
en: In dark times like these, the world needs champions like you.

zh: ：「這不是琪琪嗎？妳沒事了？」
en: Kiki! My dear, you're unharmed?!

zh: ：「是的，老爺爺。是這些朋友把我從妖魔的手中救回來的。」
en: Yes, grandfather! These brave friends rescued me from the clutches of the fiends.

zh: ：「嗯・・・幹得好，現在這個世界就需要你們這樣子的英雄。」
en: Bless you all! You are true heroes in a world going mad.

zh: ：「聽說村長的女兒被救回來了，不知道是真是假？」
en: I heard the elder's daughter was rescued. I pray it's true!

zh: ：「原來是村長的女兒被抓走了，難怪他會變得這麼的奇怪。」
en: So the fiends took his daughter... No wonder the poor elder was acting so out of his mind.

zh: ：「說也奇怪，最近村長好像變了個人似的，不知道是怎麼一回事。他的女兒也不知道跑到那裡去了。」
en: It was so bizarre. The elder suddenly turned cold as ice, and his daughter vanished without a word.

zh: ：「年輕人，要小心啊。」
en: Walk carefully, young travelers.

zh: ：「位於南方山脈中有個叫帕米歐斯，它是這大陸中最平坦，最寬廣的地方。」
en: High in the southern mountains lies the Pamius Plains—the vastest, flattest expanse in all the realm.

zh: ：「啊・・・琪琪，妳沒事了？妳的朋友真厲害，不但救了村子，還救了妳。」
en: Kiki! You're back! Your friends are amazing—they saved both you and our village!

zh: ：「是啊，他們可是聖克魯茲城的聖騎士呢！」
en: They truly are! They're the Holy Knights of Santa Cruz Castle!

zh: ：「聽說村長的女兒被救回來了，一定是你們救的，年輕人真行。」
en: Word is the elder's daughter was saved. It must have been your doing. Well done, youths!

zh: ：「年輕人真厲害，能夠打退怪物。」
en: Splendid work, young heroes, driving those beasts away!

zh: ：「年輕人，我說的話要聽不聽隨便你。」
en: Listen to an old crone's warning or don't, it's your funeral.

zh: ：「哦哦・陌生人・・快走吧，這裡不是你該來的地方。」
en: Outsiders... flee this place! There is nothing here for you but sorrow.

zh: ：「這是為什麼？」
en: Why do you say that, grandmother?

zh: ：「你不知道嗎？怪物就快來了。」
en: Are you blind? The monsters will be back any minute!

zh: ：「老婆婆，我們能幫你打倒怪物。」
en: Fear not, grandmother. We are knights—we will slay them for you.

zh: ：「不用了，你還是快點逃命去吧。
en: Save your breath and run while you still can!

zh: ：「加油吧！有空再來馬蘭村玩。」
en: Fight on, heroes! Come visit Maran Village when peace returns.

zh: ：「這不是琪琪嗎？妳沒事了？」
en: Kiki! Thank the heavens you're safe!

zh: ：「聽說村長的女兒被救回來了，如果你們有遇到她，請代我向她問好。」
en: I heard the elder's daughter was rescued. If you see her, give her my warmest regards.

zh: ：「村長的女兒被怪物抓走，有人說他被抓到丹托鎮。」
en: The monsters snatched the elder's daughter and dragged her toward Danto Town, or so they say.

zh: ：「快離開，怪物在一段時間後就會回來・・・快走・・」
en: Run! The fiends will return before long... flee while you have the chance!

zh: ：「你們是好人。」
en: You are truly good people.

zh: ：「這不是琪琪嗎？妳沒事了？」
en: Is that Kiki?! You're unharmed!

zh: ：「聽說村長的女兒被救回來了，是不是你們救的？」
en: They say Kiki was rescued from the monsters. Was it your doing, travelers?

zh: ：「謝謝你救了本村，但是村長的女兒被抓走了，現在不知在何處？」
en: Thank you for defending our village. But the elder's daughter was taken, and no one knows where she is...

zh: ：「你還在這裡做什麼？還不快走？」
en: What are you still doing loitering about? Move on!

zh: ：「哇・怪物快來了・・快點逃。」
en: Eeeek! The monsters are coming! Run for your lives!

zh: ：「年輕人不喜歡留在這樸實村子，多數的人都到南方巴魯薩城裡找工作。」
en: The youth don't care for quiet village life anymore. Most pack their bags and head south to Barusa for work.

zh: ：「終於回復以前的平靜。謝謝你，你是本村的英雄。」
en: Peace has finally returned to our valley. Thank you—you are the saviors of our village!

zh: ：「年輕人都到外面工作，現在村子裡只剩下老年人和小孩子，要是怪物那一天來了，就沒有人能抵抗攻擊，這不知要如何是好？」
en: With all the young folk working abroad, only elders and babes remain. If monsters attack, we are defenseless. What will become of us?

zh: ：「大哥哥，大姐姐，要加油喔。」
en: Cheer up, big brother, big sister! You can do it!

zh: ：「大哥哥你知道嗎？有一天我們村子來了一位身上穿神官服的老先生，好像說要到皇家大聖堂。不知他到了沒有？」
en: Did you know, sir? An elderly priest passed through our village days ago, saying he was headed for the Royal Cathedral. I wonder if he made it?

zh: ：「嗯・・會不會是他？」
en: Hmm... Could it be him?

zh: ：「你說的是誰？」
en: Who are you talking about, Roy?

zh: ：「不・・沒什麼。」
en: No... It's nothing.

zh: ：「啊・・大哥哥，為了保險起見，每次你到一個村子最好隨時隨地去教會記錄現在的故事比較安全。」
en: A piece of advice, sir: whenever you reach a new village, always visit the church to record your deeds. Safety first!

zh: ：「原來是村長的女兒被抓走，要是再有怪物來，不知又會帶走什麼？」
en: First the elder's daughter... If the fiends come back, what will they steal next?

zh: ：「哇・・好可怕啊！上一個月大批怪物從村子通過，村子裡的人合力把怪物趕跑，但是怪物在走了數天後，村長就變得怪怪的，不知是為什麼？」
en: It was terrifying! Last month a horde marched right past our homes. We drove them off, but days later the elder started acting so strange...

zh: ：「這裡是聖克魯茲鎮。」
en: This is Santa Cruz Town.

zh: ：「啊！{HERO}，聽說南方有魔物攻擊馬蘭村，不知道是不是真的？」
en: Ah, {HERO}! They say fiends assaulted Maran Village in the south. Is it true?!

zh: ：「這裡是聖克魯茲鎮。」
en: This is the town of Santa Cruz.

zh: ：「{HERO}，國王在召見你，快點去王城會見國王。」
en: {HERO}, His Majesty has summoned you. Hurry to the throne room at once!

zh: ：「這裡是聖克魯茲鎮。」
en: This is the town of Santa Cruz.

zh: ：「南方有個叫作修行瀑布的地方，是一個風景很漂亮的地方。」
en: To the south lies the Training Falls, a place of breathtaking scenic beauty.

zh: ：「這裡是聖克魯茲鎮。」
en: This is the town of Santa Cruz.

zh: ：「咦？{HERO}，國王不是在召集所有的小隊長，你還不快點去。」
en: Eh? {HERO}, isn't the King assembling all squad captains? You had best make haste!

zh: ：「一定要裝備武器和防具，只是攜帶是不行的，一定要裝備才行。」
en: Remember to equip your weapons and armor! Simply carrying them in your pouch does you no good in combat.

zh: ：「神殿裡的東西好像是用來封印某怪物的，現在裡面物品被拿走了，這下可不好了。」
en: The relic within the shrine was placed there to seal an ancient evil. Now that it has been plundered, dark times are upon us.

zh: ：「北方古代神殿好像發生什麼事情？」
en: Did something happen at the northern Ancient Shrine?

zh: ：「古代神殿有個古老的傳說，傳說以前勇者放置了什麼物品在神殿裡。」
en: An ancient legend tells of a sacred relic enshrined within the northern sanctuary by the legendary hero.

zh: ：「這裡是聖克魯茲鎮。」
en: This is the town of Santa Cruz.

zh: ：「最近從南方天空上看到一片黑雲慢慢向聖克魯茲城接近，難道是魔物復甦嗎？」
en: Lately, an ominous black cloud drifts slowly from the southern horizon toward Santa Cruz. Could ancient fiends be awakening?

zh: ：「{HERO}，你們要到古代神殿要小心點，聽說那一帶常有怪物出沒。」
en: {HERO}, tread with care on your way to the Ancient Shrine. Monsters frequently prowl those ridges.

zh: ：「沒辨法，這是我們的任務。」
en: Duty calls—it is our mission.

zh: ：「那麼你要小心點唷。」
en: Then watch your back out there.
Thank you.

zh: ：「不客氣。」
en: You're most welcome.

zh: ：「{HERO}，在戰場上有些草地，好像能撿到寶物，所以在戰場上不能放過這些地方。」
en: {HERO}, search patches of tall grass on the battlefield—hidden treasures are often buried beneath them. Never overlook such terrain!

zh: ：「這是真的嗎？那麼我會記下來，以後一定會檢查。」
en: Is that true? I shall keep that in mind and inspect unusual ground whenever we fight.

zh: ：「唉・・・聽說我訂的貨在馬蘭村就失去下落了，這一次可虧大了。」
en: Sigh... word reached me that my trade caravan lost all contact near Maran Village. I'm ruined!

zh: ：「唉・・・我所訂的貨到現在還沒有送來，不知道是不是在路上被打劫了，要真是這樣那我就虧大了。」
en: Sigh... the goods I ordered have yet to arrive. I fear the shipment was ambushed by highway bandits. If so, I'll face ruinous losses.

zh: ：「歡迎歡迎，客人您真是好眼光呀，本店的道具物美價廉，保證讓你不虛此行。不過嘛・・・這一陣子外面太亂了，所以我訂的貨都還沒有運到呢。」
en: Welcome, welcome! You have a keen eye, traveler. Our wares are of peerless quality and modest price. Alas... with the roads so chaotic lately, my latest shipment hasn't arrived.

zh: ：「唷，是{HERO}呀！真是稀客。不過你現在來的太早了，我的店還沒有開張呢，讓我多休息一下，再過一兩個時辰就會開張了。」
en: Well, if it isn't {HERO}! Quite the honored guest. But you've arrived too early—my shop hasn't opened for the day yet. Come back in an hour or two!

zh: ：「謝謝光臨，請您空的話一定要再次光臨。先在這裡謝謝你了。」
en: Thank you for your patronage! Please grace our humble counter again whenever your travels permit.

zh: ：「歡迎光臨！本店可說是全國最好的旅店，我們的床鋪柔軟舒適，我們的服務讓您有回到家的感覺，請您好好的休息吧。」
en: Welcome! Our establishment is the finest inn in the kingdom. Our beds are soft as down and our service feels like home. Rest your weary bones!

zh: ：「嘿！你不是{HERO}嗎？怎麼會這個時間還在這裡呢？我聽說國王已經召集所有的小隊長了，你不是應該也要去集合嗎？」
en: Hey! Aren't you {HERO}? What are you still doing in town at this hour? I heard His Majesty summoned all squad captains—shouldn't you be at the palace?

zh: ：「雖然寶珠的光芒已經完全消失了，但是你的心中還有著完全不同的光芒。只要你能夠保持自己心中的光，就可以拯救這個世界的未來。」
en: Though the radiance of the orbs has faded, an entirely different light burns within your heart. As long as you preserve that sacred spark, you can save the future of our world.

zh: ：「唉・・・沒想到連十兵衛也死了，他雖然早就知道自己的死期，但是卻還是不信邪的想要改變一切・・・唉・・・・・・」
en: Alas... to think even Master Jubei has fallen. Though he foresaw his own end, he strove to defy fate until his dying breath... Sigh............

zh: ：「老婆婆，您也相信這一些嗎？」
en: Granny, do you truly believe in these omens?

zh: ：「我是不願意相信，但是目前的情勢卻越來越接近我所看到的情況，使我不相信也不行。」
en: I wish I could disbelieve them, yet the realm's turmoil matches my visions all too closely, leaving no room for doubt.

zh: ：「您可不可以再為我看看。」
en: Could you peer into the crystal ball once more for me?

zh: ：「嗯・・・就讓我看看，咦？怎麼會有這樣子的事？」
en: Mm... let me gaze into the mists... Eh? How could this be?!

zh: ：「怎麼了？」
en: What is it, Granny?

zh: ：「雖然五個寶珠的光芒都被黑雲給覆蓋了，但是我確在這五個寶珠的位置看到完全不同的五道光芒，或許這是上天所賜的。」
en: Though the light of the five orbs has been smothered by the dark clouds, five brand-new, radiant beams have arisen in their stead! Perhaps this is heaven's divine blessing.

zh: ：「啊・・・啊・・・啊・・・綠色的光芒也被黑雲蓋住了，怎麼會這樣？怎麼會這樣呢？世界就要毀滅了，所有的光芒都消失了，只剩下你心中的一點小光芒了。」
en: Ah... ah... ah! The green light has also been swallowed by darkness! How could this happen?! The world stands upon the brink of ruin—all the lights are extinguished, save for a tiny ember in your soul!

zh: ：「啊・・・啊・・・啊・・・我看到黑雲又將圍繞著綠色的光茫，光茫就快要被黑雲蓋住了・・・・・・」
en: Ah... ah! I see dark clouds gathering around the green radiance... The light is nearly snuffed out............

zh: ：「啊・・・啊・・・啊・・・紫色的光芒也被黑雲蓋住了，怎麼會這樣？怎麼會這樣呢？」
en: Ah... ah! The purple light has also been engulfed by black fog! How could this be?! What is happening?!

zh: ：「啊・・・啊・・・啊・・・我看到黑雲又將圍繞著紫色的光茫，光茫就快要被黑雲蓋住了・・・・・・」
en: Ah... ah! I see dark clouds swirling around the purple radiance... The light is about to be smothered............

zh: ：「啊・・・啊・・・啊・・・藍色的光芒也被黑雲蓋住了，怎麼會這樣？怎麼會這樣呢？」
en: Ah... ah! The blue light has been smothered by darkness as well! How could this happen?!

zh: ：「啊・・・啊・・・啊・・・我看到黑雲又將圍繞著藍色的光茫，光茫就快要被黑雲蓋住了・・・・・・」
en: Ah... ah! I see dark clouds coiling around the blue radiance... The light is fading fast............

zh: ：「啊・・・啊・・・啊・・・黃色的光芒也被黑雲蓋住了，怎麼會這樣？怎麼會這樣呢？」
en: Ah... ah! The yellow light has been completely smothered by dark fog! How can this be?!

zh: ：「啊・・・啊・・・啊・・・我看到黑雲已經圍繞著黃色的光茫，光茫就快要被黑雲蓋住了・・・・・・」
en: Ah... ah! Dark clouds have completely enveloped the yellow radiance... The light is on the verge of vanishing............

zh: ：「孩子，你的未來相當的凶險呀！不過我相信你心中的光芒將可以幫你渡過這一切危險的。」
en: Child, your future is perilous in the extreme! Yet I believe the radiant light in your heart will guide you safely through every trial.

zh: ：「年輕人過來一下。」
en: Come closer, young warrior.

zh: ：「什麼事，老婆婆？」
en: What is it, grandmother?

zh: ：「我感覺到你的身上有著相當重大的任務，但是又有著許多未知的謎需要你去解決，你願意聽聽故事嗎？」
en: I sense a momentous destiny upon your shoulders, yet countless mysteries remain unsolved. Would you care to hear an ancient tale?

zh: ：「別理她，我們不是有要緊的事要做嗎？還不趕快離開。」
en: Pay her no mind! We have pressing royal duties—let's make haste!

zh: ：「沒關係，聽聽拉米亞婆婆有什麼故事也好，婆婆您請說。」
en: It does no harm to listen to Granny Lamia's wisdom. Please, grandmother, we are listening.

zh: ：「嗯・・・我相信你已經知道六顆寶珠的事情了吧？」
en: Mm... I trust you are already aware of the Six Orbs?
Yes, we know of them.

zh: ：「我現在所要說的事也和這六顆寶珠有關。在當初勇者將這六顆寶珠藏起來的時候，曾經為每一個寶珠選定了一名守護者，這六名守護者的存亡正表示了這六顆寶珠封印的維持。」
en: What I have to say concerns those very orbs. When the ancient hero concealed them across the land, he chose a guardian for each orb. The life of each guardian sustains the seal of their corresponding orb.

zh: ：「為了保護他們的安全，這六名守護者都不知道其他人的身份。不過，為了怕時間流逝後再也找不出這六顆寶珠的下落，所以勇者在三本古老的書籍上留下了這六個人的線索。」
en: To protect their secrecy, none of the six guardians knew the identities of the others. Yet fearing that knowledge of the orbs would be lost to time, the hero hid clues across three ancient books.

zh: ：「第一本就是王室所保存的年鑑，它上面有著這六個寶珠隱藏地點的提示地點。第二本是吉普賽人的歷史文獻，裡面記載了六個寶珠的力量。第三本是最重要的一本，它的上面記載著六名守護者的身份。」
en: The first is the Royal Annals kept in the palace, hinting at the hiding places. The second is the Gypsy Historical Chronicle, recording the powers of the orbs. And the third—most vital of all—records the identities of the six guardians.

zh: ：「老婆婆，在我們離開王城之前，大法師曾經和我們提起一段謎一般的詩句，這些詩句是・・・・・・」
en: Grandmother, before we departed the capital, the Grand Mage spoke of a cryptic stanza...

zh: ：「這些詩句就是王室年鑑上所記載的資料，只有這些是不夠。要想得知真正的隱藏地點，就必需要獲得這三份資料才能夠知道所有寶珠的地點。」
en: That riddle was inscribed within the Royal Annals. But that alone is not enough. To discover the true sanctuaries, one must gather all three ancient texts.

zh: ：「可是妖魔們已經到古代神殿裡不知道取走了什麼，它們是怎麼知道的？」
en: Yet the demons already breached the Ancient Shrine and stole something within! How could they have known?

zh: ：「啊・・・有這樣的事？這麼說妖魔們已經知道所有寶珠的下落了嗎？讓我為你們占上一卦吧！」
en: Ah... could it be?! Does the demon host already know the locations of all the orbs?! Let me cast a divination for you!

zh: ：「嗯・・・這個・・・怎麼會是這樣？我完全看不到你們的將來・・・我只看到六個不同顏色的光芒被一片黑雲圍繞著，而光芒越來越弱・・・啊！紅色的光芒被黑雲蓋住了・・・・・・」
en: Mm... what... how can this be?! I cannot foresee your future at all... I see only six radiant beams of different colors engulfed by dark clouds, their light growing ever fainter... Ah! The crimson light has been completely smothered by the shadow............

zh: ：「婆婆，妳怎麼了？」
en: Grandmother, what happened?!

zh: ：「孩子，你的未來相當的凶險呀！不過我相信你心中的光芒將可以幫你渡過這一切危險的。」
en: Child, the path ahead of you is perilous in the extreme! Yet I believe the radiant light in your heart will guide you safely through every trial.

zh: ：「我所能告訴你的就只有這些，其他的必需靠你自己去探索了。」
en: That is all I can reveal to you. The rest of the truth is yours to discover.
Grandmother, I............

zh: ：「你別說，我知道你的來意。你想要知道這股邪惡力量的起源嗎？」
en: Say no more—I know why you have come. You wish to understand the genesis of this encroaching malice?
Yes, we do.

zh: ：「這是一個相當古老的故事了・・・很久很久以前，大陸上曾經被一名魔王所率領的魔王軍所威脅著。這個時候四名勇士挺身而出，他們用六顆喚醒不死鳥的寶珠將魔王封印在地底，使王國恢復了和平。」
en: It is an ancient tale... Long, long ago, the continent was threatened by an archdemon and his legion. Four champions arose and sealed him beneath the earth using six Phoenix Orbs, restoring peace to the kingdom.

zh: ：「這件事和最近所發生的奇怪現象有什麼關係呢？」
en: And how does that ancient legend connect to the horrors unfolding today?

zh: ：「這個大魔王就是洛馬，由於他的力量實在太大了，就連寶珠也只能將它暫時的封住，所以要是有人將這六顆用來封印魔王的寶珠奪走，沒有封印壓制的魔王將再一次的控制大陸。」
en: That archdemon was none other than Loma. Because his power was so monstrous, even the sacred orbs could only seal him away temporarily. If someone plunders those six sealing orbs, the unsealed Archdemon will once again conquer the continent.

zh: ：「這件事和現在的狀況又有什麼關係呢？」
en: And how does that tie into our current crisis?

zh: ：「目前一切還在未知的狀況，我也無法由水晶球中看出任何徵兆，但是我相信這兩件事一定有所關連的。」
en: Much remains veiled in shadow, and even my crystal sphere reveals no clear signs. Yet I am certain the two are inextricably bound.

zh: ：「謝謝你，這樣就夠了。」
en: Thank you, grandmother. That is enough.

zh: ：「老婆婆，我將要去執行一件危險的任務，我想請您幫我占卜一下。」
en: Grandmother, I am about to embark on a perilous mission. Could you read my fortune?

zh: ：「嗯・・・讓我看看・・・雖然你的任務相當的危險，在你的面前是一片的黑暗。但是只要你能夠維持著心裡的光芒，就可以突破難關，完成你的任務。
en: Mm... let me gaze into the glass... Though your quest is fraught with peril and pitch darkness lies ahead, as long as you preserve the radiant light in your heart, you shall overcome every hardship and fulfill your destiny.

zh: ：「嗯・・・小隊長集合的時間到了，快去吧。」
en: Mm... the squad captains' assembly hour has arrived. Make haste!

zh: ：「最近的天氣越來越怪了，這該不是世界末日的預兆吧！」
en: The weather grows more bizarre by the day... Could this be an omen of the end times?!

zh: ：「{HERO}！好久不見了，聽說你最近為了國王陛下交付的任務相當的忙碌，真是辛苦了。」
en: {HERO}! Long time no see! I hear you've been run ragged on His Majesty's missions—you must be exhausted.

zh: ：「・・・真是可怕呀，原來魔軍也會用人質來脅迫我們呀，那麼我也要小心了。」
en: ...How terrifying! To think the demon army would resort to hostages to coerce us—I must keep my guard up as well.

zh: ：「快去執行任務吧。」
en: Go forth and fulfill your royal mission.

zh: ：「歡迎光臨！聽說你們又要出發了？」
en: Welcome! Word has it you're setting off on another mission?

zh: ：「是呀，又有新的任務了。」
en: Aye, we've received new orders.

zh: ：「真是辛苦，喝杯酒吧，我請客！」
en: Hard work indeed! Have an ale on the house!

zh: ：「那怎麼好意思・・・真是謝謝你了，最近有沒有什麼奇怪的消息？」
en: You're too kind... My thanks! Have you heard any peculiar rumors lately?

zh: ：「嗯・・・這個嘛・・・據說在城西的瀑布曾經有人看到一個怪人在瀑布附近徘徊，不知道是為了什麼。」
en: Mm... well now... Folk say a strange figure was seen lingering near the waterfall west of town, though nobody knows why.

zh: ：「城西的瀑布？」
en: The waterfall west of the city?

zh: ：「嗯・・・就是出城後西方山區裡的那個瀑布。多爾卡你應該知道吧？」
en: Aye... the waterfall in the western mountains just outside the gates. Doruka, surely you know the spot?

zh: ：「我知道。」
en: Aye, I know it well.

zh: ：「看樣子我們有空應該到瀑布去看看是怎麼一回事。老闆，謝謝你的酒了。」
en: It seems we should investigate that waterfall when time permits. Barkeep, thanks for the ale!

zh: ：「那裡那裡。」
en: Think nothing of it!

zh: ：「回來啦？向國王報告調查結果了嗎？」
en: Back already? Have you reported your findings to the King?

zh: ：「有任務要執行啦？那麼趕快去吧。」
en: New orders from the throne? Then hurry along!

zh: ：「{HERO}開完會了，要不要喝一杯？」
en: {HERO}, finished with your council? How about a drink?

zh: ：「{HERO}！國王不是召集你們所有的小隊長開會，還在這裡做什麼？」
en: {HERO}! Didn't His Majesty summon all squad captains to council? What are you still doing here?!

zh: ：「世界末日快到了嗎？太可怕了！」
en: Is the end of the world truly upon us?! How horrifying!

zh: ：「哎呀，{HERO}呀！好久不見了，聽說你最近為了國王陛下交付的任務相當的忙碌，真是辛苦了。」
en: Ah, {HERO}! Long time no see! I hear you've been run ragged on His Majesty's missions—you must be exhausted.

zh: ：「哎呀呀・・・真是可怕呀，原來魔軍也會用人質來脅迫我們呀，這下子我也要小心了。」
en: Good heavens... How dreadful that the demon army resorts to taking hostages! I must watch my own family closely.

zh: ：「你怎麼又來了，不是有任務要執行嗎？等你完成任務後，我再請你喝酒。」
en: Back again? Don't you have a mission to carry out? When you complete it, I'll treat you to an ale!

zh: ：「哎呀呀・・・是{HERO}呀！我告訴你唷，最近有許多奇怪的傳言說馬蘭村的村長已經投靠妖魔了，你們可要小心唷！」
en: Bless my soul, {HERO}! Whispers say the elder of Maran Village sold out to the fiends! Keep your eyes peeled out there!

zh: ：「你怎麼又來了，不是有任務要執行嗎？等你完成任務後，我再請你喝酒。」
en: Back again? Don't you have a mission to carry out? When you complete it, I'll treat you to an ale!

zh: ：「唷・・・是{HERO}呀！你們開完會了？怎麼樣，讓我請你喝一杯酒吧？」
en: Well now, {HERO}! Council adjourned already? How about I buy you an ale?

zh: ：「這個・・・不太好吧，我才剛剛接下了國王陛下的命令，要前往古代神殿。若是在這個時候喝醉可就誤事了。」
en: I appreciate the thought, but I've just received His Majesty's orders to march on the Ancient Shrine. Getting drunk right now would be catastrophic.

zh: ：「哎呀！那可真是太可惜了。不過・・・為了你的任務著想，我看就等你回來之後我再請你喝一杯吧！」
en: Ah, what a pity! But for the sake of your mission, I'll save that drink for your triumphant return!

zh: ：「好，一言為定！」
en: Very well, it's a promise!
Oh, before I forget............

zh: ：「什麼事？」
en: What is it?

zh: ：「若是你有空的話，別忘了到拉米亞老婆婆的占卜屋去一趟，應該可以得到你所需要的指示。」
en: If you have time, be sure to visit Granny Lamia's divination hut. You're sure to find guidance for the road ahead.
Much obliged.

zh: ：「那裡，小意思嘛。」
en: Think nothing of it—happy to help!

zh: ：「{HERO}！快去王城集合吧！等一下我請你喝一杯。」
en: {HERO}! Hurry to the throne room to assemble! I'll buy you an ale afterward.
Zzz... Zzz...

zh: ：「我作了一個惡夢，夢見一座古老的城堡被魔物所占領。」
en: I had a dreadful nightmare... I saw an ancient fortress seized by dark fiends.

zh: ：「啊！是{HERO}呀！真是好久不見了。」
en: Ah, {HERO}! It has been ages!

zh: ：「南方有個中立國家叫作巴魯薩，聽說這個國家的人民和怪物和平相處。」
en: To the south lies a neutral realm called Barusa. Word has it humans and monsters dwell together in peace there.

zh: ：「聖克魯茲王國是由數個聯邦合起來，保護這大陸上的人民。」
en: The Kingdom of Santa Cruz was forged from an alliance of city-states to shield the folk of this continent.

zh: ：「快去執行國王交待的任務。」
en: Go forth and fulfill His Majesty's royal command.

zh: ：「南方路上有魔物阻擋，所以經過時要小心為妙。」
en: Monsters prowl the southern highways, so tread with vigilance.

zh: ：「有人在西方的修行瀑布發現一個人影，不知是不是魔物出現？」
en: Someone spotted a mysterious figure near the Training Falls to the west. Could fiends have appeared there?

zh: ：「呵呵・・{HERO}，聽說你接下了國王交待的任務，那麼快去執行吧。」
en: Heh heh... {HERO}, I hear you accepted His Majesty's mission. Go and see it done!

zh: ：「北方有個神殿，牆壁上刻了謎樣的古老紋章。」
en: To the north stands an ancient shrine, its stone walls carved with arcane heraldry.

zh: ：「哈・・・哈・・・哈・・・這一次靠這個事件又讓我賺了不少錢，那些想要離開的人都把房子廉價賣給我，現在我可以高價的把這些房子再賣給他們了。」
en: Bwahaha! This commotion has lined my pockets handsomely! All those fleeing fools sold me their manors for pennies, and now I can sell them back at triple the price!

zh: ：「怎麼辦，怎麼辦？我不是每年付它們好多錢嗎？怎麼會這樣？」
en: What shall I do? What shall I do?! Didn't I pay them fortunes in tribute each year? How could this happen?!

zh: ：「我可要再次的警告你們，千萬不要在我的城裡鬧事，這可是很重的罪。」
en: I warn you once more: brawling in my city is strictly forbidden! It carries severe penalties!

zh: ：「我已經聽說過在酒店裡發生的事情了，請你們注意千萬不要在城裡鬧事，這是相當嚴重的罪。」
en: I heard what happened in the tavern. Take heed: never stir up trouble within this city—the consequences are dire.

zh: ：「你怎麼能夠容許妖魔出現在你的城裡？」
en: How can you permit demonic beasts to walk openly in your city?!

zh: ：「妖魔又怎麼樣？對我來說最重要的就是賺錢。只要這些妖魔也有錢讓我賺，讓它們自由進出又怎麼樣？」
en: What of it? To me, profit is everything! As long as monsters have gold to spend, why shouldn't they come and go as they please?

zh: ：「這是那一國的理論，怎麼會有人為了錢什麼都不顧？」
en: What kind of twisted logic is that?! Abandoning all honor for filthy lucre?!

zh: ：「哈哈哈・・・什麼都不顧？我告訴你，我就是個這樣的人。好不容易有這麼一個賺錢的機會我怎麼能夠放過。」
en: Hahaha! Abandon honor? I am a merchant through and through! Why would I let a golden opportunity slip through my fingers?

zh: ：「歡迎各位來到中立城市巴魯薩城，在這裡人類和妖魔是平等的，誰都不能在城裡鬧事。若是有人想在城裡鬧事，那麼將會被逮捕。」
en: Welcome to the neutral city of Barusa! Here, humans and fiends stand as equals. Keep the peace, or our dungeons await.

zh: ：「那個傢伙說的謠言呀！害了不少人無家可歸，真是可惡。」
en: That wretch's vile rumors left so many good folk homeless! Truly unforgivable!

zh: ：「我也好想逃，但不能走，嗯・嗯・・。」
en: I want to flee too, but as a guard, I cannot abandon my post...

zh: ：「哇・・聽村民說妖魔快攻過來了，要不要逃離這個地方？」
en: The villagers say the demon army is marching this way! Shouldn't we pack up and run?

zh: ：「沒辦法，我們是士兵，不能任意逃走。」
en: No can do. We're sworn garrison troops—we can't just desert our posts.

zh: ：「你想城主會不會來救我們？」
en: Do you think the Lord will ride out to protect us?

zh: ：「不可能的，你明知道城主的為人，他會救自己，哪會救我們。」
en: Fat chance! You know what he's like—he'd sell his own mother to save his skin, let alone us.

zh: ：「對呀！我想也是不太可能，他那麼自私，可能現在正準備逃跑。」
en: Aye, you're right. That selfish parasite is probably packing his gold chests right now.

zh: ：「那麼要怎麼辦呢？」
en: What are we supposed to do, then?

zh: ：「又不能走，只得留在這裡。」
en: We can't leave. All we can do is hold the line.

zh: ：「你們不要聽那位士兵信口胡說，城主沒有那麼壞，這是真的。」
en: Don't listen to that guard's slander! Our Lord isn't that wicked, truly!

zh: ：「在城內安份點，不要鬧事，不然你會被抓去關，被抓時不要說我沒警告過你們。」
en: Keep your noses clean in town and don't cause trouble. Otherwise, you'll be locked in irons—don't say I didn't warn you.

zh: ：「去、去去、不要站在這裡。」
en: Move along, move along! Don't loiter here.

zh: ：「有不少人賣掉房子逃難去，現在想回來又買不起房子了。好在我沒逃跑，不然就會和那些村民一樣。」
en: Many folk sold their houses for pennies to flee the realm, and now they can't afford to buy them back. Good thing I stood fast, or I'd be homeless too.

zh: ：「哇・・嗯・嗯・不能走。」
en: Ugh... mm... I can't leave...

zh: ：「這裡是中立之城巴魯薩城。」
en: This is the neutral sanctuary of Barusa Castle.

zh: ：「偷偷告訴你，城主是個自私又小氣的人。」
en: Keep this between us, but our Lord is a greedy, cowardly skinflint.
Oh... is that so?
And what's more...

zh: ：「喂！你不要在背後說城主的壞話！」
en: Quiet! Don't badmouth the Lord behind his back!

zh: ：「我沒有說錯呀！他明明就是這種人。上次啊，他就拐騙了不少人民的血汗錢，這次又不知會有多少人受害，簡直就是吸血鬼・・・」
en: I speak no lies! He's a crook, plain and simple! Last month he swindled countless folk out of their hard-earned coin, and now more are suffering. He's an outright bloodsucker...

zh: ：「不要再說了，好不好？」
en: Will you hold your tongue?!

zh: ：「好啦，好啦，・・・我不說了。」
en: Fine, fine... I'll say no more.

zh: ：「去、去去、不要站在這裡。」
en: Move along, move along! Don't loiter here.

zh: ：「你們說怪物攻擊路人？不可能，一定是你們聖克魯茲城的人忌妒我們國家，才編了這麼大謊言。」
en: You claim monsters are ambushing travelers? Impossible! You folk from Santa Cruz are just jealous of our city and spreading vicious lies!

zh: ：「謝謝光臨，感謝您對本店的照顧，有空一定要再來呀！」
en: Thank you for your patronage! Do come again whenever you pass through!

zh: ：「歡迎歡迎，這裡是本城的旅店，不但房間舒適而且服務又好唷。雖然本店也住著妖魔，但是絕對不會傷害客人您的，請好好休息吧。」
en: Welcome, welcome! Our inn offers cozy beds and peerless hospitality. Though a few fiends lodge here as well, they won't harm our guests. Sleep soundly!

zh: ：「酒保，拿酒來！」
en: Barkeeper, bring more ale!

zh: ：「那裡來的野蠻人，吵死人了！」
en: Where did this loud brute crawl from? So noisy!

zh: ：「這個標幟・・・你這傢伙是妖魔一夥的，你怎麼會在這裡？」
en: That crest... You're with the demon army! What are you doing in this city?!

zh: ：「什麼，妖魔一夥的傢伙！」
en: What?! One of the fiends?!

zh: ：「千萬不能在這裡鬧事，這個巴魯薩城就是有名的中立城。無論是那一方的人都可以在城裡自由進出，若是在城裡鬧事的話將會被逮捕的。」
en: Hold your blades! Barusa is a famed neutral city—both humans and demons can enter freely. If you start a brawl here, the guards will arrest us all!

zh: ：「可惡，就這樣的放過這個傢伙嗎？有種的就報上名來！」
en: Blast it! Are we just going to let this wretch walk away?! If you have any guts, state your name!

zh: ：「哼哼哼・・・小子你聽清楚了，我的名字叫卡拉哈德，是魔軍旗下三大軍團長的魔劍士。」
en: Heh heh heh... Listen well, pups. The name is Galahad—Magic Swordsman and one of the Three Legion Commanders of the Demon Host!

zh: ：「這次就放過你，下次再讓我們見到絕對會讓你好看！」
en: We'll let you off this once! Cross our paths again and we'll cut you down!

zh: ：「哼！我最痛恨的就是你們自稱正義之士的傢伙，下次見面不知道是誰讓誰好看。哈哈哈・・・我們就走著瞧吧！」
en: Hmph! I despise nothing more than hypocrites who claim the mantle of justice! Next time we meet, we'll see who cuts down whom! Hahaha... Until then!

zh: ：「哇・・嗯・嗯・哇・我賣掉房子現在沒錢買回房子了・・嗯・嗯・哇・・」
en: Waah... I sold my family home, and now I don't have enough coin to buy it back! *Sob*...

zh: ：「我要趕快逃離這個地方！要是被怪物抓走那可就沒命了。」
en: I must flee this city at once! If the beasts capture me, it's the end of my life!

zh: ：「哎・・真是無聊。」
en: Sigh... nothing to do around here.

zh: ：「我爸爸到處向朋友借錢，因為現在沒錢買回房子。」
en: My father is running around begging friends for loans, because we don't have enough coin to reclaim our home.

zh: ：「我爸爸打算把房子賣了之後趕緊逃走。」
en: My father plans to sell our house and flee the city as fast as he can.

zh: ：「啊・・好無聊！大哥哥你能陪我玩嗎？」
en: Ah... so boring! Mister, will you play with me?

zh: ：「小妹妹，你有沒有看到一位十多歲的女孩，名叫琪琪？」
en: Little girl, have you seen a young maiden about your sister's age named Kiki?

zh: ：「哈哈呀・・你說的是不是馬蘭村村長的女兒？」
en: Haha! Are you speaking of the Maran Village chieftain's daughter?

zh: ：「你怎麼知道。」
en: How did you know?!

zh: ：「那天啊！我在酒店看到一些怪物，牠們正好談到一個叫作琪琪的女孩。」
en: Just the other day in the tavern, I overheard some beasts whispering about a girl named Kiki.

zh: ：「他說什麼？」
en: What did they say?!

zh: ：「怪物是這麼說：你知道嗎？我們從馬蘭村抓來的女孩，在丹托鎮時被她逃跑了。另一個怪物又說：還好在丹托鎮地下洞穴中發現她，這次她一定跑不掉。」
en: One beast growled: 'You know that girl we snatched from Maran Village? She gave us the slip near Danto Town!' And the other hissed: 'Luckily she was cornered in the underground caves near Danto Town—she won't escape this time!'

zh: ：「後來呢？琪琪有沒有被抓到？」
en: And then what?! Was Kiki captured?!

zh: ：「我哪知道，你自己去看不就得了？」
en: How should I know? Go see for yourself, won't you?

zh: ：「啊・・好無聊！大哥哥你能陪我玩嗎？」
en: Ah... so boring! Mister, will you play with me?

zh: ：「我就說嘛，要相信城主的話，他一定會保護我們，那些逃走的人你看自食惡果了吧。」
en: Didn't I tell you? Have faith in the Lord! He'll protect us—look at those panicked fools who fled, suffering their own folly!

zh: ：「我不相信妖魔會來攻擊。就算真的來，也有城主會保護我們的，所以我要留下來。」
en: I refuse to believe fiends will attack. Even if they do, the Lord will protect us, so I'm staying put!

zh: ：「現在怪物和人和平相處，所以沒啥事情可作真無聊。」
en: Now that humans and monsters live peacefully, there's no excitement at all. Quite dull, really.

zh: ：「幸好當初沒有為了逃難而離開這個地方，有好多人當初匆忙的把房子賣掉離開這裡，現在想回來卻買不起房子了。」
en: Thank heavens I didn't panic and sell my home! So many folk rushed to sell their deeds and flee, and now they can't afford to buy them back.

zh: ：「什麼城主嘛，居然讓妖魔威脅到我們的生活。我要不是沒有錢，早就逃離這個鬼地方了。」
en: Some Lord he is, letting fiends terrorize our daily lives! If I weren't so broke, I would have fled this wretched place long ago.

zh: ：「我們有一個好城主，所以能夠這麼安全的生活著。」
en: We have such a wonderful Lord, keeping us safe and sheltered.

zh: ：「原來當初說妖魔要進攻這裡是謠言呀，這樣子當初逃離這裡的人可要後悔了。」
en: So the talk of fiends attacking was just a silly rumor after all! Those who fled must be kicking themselves.

zh: ：「唉・・・最近生意變差了，好多人都匆匆忙忙的逃離這個地方了。」
en: Sigh... business has plummeted lately. So many patrons fled the city in panic.

zh: ：「最近妖魔一直出現在城外的西方，又在那裡搭建了相當大的帳蓬，該不會是要向這裡發動攻擊吧？」
en: Lately, fiends keep gathering west of town, pitching massive war pavilions. Could they be preparing an assault on our city?

zh: ：「不會吧，我們城主每年付這麼多的保護費給它們，應該不會有這種事吧！」
en: Surely not! Our Lord pays them exorbitant tribute every single year—they wouldn't dare attack!

zh: ：「這可很難說，有誰知道這些妖魔在想些什麼。」
en: Who can say? Nobody knows what foul schemes brew inside a monster's mind.

zh: ：「那太可怕了，我要趕快逃離這個地方！」
en: How horrifying! I must pack my bags and flee at once!

zh: ：「你們怎麼對城主這麼沒有信心呢，要相信城主一定會保護我們的。」
en: Why have you all so little faith in our Lord? Trust that he will protect us!

zh: ：「這可很難說喔・・・・・・」
en: Nothing is certain in these dark times............

zh: ：「客人要來杯酒嗎？」
en: Would you care for a drink, traveler?

zh: ：「不用了，我們就要離開了。」
en: No thank you, we must be on our way.

zh: ：「酒保，那個叫做卡拉哈德的傢伙現在在哪裡？」
en: Barkeeper, where did that Galahad fellow go?

zh: ：「你是說卡拉哈德大爺是嗎？他剛才就已經離開巴魯薩城了。」
en: Master Galahad, you mean? He departed Barusa Castle just moments ago.

zh: ：「他是往那個方向離開的？」
en: Which way did he head?

zh: ：「嗯・・・好像是向著丹托鎮的方向吧！」
en: Mm... looked like he was heading toward Danto Town!

zh: ：「謝了，酒保。」
en: Thanks, barkeep.

zh: ：「客人別生氣，喝一杯消消氣吧？」
en: Don't be cross, traveler! Have a drink on the house to cool off!

zh: ：「歡迎光臨！客人要喝點什麼嗎？」
en: Welcome! Care for a tankard of cold ale, travelers?

zh: ：「哈哈哈・・・這下子這些該死的妖魔應該知道我們的厲害了吧。」
en: Bwahaha! Those blasted fiends should know our true strength by now!

zh: ：「什麼你的厲害，還不是我比較厲害。」
en: Your strength? It was clearly my magic that did the heavy lifting!

zh: ：「哼！好男不和女鬥，我才不和你這個女人計較。」
en: Hmph! A true gentleman doesn't bicker with women—I won't stoop to your level!
Hmph!

zh: ：「多爾卡，下一個地點就是丹托鎮了吧？」
en: Doruka, our next stop is Danto Town, correct?

zh: ：「嗯・・・前面就是丹托鎮了。」
en: Aye... Danto Town lies right ahead.

zh: ：「希望琪琪沒事。」
en: I pray Kiki is safe...

zh: ：「擔心也沒有用，到了就知道了。」
en: Fretting won't change anything. We'll know the truth once we arrive.

zh: ：「氣死我了，居然會有這樣子的城主，他到底是怎麼看這次妖魔作亂的事件。」
en: It boils my blood! How can a Lord be so despicable? What does he even think of this demonic rampage?!

zh: ：「你真是囉唆，像這種人還有什麼好說的，就讓他等著自食惡果吧！」
en: You're wasting your breath! Why bother talking about a wretch like him? Let him reap what he sows!

zh: ：「妳說我囉唆，妳這個吵死人的女人！」
en: Calling me long-winded?! You loud-mouthed shrew!

zh: ：「怎麼樣！」
en: What did you say?!

zh: ：「好了好了，你們兩個停一停吧，敵人已經出現了。」
en: Enough, both of you! Hold your tongues—enemies have appeared!

zh: ：「來的正好，就讓我把這一口悶氣發洩在它們的身上吧！」
en: Perfect timing! Let me vent all this pent-up fury on their hides!

zh: ：「謝謝光臨，希望您不會覺得小店的服務太差了，請多原諒呀。」
en: Thank you for your patronage! Please forgive our humble service, and do come again!

zh: ：「哎呀呀・・・歡迎光臨、歡迎光臨。小店是本地唯一的旅店，雖然設備裝璜不是頂好，但也請各位在此地好好的休息吧。」
en: Bless my soul... welcome, welcome! This is the only inn in town. While our decor may be modest, please rest your weary bones comfortably.

zh: ：「大哥哥，大姐姐加油！要小心喔！」
en: Cheer up, heroes! Fight on and take care!

zh: ：「你們找到琪琪了嗎？她一定長得很漂亮，不然這位哥哥不會急著找她。」
en: Have you found Kiki yet? She must be exceptionally beautiful, or that big brother wouldn't be so desperate to find her!

zh: ：「對呀！妳真聰明。將來他們結婚一定請妳吃喜酒。」
en: Quite right! You're a sharp one. When they wed, we'll surely invite you to the banquet!

zh: ：「不要取笑我了啦！」
en: Stop teasing me, will you?!

zh: ：「這位小妹妹，請問你是否有琪琪的消息？」
en: Little maiden, do you happen to have any news of Kiki?

zh: ：「對不起，沒有唷。」
en: I'm sorry, I haven't heard anything.

zh: ：「聽說最近有一隊妖魔進入了不遠的地下洞穴呢。」
en: Word is a squad of fiends slipped into the underground cavern nearby.

zh: ：「那又怎麼樣，像這種沒有賺頭的生意我凱莉是不會沾的。」
en: What of it? If there's no profit to be made, Kelly doesn't lift a finger.

zh: ：「對不起打擾一下，剛才有人提到妖魔的事情嗎？」
en: Pardon the intrusion, but did someone just mention fiends?

zh: ：「是呀，怎麼了？」
en: Aye, we did. What of it?

zh: ：「我想請問一下這些妖魔是不是有帶著一個女孩子。」
en: Might I ask whether those fiends were dragging a young girl along with them?

zh: ：「嗯・・・這個・・・這個我就不太清楚了唷，這個女孩子長得怎麼樣？」
en: Mm... well now... I wouldn't know the details. What does this girl look like?

zh: ：「是一個年輕的女僧侶，在馬蘭村被妖魔抓走後據說來到此地了。」
en: She's a young cleric, abducted from Maran Village. Whispers say the beasts brought her here.

zh: ：「好呀！這下子有生意做了。小子，我幫你救這個女孩子怎麼樣？價格嘛・・・就算你五十萬就好了。」
en: Well, well! Looks like business has come knocking! Listen up, kid: how about I rescue this girl for you? As for my fee... let's say a modest five hundred thousand gold.

zh: ：「五十萬！妳這是搶人呀。」
en: Five hundred thousand?! That's highway robbery!

zh: ：「妳這小女孩真是沒見過世面，小小的五十萬就把你嚇成這樣。妳要知道人命關天，我是看你們順眼才收這麼便宜的價格。」
en: You sheltered little girl! Fainting over a petty five hundred thousand? Human lives are at stake here! I only gave you such a bargain because I like your faces.

zh: ：「真是謝謝妳呀，這麼說我們還應該感謝妳大發慈悲了。」
en: How generous of you! Shall we get on our knees and thank you for your boundless mercy?!

zh: ：「索菲亞不要和這個女人囉唆了，我們還是趕快去找琪琪的下落吧！」
en: Sophia, don't waste your breath on this mercenary! Let's find Kiki ourselves!

zh: ：「那就算了，以後不要跪著求我幫忙！。」
en: Have it your way! Just don't come crawling back on your knees begging for my help!

zh: ：「歡迎光臨，客人要喝點酒嗎？」
en: Welcome! Would you care for a drink, travelers?

zh: ：「說也奇怪，我們這裡和艾隆鎮不過是一小段路，但是最近卻連一點消息都沒有。」
en: It's quite strange... Iron Town is only a stone's throw away, yet we haven't received a whisper of news from them lately.

zh: ：「你們可要小心了，聽說妖魔們已經派出相當可怕的指揮官來到附近了。」
en: Keep your guard up! Rumors say the demon army dispatched a terrifying commander to this region.

zh: ：「聽說你們打敗了洞穴裡的妖魔，真是了不起呀！」
en: I hear you defeated the monsters lurking in the caves! Truly remarkable!

zh: ：「那裡，這是我們應該做的。」
en: Think nothing of it—we merely did our duty.

zh: ：「我有個女兒想要見見各位英雄，不知各位有沒有時間？」
en: My daughter has been dying to meet the brave heroes. Do you have a moment to spare?

zh: ：「是你啊・・・你不就是那位年輕人嗎？現在又打倒妖魔。」
en: It's you! Aren't you the young warrior who vanquished the demons?
Yes, that was us.

zh: ：「哇！好棒好棒，我可不可以和你們一起去冒險？」
en: Whoa, amazing! Can I come adventuring with your party?!

zh: ：「不可以！你的年紀還小，我不准妳隨便亂跑。」
en: Certainly not! You're far too young—I won't have you wandering off into danger!

zh: ：「人家不管啦・・・我要一起去冒險啦！」
en: I don't care! I want to go adventuring too!

zh: ：「對不起小孩子愛胡鬧，各位不要在意。」
en: Forgive my child's wild imagination, travelers. Don't mind her.

zh: ：「沒關係。」
en: No trouble at all.

zh: ：「西方有一個離本鎮很近的妖魔洞穴，最近常會聽見從裡頭傳出一些聲音，好像是女生的叫聲。」
en: To the west lies a cavern occupied by demons. Lately, strange sounds echo from within—almost like a maiden's cries.

zh: ：「不理你了啦！」
en: Hmph! I'm not talking to you anymore!

zh: ：「我也想去冒險・・・可是我爸爸不准我出遠門。」
en: I want to go adventuring too... but Father won't let me leave town.

zh: ：「帶人家去啦・・・我的英雄・我・我・好崇拜你・帶我去嘛！」
en: Take me with you! My hero... I... I admire you so much! Please take me along!

zh: ：「帶人家去啦！・・・帶人家去啦！」
en: Take me with you! Pretty please, take me with you!

zh: ：「這裏是丹托鎮。歡迎你們來這休息。」
en: This is Danto Town. Welcome, travelers—rest your weary feet here.
Thank you!

zh: ：「各位大哥哥、大姐姐真是勇敢，能夠面對這些妖魔戰鬥到底。」
en: You are all so brave, standing tall against the demon host!

zh: ：「你這小子，沒事不要亂傳話。」
en: You little brat, quit spreading idle rumors!

zh: ：「好了，不要再嚇他了。」
en: There now, stop frightening the lad.

zh: ：「凱莉是個愛錢的女人，只要有錢就可以叫她做任何事，所以・・・・・・」
en: Kelly is obsessed with coin. Wave enough gold and she'll do anything, so............

zh: ：「你說什麼！」
en: What was that you said?!

zh: ：「好了好了，妳就不要嚇這個小男孩了。」
en: Easy now, Kelly, don't terrorize the boy.

zh: ：「是呀！更何況他說的也是真話。」
en: Aye! Beside, the lad speaks the honest truth.

zh: ：「你們倆個有完沒完，放到一起就吵個沒完，你們不覺得很吵嗎？」
en: Will you two ever cease? Every time you're in the same room you squabble endlessly! Don't you realize how noisy you are?!

zh: ：「在我們村子裡有個叫做凱莉的女傭兵，她的身手相當的了不起，唯一的缺點是太愛錢了。」
en: A mercenary named Kelly lives in our town. Her combat skills are formidable, but her only flaw is an unquenchable lust for gold.

zh: ：「丹托鎮隨時歡迎各位來訪。」
en: Danto Town welcomes you at any time.

zh: ：「原來是那個洞穴成為妖魔的巢穴了，怪不得會有這樣的情況。」
en: So that cave became a demonic lair... No wonder all those terrifying things happened.

zh: ：「唉・・・最近村子裡面越來越不安寧了，妖魔經常在夜晚出現在村子裡面，是不是這附近有它們的巢穴？」
en: Sigh... our town grows more restless by the day. Fiends prowl the streets at night—could their nest be nearby?

zh: ：「丹托鎮隨時歡迎各位來訪。」
en: Danto Town welcomes you at any time.

zh: ：「據說在妖魔中有著三大軍團長，分別是魔劍士卡拉哈德、妖劍士卡姬、以及邪劍士凱茵，這三個可以說是魔軍中最可怕的三個人，每一個都有著邪惡的力量。」
en: Legend speaks of the Three Legion Commanders of the Demon Host: Magic Swordsman Galahad, Phantom Swordsman Kaji, and Evil Swordsman Cain. They are the most dread champions in the demon army, each wielding dark, terrifying powers.

zh: ：「前幾天一隊妖魔出現在東北的洞穴附近，看樣子這些妖魔已經占領那個洞穴了。」
en: A squad of fiends appeared near the northeastern cavern days ago. It looks like they've fortified the depths.

zh: ：「唷！你們居然可以活著回來，真是出乎我的意料之外。」
en: Well, well! You managed to come back alive after all! Color me impressed.

zh: ：「哼！妳這個死要錢的女人，這下子我們一毛都不用付給妳了吧！」
en: Hmph! You greedy mercenary! Now we didn't have to pay you a single copper coin!

zh: ：「是我看走了眼沒錯，請問你們願意讓我加入嗎？」
en: I misjudged your mettle, that's certain. Tell me... would you let me join your company?

zh: ：「可是・・・當初妳不是說我們一定要你的幫忙才行嗎？」
en: Oh? Didn't you boast earlier that we couldn't possibly manage without your help?

zh: ：「是我錯了。」
en: I was mistaken.

zh: ：「沒有錢可以付妳唷！」
en: We won't pay you a single penny, you know!

zh: ：「沒問題，一切免費。」
en: No problem at all! Everything is free of charge.

zh: ：「索菲亞別鬧了。{HERO}，你決定吧？」
en: Sophia, stop teasing her. {HERO}, the choice is yours.

zh: ：「嗯・・・妳的名字叫凱莉是嗎？我可以答應讓妳加入我們的行列，但是我希望妳不要誤事了。」
en: Mm... Your name is Kelly, right? You may join our ranks, but I expect you to follow orders and not bungle our missions.

zh: ：「這個你放心好了。」
en: Leave it to me! You won't regret it.

zh: ：「怎麼是你們呀！可不要小看我家裡這些裝飾，它們可都是我用性命換來的。後悔了嗎？這次我可是不打折扣了，不二價五十萬就好了。」
en: Back already? Don't sneer at the trophies decorating my home—I risked life and limb for every single piece. Regretting your decision? My rate is fixed: five hundred thousand gold, not a copper less!

zh: ：「琪琪妳沒事吧？」
en: Kiki! Are you all right?!

zh: ：「嗯・・・我沒事。羅伊，真是謝謝你了，這幾位是・・・・・・」
en: Mm... I'm unharmed. Roy, thank heavens you came! And who are these companions...?

zh: ：「我幫妳介紹一下，這位是{HERO}，是聖騎士團的小隊長。」
en: Allow me to introduce our leader: this is {HERO}, captain in the Holy Knights of Santa Cruz.
A pleasure to meet you.

zh: ：「其他這幾位都是我們的夥伴，我們是在國王陛下命令下到王國各地進行調查。」
en: The rest are our trusted allies. By royal decree of His Majesty, we are investigating the demonic incursions across the continent.

zh: ：「真好，我也想去。」
en: How wonderful! I wish I could journey with you.

zh: ：「我想妳最好還是回家向老伯說一下吧，他為了妳被抓走的事擔心得很呢。」
en: I think you should return home to your father first. He was worried sick when you were captured.

zh: ：「嗯・・・那麼我先回家一趟，我先走一步了。」
en: You're right... I should return home at once. I'll take my leave now!

zh: ：「好的，我們隨後就到。」
en: Safe travels! We will follow shortly.

zh: ：「琪琪！琪琪！」
en: Kiki! Kiki!

zh: ：「等一下，你們有沒有聽到什麼？」
en: Wait... did you hear that?

zh: ：「多爾卡，快聽聽那是什麼聲音。」
en: Doruka, listen closely! What is that sound?

zh: ：「嗯・・・我好像有聽到女孩子的聲音。」
en: Aye... I hear a young woman's voice calling out.

zh: ：「女孩子？那麼說琪琪果然是被抓到這裡來了，她在那裡？」
en: A woman? That means Kiki was indeed dragged into these caverns! Where is she?!

zh: ：「有妖魔，大家快注意！」
en: Demons! Watch your backs, everyone!

zh: ：「快說，你們為什麼要攻擊皇家大聖堂？是為了什麼？」
en: Speak! Why did your forces attack the Royal Cathedral?! What are you after?!

zh: ：「嘿嘿嘿・・・我為什麼要告訴你，這是我魔軍的軍事機密。哈哈哈・・・你們這些凡人是一輩子也想不通的。」
en: Heh heh heh... Why would I tell you? That is an imperial military secret! Hahaha... You mere mortals will never comprehend our grand design!

zh: ：「死到臨頭了還在嘴硬，快說！」
en: You're at death's door and still defying us?! Speak!

zh: ：「哈哈哈・・・大魔王萬歲・・・魔法師萬歲・・・妖魔帝國永遠不滅・・・」
en: Hahaha... Long live the Archdemon! Long live the Sorcerer! The Demon Empire is eternal...

zh: ：「糟了，她死了。這下子什麼消息都問不出來了。」
en: Curses, she's dead. Now we'll learn nothing more from her.

zh: ：「這又不是你的錯，我們總不可能為了這些妖魔浪費自己的法力吧！」
en: It isn't your fault. We can't waste our precious healing magic on filthy fiends!

zh: ：「你們剛才有沒有聽到他說起魔法師這個名字？」
en: Did you hear what she said? She mentioned a 'Sorcerer'.

zh: ：「好像有・・・這代表了什麼意義？」
en: I believe she did... What could that mean?

zh: ：「這・・・我也不確定，只不過是有一點預感，認為這一句話可能代表了什麼我們所不知道的秘密。」
en: I cannot say for certain, but I have a dark premonition that this word hints at a secret we know nothing about.

zh: ：「別想那麼多了，皇家大聖堂還在妖魔的部隊包圍下，我們先趕去再說吧。」
en: Don't brood over it now! The Royal Cathedral is still encircled by demon troops—we must hurry to the rescue!

zh: ：「這裡就是妖魔的營地了，大家提高警覺，不要被發現了。」
en: Here lies the demon encampment. Stay vigilant and don't let them spot us.

zh: ：「哼哼哼・・・別以為你們這樣偷偷過去就可以不被發現。來人呀，把他們抓起來！」
en: Heh heh heh... Did you truly think you could sneak past us unnoticed? Seize them, minions!

zh: ：「糟糕，被發現了！」
en: Dismal luck! We've been spotted!

zh: ：「沒關係，就看看他們有什麼本事能夠抓到我們。」
en: No matter! Let's see if they have the mettle to take us!

zh: ：「原來你們就是最近一直干擾我們魔軍工作的傢伙？來的好，明年的今天就是你們的祭日！」
en: So you're the meddlesome fools who have been disrupting our army's grand work? Welcome to your grave!

zh: ：「你還好吧？」
en: Are you holding up?

zh: ：「大腎者艾魯，您沒事吧？」
en: Grand Sage El, are you unharmed?

zh: ：「嗯・・・我沒事，不過這裡已經被破壞的差不多了，・・・・・・」
en: Mm... I am well, but our sacred cathedral lies in ruins............

zh: ：「幸好，您沒發生事情！」
en: Thank the heavens you are safe, Your Eminence!

zh: ：「大家沒事吧？。」
en: Is everyone all right?

zh: ：「糟糕，寶珠不見了！這・・・這・・・難道說他們的目標原本就是這個？」
en: Disaster! The sacred orb is gone! Could... could this have been their true objective all along?!

zh: ：「什麼寶珠？」
en: What sacred orb?

zh: ：「在這個神殿裡藏有著一顆當初勇者用來封印魔王的寶珠，我受命令守護在這裡也是為了保護這顆寶珠，沒想到・・・・・」
en: Within this sanctuary rested one of the ancient orbs used by the legendary hero to seal the Archdemon. I was charged with guarding this holy ground to protect it... and now............

zh: ：「那現在要怎麼辦？」
en: What should we do now?

zh: ：「嗯・・・既然這樣我也不需要再守護在這個地方了，我願意和你們一起行動。」
en: Mm... With the seal shattered, there is no longer any reason for me to remain behind. I shall join your company.

zh: ：「好了，那我們就先向國王陛下稟告這裡所發生的一切吧。」
en: Understood. Then let us report all that has transpired here to His Majesty at once.

zh: ：「你們這些該死的妖魔，我可不會讓你們輕易的破壞這裡！」
en: Vile fiends! As long as I draw breath, I will never let you defile this sacred ground!

zh: ：「快看！有人被妖魔包圍著。」
en: Look over there! Someone is cornered by the beasts!

zh: ：「那是皇室腎者艾魯，他是負責保護這個地方的安全，我們快去支援他！」
en: That is Royal Sage El! He guards this sanctuary—we must reinforce him immediately!

zh: ：「夥伴們，事不宜遲。我們出動！」
en: Comrades, there is no time to lose! Move out!

zh: ：「要走了呀，歡迎你們有需要的時候再來，本店的大門永遠都是打開的。」
en: Departing already? Come back whenever you need—our doors are always open to you.

zh: ：「請隨便坐呀！本店雖然有些髒髒的，但可是本地最好的休息地點了。最近外面有些不平靜，你們就好好的在這裡休息吧。」
en: Please, have a seat! Our inn may be a bit dusty, but it's the finest lodging in town. The roads outside are treacherous lately, so take your ease here.

zh: ：「你們就是打敗礦場中妖魔的人？」
en: Are you the warriors who purged the demons from our iron mine?

zh: ：「是的，請問您是？」
en: We are. And who might you be, sir?

zh: ：「我的名字叫卡森，是在大陸上到處旅遊的戰士。」
en: The name is Carson—a wandering warrior roaming the continent.

zh: ：「卡森？這麼說你就是大陸上有名的狂戰士卡森。」
en: Carson?! Then you're Carson the Berserker, famed across the realm!
Aye, that's me.

zh: ：「什麼是狂戰士？」
en: What is a berserker?

zh: ：「在人類中有些少部份的人一出生就被狂怒的精靈休里所附身，當他們發怒的時候，就會和精靈的力量發生感應，變身為狂戰士。」
en: Among mankind, a rare few are touched at birth by the fierce spirit Shuri. When their wrath ignites, their souls resonate with the spirit's primal fury, awakening them as berserkers.

zh: ：「然後呢？」
en: And then?

zh: ：「在這些人變身為狂戰士的時候，會變得不怕死，同時還擁有可怕的力量。由於他們有這樣的力量，所以才獲得了狂戰士的名號。不過・・・・・・」
en: In that berserk state, fear of death vanishes, replaced by terrifying physical power. For that sheer might, they are named berserkers. However............
However what?

zh: ：「妳唷，一定沒有好好的聽課，我相信妳的老師歐魯西亞一定曾經說過他們的事情。我只是沒有想到現在還有狂戰士。」
en: Honestly! You must have daydreamed through your lessons! I know Master Orsia taught you of this. I simply never imagined real berserkers still walked the earth.

zh: ：「既然你們就是除去礦場妖魔的人，那麼我相信這個消息你們一定會有興趣。在帕米歐斯平原聽說有妖魔的部隊搗亂，我決定前往看看，你們有沒有興趣一起走？」
en: Since you cleared the mine, I wager this rumor will pique your interest: demon detachments have been stirring up trouble on the Pamius Plains. I'm heading there to investigate—care to join me?
We would be honored!

zh: ：「我們在礦場內挖到了金塊。」
en: We struck gold nuggets inside the mine!

zh: ：「謝謝你們，現在工場和礦場終於開工了，我又有工作可以做了。」
en: Thank you all! The refinery and the mine have finally reopened, and I have honest work again.

zh: ：「那裡，這是我應該做的。」
en: Think nothing of it—we merely did what was right.

zh: ：「礦場和工廠關閉，現在沒有工作要讓我怎麼生活呢？再來一杯酒！」
en: With the mine and foundry shut down, how am I supposed to feed my family?! Barkeep, another drink!

zh: ：「你們若是想要知道原因的話，就到工廠去見見我的老闆吧。」
en: If you want the real story, go to the foundry and ask my boss.

zh: ：「唉・・・最近礦場關閉了，不但沒有工作可以做，就連收入都沒有了，這樣子我要怎麼生活嘛？」
en: Sigh... the mine closed down recently. No work, no pay... how am I supposed to survive?

zh: ：「你就不要抱怨了，又不是只有你沒有工作呀，鎮裡的人那一個不是在礦場和工廠中工作呢。」
en: Quit your bellyaching! You aren't the only one out of work.

zh: ：「可是・・・突然就宣佈礦場和工廠都停工，卻不和我們說原因，實在是有點讓人難以接受。」
en: Sigh... if this keeps up, our village will starve.

zh: ：「唉・・・也許只有你們老闆才知道一切的原因吧。」
en: Welcome, travelers! Rest your weary bones before heading back out.

zh: ：「我們在礦場內挖到了金塊。」
en: Our town thrives on iron ore, but with the mines dark, our lively streets have fallen silent.

zh: ：「原來是怪物在礦場裡，怪不得老闆要關閉礦場，現在沒怪物又可以回去工作了・・真好・・。」
en: The boss refuses to tell anyone why he closed the mine. It's driving everyone mad.

zh: ：「老闆不知為什麼關閉了礦場，現在我們沒有工作要如何過活？」
en: Some folk say beasts broke into the shafts, but who knows if that's the truth?

zh: ：「老闆好像很怕人家知道礦場裡發生什麼事，悶在心裡也不說。希望有人能問老闆為什麼關閉礦場，因為這樣下去，也不是辦法，大家都還要生活。」
en: The boss seems terrified that anyone will discover what happened down in the mine. He keeps it bottled up inside. Someone needs to demand the truth—we have families to feed!

zh: ：「唉・・・最近礦場關閉了，不但沒有工作可以做，就連收入都沒有了，這樣子我要怎麼生活嘛？」
en: Sigh... with the mine shut down, we've lost our livelihood. How are we supposed to get by?

zh: ：「在帕米歐斯平原上以前好像居住著一群吉吉普賽人，聽說他們是相當好客的民族，但不知為什麼遷移到東方。」
en: Gypsy nomads once lived on the Pamius Plains. They were renowned for their warm hospitality, but for some reason they migrated east.

zh: ：「現在礦場關閉，一些礦工無事可作，只好在酒店喝酒，也有人離開村子到外面找新的工作。這都是真的，並不是我信口胡說，每個村民都知道。」
en: With the mine closed, miners drown their sorrows in the tavern, while others left the village to seek new work. It's the honest truth—every soul in town knows it.

zh: ：「大家都在討論為什麼工廠和礦場關閉，有人說因為怪物在礦場裡面，也有人說老闆在礦場發現什麼不讓人知道，每一個人心裡想的都不同，每個人又有一套自己的說法。」
en: Everyone is arguing about why the mine closed. Some say monsters broke in, others say the boss unearthed a dark secret he wants to hide. Everyone has their own theory.

zh: ：「客人真抱歉，因為工廠和礦場關閉，所以每個人都愁容滿面，希望您不要介意。」
en: Pardon our gloom, travelers. With the foundry and mine shuttered, long faces are everywhere. Please pay us no mind.

zh: ：「礦場開工後村子熱絡不少，離開後的礦工又回來工作，酒店生意比以前更好。」
en: Ever since the mine reopened, life has returned to our village! Miners came back to work, and tavern business is booming!

zh: ：「有些村民離開村子到外面去找工作，如今生意變好差。」
en: Villagers left in droves to seek work elsewhere. Business has been miserable.

zh: ：「唉・・・你去問老闆，也許只有他才知道關閉礦場的原因吧。」
en: Sigh... go ask the boss. He's the only one who truly knows why the mine went dark.

zh: ：「客人真抱歉，因為工廠和礦場關閉，所以每個人都愁容滿面，希望您不要介意。」
en: Pardon our gloom, travelers. With the foundry and mine shuttered, long faces are everywhere. Please pay us no mind.

zh: ：「偷偷告訴你們，我先生有挖到金塊喔。」
en: A word in your ear: my husband struck real gold down in the shafts!

zh: ：「不要到帕米歐斯平原，那裡好像常會出現怪物。」
en: Steer clear of the Pamius Plains—monsters are said to haunt the tall grass.

zh: ：「東南方有個帕米歐斯平原，是聖克魯茲大陸陸最大的平原。傳說有隻雙頭怪物被某位英雄殺死，牠的血染紅這塊平原之後，這塊平原從此就不得安寧。一些旅人在晚上走過帕米歐斯平原時，常會聽到一些恐怖的聲音，聲音好像是在述說那隻怪物不滿，時間一久就沒人敢在晚上走過帕米歐斯平原，這塊平原又叫被惡魔所詛咒之平原。」
en: To the southeast lie the Pamius Plains, the vastest grasslands in Santa Cruz. Legend says an ancient hero slew a two-headed fiend there, and its spilled blood cursed the earth forever. Travelers passing through at night hear horrifying shrieks, as if the beast's rancor still lingers. People call it the Cursed Demon Plains.

zh: ：「謝謝你們讓我的先生恢復活力，他這個人只要有工作就沒事了。」
en: Thank you for restoring my husband's spirit! He's always at his best when he has honest work.

zh: ：「唉・・・我先生自從沒有了工作之後，就整天在酒店裡喝悶酒，這樣下去該怎麼辦呀？」
en: Sigh... ever since my husband lost his job, he spends all day drinking gloomily in the tavern. What are we to do?
