zh: ：「唉・・不知礦場老闆幹嘛要關閉礦場，一些人沒工作，只好離開村子到外面去找工作。像我那死鬼現在沒工作，整天都在酒店鬼混，也不會留在家裡陪陪我。」
en: Sigh... who knows why the boss shuttered the mine? With no wages, folks had to leave town. Look at my lazy husband—unemployed, loafing in the tavern all day instead of keeping me company.

zh: ：「沒想到我的礦場裡竟然有金塊，這下我可發了。」
en: To think my mine held real gold veins! I'm going to be rich!

zh: ：「太好了，太好了，這下子我的工廠可以恢復生產了。」
en: Wonderful, truly wonderful! Now my smelting foundry can resume operations at last!

zh: ：「真是謝謝你們了，這個礦場和工廠可以說是我的生命，再次謝謝了。」
en: You have my deepest gratitude! That mine and foundry are my very life. Thank you again and again!

zh: ：「礦場就在離開這裡往西南方的山裡，是個露天的礦場。」
en: The mine is tucked into the mountains southwest of town—an open-pit quarry.

zh: ：「唉・・・該死的妖魔，害我不得不停止礦場和工廠裡的工作。」
en: Blast those cursed fiends! Forcing me to halt all operations at the mine and foundry!

zh: ：「對不起，你剛才有提到妖魔？」
en: Pardon me, did you just mention fiends?

zh: ：「我什麼都沒說，你們有什麼事？」
en: I said no such thing! What do you want?

zh: ：「我們是來自王城的聖騎士團，在國王的命令下到本地來看看發生什麼事了。」
en: We are Holy Knights from the royal capital, investigating strange incidents on His Majesty's orders.

zh: ：「你快說呀，別吞吞吐吐的。」
en: Out with it! Stop beating around the bush!

zh: ：「幾天前礦場中出現了一隻妖魔，它們在礦場中到處行動，我為了怕礦工受到傷害，就宣佈礦場暫停工作幾天，誰知道妖魔的數量越來越多，現在不但礦場停工，就連工場也不得不跟著停工了。」
en: Days ago, a monster appeared in the shafts. It prowled through the tunnels, and fearing for my men's safety, I announced a temporary closure. But then more fiends swarmed in! Now the quarry and the foundry are completely paralyzed!

zh: ：「那你可以和礦工們解釋這一切呀！」
en: Then why didn't you explain that to your miners?!

zh: ：「這你就不明白了，我們這裡是個小地方，這些礦工又沒什麼知識，若是這樣草率的告訴他們，恐怕會造成恐慌的，那以後就沒有人敢進礦場了。」
en: You don't understand! This is a humble village—these miners are superstitious folk. If I told them outright, panic would erupt and no one would ever set foot in the shafts again!

zh: ：「你這種愚民政策不太好吧，現在反而讓那些礦工生活在恐懼中。」
en: Keeping them in the dark was foolish. Now they live in even greater dread!

zh: ：「好吧，那我們就到礦場中幫你把這些妖魔消滅吧，礦場在那裡？」
en: Very well. We will venture into the quarry and exterminate the beasts for you. Where is the mine?

zh: ：「真是謝謝你們了，礦場就在離開這裡往西南方的山裡，是個露天的礦場。」
en: Bless you! The mine lies southwest in the mountains—an open-pit quarry.

zh: ：「這下子礦場裡應該沒有什麼妖魔了。」
en: That should be the last of the beasts in this quarry.
Squeak... squeak... squeak............

zh: ：「這是什麼東西？」
en: What in the world is that?!

zh: ：「這是一種古老的生物，它的原名叫做史萊姆。據說在好久以前就應該消失了才對，沒想到這裡還有一隻。」
en: It's an ancient creature known as a Slime! They were thought extinct centuries ago, yet here is one right before our eyes!
Squeak... squeak... squeak............

zh: ：「不管它是什麼，有哪個人快來把它趕走好嗎？」
en: Whatever it is, can someone please shoo it away?!

zh: ：「看樣子它好像喜歡上你了。」
en: Looks like it's taken quite a liking to you!

zh: ：「別開玩笑了，快點把它趕走！」
en: Stop joking around and get it off me!

zh: ：「它好可愛唷，我們帶著它一起走吧！」
en: It's so adorable! Can we keep it and bring it along?!
What in the world?!

zh: ：「嗯・・・我看・・・我看就叫它史拉米好了，史拉米！史拉米！」
en: Mm... I think... let's name it Slami! Here, Slami! Good Slami!
Squeak... squeak... squeak............

zh: ：「好了，我們走吧。」
en: Alright then, let's keep moving.

zh: ：「這裡就是礦場了，沒有看到妖魔呀？」
en: This is the quarry, but I don't see any fiends around?

zh: ：「噓・・・我好像有聽到什麼了。」
en: Hush... I hear something rustling.

zh: ：「甘達特你聽到什麼了嗎？」
en: Gandat, did you hear something?

zh: ：「嗯・・・但是我不確定這是什麼聲音，我只知道這裡一定有什麼東西。」
en: Aye... but I can't pinpoint the sound. All I know is something lurks nearby.

zh: ：「我也聽到了，看樣子這裡真的有妖魔。」
en: I hear it too. It seems monsters truly nest here.

zh: ：「你們倆個別聽了啦，妖魔已經出現在我們四周了。」
en: Quit listening and draw your steel—they've already surrounded us!

zh: ：「哇！這哪是一兩隻妖魔，簡直就是一整個部隊嘛！」
en: Whoa! This isn't just one or two beasts—it's an entire detachment!

zh: ：「我早就知道了，妳怕了嗎？」
en: I warned you earlier! Getting cold feet?

zh: ：「誰會怕呀！」
en: Who's afraid?! Not me!

zh: ：「以這裡的情況看來，再往前走們可能會碰到更大的挑戰。」
en: Judging by the terrain ahead, our greatest trial still awaits.

zh: ：「前面是什麼地方？」
en: What lies ahead?

zh: ：「前面是一個被人們稱為斷魂橋的地方，那個地方有著相當險惡的地形，若是妖魔在那裡設下埋伏而我們又想要通過，一定會付出相當慘痛的代價。」
en: Ahead lies a treacherous gorge known as the Bridge of Souls. The terrain is perilous—if fiends ambush us there, we'll pay a steep price in blood.
The Bridge of Souls............

zh: ：「怎麼了？」
en: What's the matter?

zh: ：「沒事沒事，我只是想起了一些往事，我們前進吧！」
en: Nothing, nothing... Just memories of old days. Let's press on!

zh: ：「這裡就是帕米歐斯平原了，大家提高警覺了，我覺得這裡有些不對勁。」
en: We've reached the Pamius Plains. Keep your guard up, everyone—something feels amiss.

zh: ：「什麼地方不對？」
en: What feels wrong?

zh: ：「你不覺得這裡太安靜了嗎？」
en: Don't you feel it's far too quiet?

zh: ：「嗯・・・這裡似乎是太安靜了一點，不像是平原該有的感覺。」
en: Aye... it is unnervingly silent for an open plain.

zh: ：「前面有敵人！」
en: Enemies ahead!

zh: ：「夥伴們開戰了。卡森，看你的表現了！」
en: Draw your weapons, comrades! Carson, show us your mettle!

zh: ：「就交給我好了！」
en: Leave them to me!

zh: ：「你們好，我的名字叫耐特，我想要加入你們的行列。」
en: Greetings, travelers. My name is Knight. I wish to join your company.

zh: ：「你這傢伙・・・不是妖魔嗎？」
en: Hold on... aren't you a demon?!

zh: ：「我的確是妖魔沒錯，但是那並不表示我就一定是壞人。我不想要和它們一起破壞這個世界，所以我才想加入你們的行列。」
en: It is true that I am a creature of the dark, but that does not mean my heart is evil. I have no desire to see this world ruined—that is why I wish to fight alongside you.
Squeak... squeak... squeak............

zh: ：「看樣子史拉米贊成呢！」
en: Look, Slami votes in his favor!

zh: ：「好吧！那就讓你加入吧。」
en: Very well! Welcome to our ranks, Knight.

zh: ：「謝謝，前面就是吉普賽人的營地了。」
en: Thank you. The Gypsy Camp lies just ahead.

zh: ：「這裡就是斷魂橋了，你們看看這個地形有多險惡。」
en: Here is the Bridge of Souls. Look how treacherous the chasm is.

zh: ：「哇～好可怕唷！」
en: Whoa... that's terrifying!

zh: ：「等一下，在橋的那一頭是什麼？」
en: Wait! What is that on the far side of the bridge?

zh: ：「讓我看看・・・嗯・・・是一隊妖魔在橋的另一端，看樣子卡森的猜測沒有錯，這裡果然是個伏擊的好地點。」
en: Let me see... A squad of fiends occupies the opposite bank! Carson's instincts were spot-on—this is an ideal spot for an ambush.

zh: ：「糟了，那是蛇髮魔女梅杜莎！」
en: Disaster! It's Medusa the Gorgon!
What?!

zh: ：「你們可以看到在橋的另一端有一個頭上都是蛇的女人，她就是神話中有名的蛇髮魔女梅杜莎。」
en: See that woman across the bridge with writhing vipers for hair? That is the legendary Gorgon Medusa from ancient myth.

zh: ：「就是那個能夠讓被她看到的人變成石像的傢伙嗎？」
en: The one whose gaze turns mortals into stone statues?!

zh: ：「沒錯！就是她。」
en: The very same!

zh: ：「她不是早在神話時代就已被殺死了嗎？」
en: Wasn't she slain back in the age of myth?

zh: ：「對啊！但不知道是誰從地獄中喚醒她。」
en: Aye! Someone must have dredged her foul soul up from the netherworld.

zh: ：「那我們現在該怎麼辦？」
en: What should we do?

zh: ：「雖然她很可怕，但也是有弱點的。她的射程很短，我們只要保持距離就可以了。」
en: Terrifying though she is, she has a weakness: her petrifying gaze has short reach. As long as we keep our distance, we can defeat her.

zh: ：「好！大家注意了，前進！」
en: Right! Form ranks, everyone—advance!

zh: ：「這裡是吉普賽營地。」
en: This is the Gypsy Camp.

zh: ：「呀！果然有陌生人來了。」
en: Ah! Strangers have arrived, just as predicted.

zh: ：「你知道我們會來？」
en: You knew we were coming?

zh: ：「營地裡的老婆婆有交待，這幾天會有陌生人來訪，應該就是你們。」
en: Our camp elder instructed us that travelers would arrive soon. That must be you.

zh: ：「原來如此，老婆婆真是未卜先知，我一定要去拜訪她。」
en: I see! The elder possesses the gift of foresight. I must go speak with her.

zh: ：「這裡是吉普賽營地。」
en: This is the Gypsy Camp.

zh: ：「近來整個大陸彌漫著逼股邪惡之氣，我擔心邪神將要甦醒了。」
en: A suffocating evil miasma drifts across the continent... I fear the dark deity is stirring once more.

zh: ：「我就是吉普賽族的長老，看樣子你們好像在找我？」
en: I am the Elder of the Gypsies. It seems you seek an audience with me?

zh: ：「是的，我們想向您借那份古老的文件。」
en: Indeed, Elder. We wish to inspect the ancient scripture in your keeping.

zh: ：「文件？那份文件・・・文件・・・那份文件早就不見了。」
en: The scripture? That ancient scroll... alas, it vanished long ago.

zh: ：「這是怎麼一回事？」
en: How could that happen?

zh: ：「唉・・・這是件好久以前的事了。」
en: Sigh... it happened many years ago.

zh: ：「數年以前，有一位皇室的魔法師來到我這裡，向我借看那份古老的文件，由於他的身份是那麼的特別，所以我就很大方的借給他看。誰知道・・・誰知道當天晚上他就消失了，還帶走了那份古老的文件。」
en: Years ago, an imperial royal sorcerer visited our camp, requesting to study the ancestral scripture. Because of his esteemed royal station, I graciously allowed him to read it. But who could have guessed... that very night he vanished into the dark, taking the sacred scroll with him!

zh: ：「他的名字是不是叫做席爾福克斯？」
en: Was his name Sil Fox?

zh: ：「都已經是那麼久的事了，我也不太記得了。但是・・・他的名字裡是有個福克斯沒錯。」
en: It was so long ago that my memory fades, but... aye, 'Fox' was indeed part of his name.

zh: ：「果然沒錯！」
en: Just as we suspected!

zh: ：「您還記得那份文件裡說了些什麼嗎？」
en: Do you remember anything recorded within the scroll?

zh: ：「嗯・・・黃色為地、藍色為水、綠色為風、紅色為火、紫色為聖、銀色為邪，集六力於一，則天地動搖、邪神為之覺醒。」
en: Mm... 'Yellow is Earth, Blue is Water, Green is Wind, Red is Fire, Purple is Holy, Silver is Evil. When the six powers unite as one, heaven and earth shall tremble, and the Archdemon shall awaken.'

zh: ：「謝謝你了，老婆婆。」
en: Thank you for sharing this, Elder.

zh: ：「要記得我提醒你們的事，只有牢記這些才能讓你們活得更久。」
en: Heed my warning well: only by keeping these truths in your heart will you survive the trials ahead.

zh: ：「年輕人，你們來了・・・在歷經這麼多的挑戰之後，我要給你們一些建議。」
en: Welcome, brave youths... Having braved so many hardships, I have counsel for your journey.

zh: ：「老婆婆請講。」
en: Please, Elder, we are listening.

zh: ：「在這個世界上，並不是有了武力就能代表一切，你們雖然很強，但是要知道人上有人天外有天的道理。」
en: In this vast realm, raw might cannot conquer everything. Formidable though you are, remember there are always greater mountains beyond the horizon.

zh: ：「是，這我們知道。」
en: We understand, Elder.

zh: ：「有句俗話說：留得青山在，不怕沒柴燒。你們一定要記得，保持最佳狀況才是明智之舉。」
en: As the ancient proverb goes: 'While green hills remain, there is no lack of firewood.' Always preserve your strength—survival is the truest wisdom.

zh: ：「慢走唷，路上的妖魔越來越多了，你們一定要小心唷。」
en: Safe journey! Fiends multiply along the roads—tread with utmost caution.

zh: ：「歡迎光臨，你們一定累了吧，就在這裡好好的休息一下吧。」
en: Welcome, travelers! You must be exhausted—rest your weary limbs here.

zh: ：「傳說聖克魯茲大陸上，有著六顆謎樣的寶珠。」
en: Legend tells of six mysterious sacred orbs scattered across Santa Cruz.

zh: ：「妳要離開了嗎，妳最好不要去巴斯克高地。」
en: Are you departing? You had best avoid the Basque Highlands.

zh: ：「法蘭西斯小姐，妳要離開了嗎？妳最好不要去巴斯克高地，有人發現怪物在高地埋伏，好像在等一些人。」
en: Lady Francis, are you leaving? You had best steer clear of the Basque Highlands—fiends have been spotted lying in ambush, waiting for someone.

zh: ：「這裡是吉普賽營地。」
en: This is the Gypsy Camp.

zh: ：「在吉普賽營地內住者一位箭術很高明的女孩子。」
en: A young maiden with peerless archery skills resides within our camp.

zh: ：「希望魔王復活的傳言不會變真的。」
en: I pray the rumors of the Archdemon's return prove false.

zh: ：「從前在這大陸上留傳下一個古老故事述說一位魔王要破壞世界時，被四名勇者封印在地底，聽說這魔王以後還會復活，希望這不是事實。」
en: An ancient legend tells of an archdemon who sought to destroy the world, sealed beneath the earth by four legendary heroes. Whispers say he will awaken once more... I pray it isn't true.

zh: ：「在東方吉普賽小村莊有位老先生，有什麼問題都可以去問他。」
en: An old scholar lives in the eastern gypsy settlement—you can ask him anything.

zh: ：「在這大陸上，每年都會在聖克魯茲城舉行射箭比賽。」
en: Every year, a grand archery tournament is held in Santa Cruz Castle.

zh: ：「在這大陸上，每年都會在聖克魯茲城舉行射箭比賽，去年拔得頭籌的是一位吉普賽人。」
en: Every year, Santa Cruz hosts a kingdom-wide archery contest. Last year, a gypsy maiden took the grand championship!

zh: ：「呀啊・・你又來了！」
en: Eek! You're back again!
...Is that so bad?

zh: ：「不要和你這個壞人說話。」
en: I'm not talking to a bad guy like you!

zh: ：「呀・呀・我媽媽說過不要和陌生人說話。」
en: Eek! Mother told me never to speak with strangers!

zh: ：「小妹妹我們不是壞人，我是聖克魯茲王國來的聖騎士軍團的小隊長。」
en: Little girl, we aren't bad people! I'm a squad captain in the Holy Knights of Santa Cruz.

zh: ：「真的喔・・聽說都是好人。」
en: Really...? I heard the Holy Knights are noble heroes.

zh: ：「沒錯！小妹妹。」
en: Indeed they are, little one!

zh: ：「還聽說是打倒怪物的正義之士。」
en: And they defeat scary monsters for justice!

zh: ：「一點也沒錯。」
en: Spot on!

zh: ：「又來了，你能不能換新一點的謊話，還想騙我。上次就有一位叫伊芙的人想騙我，都沒成功。」
en: Here you go again! Can't you come up with a newer lie? You can't fool me! Last time, some sneaky thief named Eve tried to trick me too, and she failed completely!
Eve...?

zh: ：「你以為小孩子好騙嗎？我媽媽說大人不能說謊話，說謊話的一定是壞人。」
en: Do you think children are so easily duped? Mother says grown-ups must never lie, and anyone who lies is a bad guy!

zh: ：「小妹妹，不是你想的這樣，不是・・・・」
en: Little one, it isn't like that at all...

zh: ：「不聽！不聽！又想騙人・・・！」
en: La la la! I'm not listening! Liars, all of you!

zh: ：「不要和你這個陌生人說話。」
en: I'm not speaking another word to a stranger like you!

zh: ：「呀！呀！陌生人你是誰，沒見過面。」
en: Eek! A stranger! Who are you? I've never seen your face before.

zh: ：「小妹妹，我是從聖克魯茲城來的聖騎士軍團小隊長{HERO}，我要見你們長老。」
en: Little maiden, I am {HERO}, squad captain in the Holy Knights of Santa Cruz. I seek an audience with your Elder.

zh: ：「你就是那個聲名遠播的聖騎士軍團小隊長{HERO}。」
en: You're THAT {HERO}?! The renowned captain of the Holy Knights?!

zh: ：「哈！哈！小妹妹，原來你知道我是聖騎士軍團的{HERO}。」
en: Haha! So you've heard of me, little one? Yes, I am {HERO} of the Holy Knights.

zh: ：「我哪知道！是你自己說的。」
en: How should I know?! You're the one who just told me!

zh: ：「・・・・・・那麼你們營地裡的老婆婆在那裡？」
en: ............So where might I find the Elder of your camp?

zh: ：「呀・・・我媽媽說不要和陌生人說話，你去問其他人吧。」
en: Eek! Mother told me never to talk to strangers—go ask someone else!

zh: ：「最近從天空上常會發現一些怪物向西方飛去，難道是傳說魔王復活的預兆嗎？」
en: Lately, winged fiends fly westward across the sky in droves... Could this be an omen of the Archdemon's rebirth?

zh: ：「路上很危險要小心，早點回來。」
en: The roads are treacherous—take care and return safely.

zh: ：「法蘭西斯小姐，妳要離開吉普賽的營地？那麼不就沒人保護我們？」
en: Lady Francis, are you leaving the camp? But without you, who will defend us?

zh: ：「北方有個海上貿易鼎盛的國家，叫做華特爾城。」
en: To the north lies Water Castle, a thriving metropolis famous for its bustling maritime trade.

zh: ：「哦・・年輕人我在你身上看到一道光保護著你，並且一直引導你走向光明，現在雖然微弱小，但不久之後就會形成一股強大力量。」
en: Ah, young warrior... I see a radiant aura of light protecting you, guiding your footsteps toward righteousness. Though faint now, it will soon swell into mighty strength.

zh: ：「在數年前我們就是從東方吉普賽人村落，出來尋找新生地。」
en: Years ago, we ventured out from the eastern gypsy village in search of fresh lands.

zh: ：「我們吉普賽人以遊牧為生活，數十年如一日。」
en: We Gypsies have lived as nomads under the open sky for generations.

zh: ：「我們吉普賽人以遊牧為生活，數十年如一日。聽以前長老說過，原本吉普賽人住在帕米歐斯平原，後來因為怪物襲擊村民而遷移到巴斯克高地。」
en: We Gypsies wander the earth as nomads. Our elders tell us we once dwelt on the Pamius Plains, but after demonic incursions, we migrated here to the Basque Highlands.

zh: ：「走到這裡大家也都累了，就由王國第一神射手請大家喝一杯吧。酒保，拿酒來！」
en: We've walked a long road, comrades! Let the Kingdom's Greatest Marksman treat you all to a drink! Barkeep, bring on the ale!

zh: ：「是什麼人在這裡大呼小叫的，真是吵死人了・・・・・・啊！原來是你。」
en: Who is shouting so obnoxiously in here? What an unbearable racket............ Oh! It's YOU.

zh: ：「吉斯，她是誰？」
en: Keith... who is she?
Er... well... you see............

zh: ：「怎麼了，說不出口嗎？要不要我來替你說明一下呀。」
en: Cat got your tongue? Would you prefer I explain it to your friends?

zh: ：「她到底是誰？」
en: Keith, who is this woman?!
Well, the thing is............

zh: ：「我？我就是一年前在射箭比賽上打敗你們這位吉斯大爺的人。」
en: Me? I'm the archer who soundly defeated your great Master Keith in the royal archery tournament a year ago!

zh: ：「妳打敗吉斯？」
en: YOU defeated Keith?!

zh: ：「那有什麼希奇的，有什麼不對？」
en: Is that so surprising? What's wrong with a woman winning?

zh: ：「對對對・・・我是被妳打敗了，那是因為我學藝不精。」
en: Aye, aye... She bested me fair and square. My technique was simply lacking that day.

zh: ：「怎麼了？你們一大群人跑到我們這個小地方來，逃難啦？」
en: What brings such a grand company to our modest camp? Are you fleeing for your lives?

zh: ：「我們是奉國王陛下的命令在王國四處進行調查。」
en: We are conducting an investigation across the realm by decree of His Majesty the King.

zh: ：「我也一起去，怎麼樣？」
en: How exciting! How about I join your company?

zh: ：「多一個人就多一份力，當然好啦。」
en: Another bow means another ally—we'd be delighted to have you!

zh: ：「好，你們等我一下，我先回家向我母親說明一下。」
en: Splendid! Wait here a moment while I inform my mother.

zh: ：「有要緊事嗎？如果沒有事，請不要一直站在這裡。」
en: Do you have urgent business? If not, kindly step aside.

zh: ：「您多保重了，不要忘記有空要再回來看我們唷！」
en: Take good care of yourself, Francis! Don't forget to visit us when you can!

zh: ：「法蘭西斯小姐，妳要離開我們了嗎？」
en: Lady Francis, are you truly leaving us?

zh: ：「是呀，我決定和這幾位一起到大陸的各地看看。」
en: Aye, I've resolved to journey across the realm with these brave knights.

zh: ：「那麼我們該怎麼辦呢？沒有妳的保護我們次是很危險？」
en: What will become of us, then? Won't we be in grave danger without your bow to protect us?

zh: ：「放心好了，你以為我是去玩的呀。我就是為了完全消滅這些妖魔才決定這麼做。再加上我母親還在嘛，她可是個不輸我的女戰士唷！」
en: Fret not! Do you think I'm off on a pleasure stroll? I'm leaving to eradicate these fiends once and for all! Besides, Mother is still here—she's a warrior who could outfight me any day!

zh: ：「那麼您多保重了。」
en: In that case, take great care.

zh: ：「那麼您多保重了。」
en: May the spirits watch over your journey.

zh: ：「妳自己要注意身體，還有・・・不要為了一些小事就生氣喔。」
en: Look after your health, my dear... and remember: don't lose your temper over trivial matters.

zh: ：「唉・・・我這個女兒呀，每天就知道舞刀弄劍的，完全忘了自己是個女孩子似的，真是的・・・・・・」
en: Sigh... that daughter of mine! She spends all day brandishing bows and blades, completely forgetting she's a maiden. Honestly............

zh: ：「母親我要走了。」
en: Mother, the hour has come for me to depart.

zh: ：「妳自己要注意身體，還有・・・不要為了一些小事就生氣喔。」
en: Look after your health, my dear... and remember: don't lose your temper over trivial matters.
Yes, Mother, I remember.
Safe travels, my child.

zh: ：「讓你們久等了，現在就讓我帶你們通過巴斯克高地吧！」
en: Sorry to keep you waiting! Now then, allow me to guide you safely through the Basque Highlands!

zh: ：「哼！雖然我輸了，但是千千萬萬的魔軍將會為我報仇的，你們動手吧！」
en: Hmph! Though I am bested, thousands of my demonic comrades will avenge me! Cut me down and be done with it!
Listen to reason first............

zh: ：「有什麼好說的！」
en: There is nothing left to say!

zh: ：「你知道自己正在做什麼嗎？若是讓魔法師將大魔王洛馬喚醒會發生什麼樣的事你知道嗎？」
en: Do you realize what you are doing?! Do you understand the horrors that will unfold if the Sorcerer awakens Archdemon Loma?!

zh: ：「我不需要知道魔法師要做的事，我只知道是他救了我，我應該為他做事。」
en: I care nothing for the Sorcerer's grand designs! All I know is that he spared my life, and I owe him my sword!

zh: ：「若是真的讓他喚醒了大魔王，那麼整個王國將會再次陷入可怕的地獄中，那時不只是你所討厭的人會糟殃，就連無辜的人民也會一起受害。」
en: If he resurrects the Archdemon, the entire kingdom will be cast into a living hell! Not just the hypocrites you despise, but thousands of innocent folk will perish alongside them!

zh: ：「我希望你想想自己所做的是對是錯，我也不說太多了。凱伊，放他走！」
en: I only ask that you reflect upon what is truly right. I will say no more. Kay, release him!

zh: ：「{HERO}！這太危險了。」
en: {HERO}! That is far too dangerous!

zh: ：「沒關係，放他走吧，也讓他自己好好的想想。」
en: It's fine. Let him go, and give him the chance to reflect.

zh: ：「你會後悔的。」
en: You will regret showing mercy!

zh: ：「你走吧！」
en: Go!

zh: ：「來的好，我等了好久了。」
en: You've walked right into my ambush! I've waited long for this moment!

zh: ：「卡拉哈德！」
en: Galahad!

zh: ：「沒錯，就是我。你們這些傢伙破壞了我們魔軍的不少行動，又殺了不少的夥伴，現在就是我為它們報仇的機會了。」
en: Aye, none other! You meddlesome worms have foiled our operations and slaughtered my brothers in arms. Now comes my retribution!

zh: ：「等一下！什麼為它們報仇，你身為人類怎麼會幫妖魔來殘殺同類呢？」
en: Hold! What talk of retribution is this?! You are a human being—why would you side with monsters to slaughter your own kind?!

zh: ：「人類又怎麼樣？想當初為了一把冰劍，我被你們這些正義之士追殺了好久，不但冰劍被奪，就連性命也差點丟掉了。要不是魔法師救了我，恐怕早就死了。」
en: Human? What did humanity ever give me?! Over a single Ice Sword, you 'knights of justice' hounded me across the continent! You stole my blade and nearly took my life! If the Sorcerer hadn't saved me from the brink of death, I would have rotted in a ditch long ago!

zh: ：「這是不一樣的，你聽我說。」
en: That is different! Hear me out—

zh: ：「少廢話，納命來吧！」
en: Enough useless prattle! Offer up your lives!

zh: ：「你們一直來找我，是不是想和我們一起生活？」
en: You keep visiting me... Do you wish to live among our tribe?

zh: ：「我們是飄泊的吉普賽人，四處流浪為家。雖然我們在這裡定居了，並不表示我們會永遠停留在這裡。」
en: We are roaming Gypsies, making our home wherever the winds blow. Though we've pitched tents here, it does not mean we will linger forever.

zh: ：「在村子北方有個港口被怪物佔領已久，怪物又隨著一股邪惡勢力擴張到村子外，時常會發現一些怪物在村子外活動，有些人因為這緣故離開村子，到西方開拓新生地。」
en: The port north of our village has long been overrun by fiends. Their foul influence spreads toward our borders, with beasts prowling outside camp. Some folk left to pioneer new lands to the west.

zh: ：「長老終於和我們聯絡了。」
en: Our Elder has finally established contact with us!

zh: ：「數年前有不少的商人和旅人從本村通過，現在來村子的人變好少，會不會是在海上發生意外呢？」
en: Years ago, merchants and travelers crossed through our village daily, but now visitors are scarce. Could some tragedy have occurred at sea?

zh: ：「北方港口被怪物佔領，沒有船就不能出海到華特爾城。」
en: Monsters have overrun the northern port. Without ships, nobody can cross the waters to Water Castle.

zh: ：「怎麼辦？通往華特爾城的路上被怪物築起圍牆，沒辦法過去。」
en: What can be done? Monsters built ramparts across the northern highway to Water Castle—there is no passing through.

zh: ：「你們有帶著恢復果嗎？如果沒有要趕快去買。」
en: Do you carry healing fruit? If not, hurry and purchase some.

zh: ：「在海上很容易遭受怪物攻擊，出門前最好買些恢復果才比較安全。」
en: Monsters frequently ambush vessels at sea. You'd best stock up on healing fruit before boarding any ship.

zh: ：「在聖克魯茲大陸東北方有座巴魯庫斯堡，上個月聽說被怪物攻佔。」
en: To the northeast of Santa Cruz lies Barukus Keep. Word reached us that fiends captured it last month.

zh: ：「在往華特爾城的海路上常被怪物攻擊，聽一些遇難逃出來旅人說過，有位手拿如蛇般寶劍的人攻擊他們。」
en: Vessels sailing the route to Water Castle are frequently attacked. Survivors recount being assaulted by a swordsman wielding a serpent-like blade.

zh: ：「呀・・大哥哥，大姐姐，你們回來了。」
en: Ah, the brave heroes have returned!

zh: ：「呀・・有位大哥哥問我到華特爾城要如何走，看樣子他好像在找人。」
en: A strange warrior asked me for directions to Water Castle. It looked as if he was tracking someone.

zh: ：「呀・・真希望有人能趕走村子附近的怪物。」
en: I truly wish someone would drive away the monsters circling our village.

zh: ：「呀呵，在村裡有位喜歡動物的大哥哥好像在酒店。」
en: A kind traveler who adores animals is lodging at the tavern.

zh: ：「村子裡流傳一個古老預言是這樣說：黑暗之氣散佈在世界時，將會出現傳說的勇土對抗他，光明將會再次照耀大地。」
en: An ancient prophecy echoes in our tribe: 'When the shadow of evil blankets the realm, legendary heroes shall arise to contest it, and the sacred light shall illuminate the earth once more.'

zh: ：「有位腎者預言說，過不久華特爾城將會發生一件很嚴重的事情，不知是什麼？」
en: A wise sage foretold that a dire catastrophe would soon strike Water Castle... I wonder what it could be?

zh: ：「有部份的吉普賽人去西方開拓新生地，村子裡也有位長老跟著過去・・。嗯・有好幾年沒回來，聽說開發的不錯，要不是這裡有親人，我老早就想去了。」
en: A contingent of our folk migrated west to cultivate new lands, accompanied by one of our tribe's elders. Word says their colony is flourishing. If not for my family here, I would have joined them long ago.

zh: ：「由於你們的關係，長老終於和我們連絡了。」
en: Thanks to your aid, the Elder has finally sent word to our village!

zh: ：「由長老所說的看來，有人一定想要喚醒大魔王洛馬，那麼世界將再次陷入危機。」
en: Judging by the Elder's words, someone is attempting to awaken Archdemon Loma, threatening to plunge the realm into ruin once more.

zh: ：「由於長老一直沒有和我們連絡，所以現在沒有人知道她在那裡，據說有一位很像長老的人目前在西方的吉普賽民族中。」
en: Because the Elder lost touch with us for so long, none knew her whereabouts. Rumors say a traveler matching her description was spotted among the western nomads.

zh: ：「請問您是吉普賽人的村長嗎？」
en: Pardon me, are you the chieftain of the Gypsies?

zh: ：「我就是吉普賽人的村長。年輕人，你到這裡來有什麼事呀？」
en: I am indeed the chieftain. What brings you to our humble settlement, young warrior?

zh: ：「村長，請問一下你們吉普賽民族是不是有一本古老的歷史文件？」
en: Chieftain, might your tribe possess an ancient historical manuscript?

zh: ：「是的，有什麼問題嗎？」
en: We do. Why do you ask?

zh: ：「能不能借我們看一下？」
en: Could you grant us permission to examine it?

zh: ：「這個・・・恐怕有些困難。這一份文件是由本族的長老所保管的，而她在好幾年前就和族裡的另一群人一起出外流浪了，現在沒有人知道她在那裡。」
en: Alas, that would be difficult. That ancient scripture was entrusted to our tribal Elder, who departed years ago to wander with another clan. No one knows her present whereabouts.

zh: ：「謝謝光臨，若是有需要的話不要忘了再來光臨呀。」
en: Thank you for visiting! Do come again whenever your travels bring you our way.

zh: ：「歡迎光臨，您需要好好的休息是嗎？本店可說是本地最好的旅店，請你們在這裡好好的休息吧！」
en: Welcome, travelers! In need of rest? Our inn is the finest establishment in these parts—take your ease here!

zh: ：「哦哦・・為吃飯・・哦哦・為了生活只好努力工作。」
en: Singing away... to earn my bread... singing away... working hard for a living!

zh: ：「歡迎光臨・・這裡是吉普賽酒店。」
en: Welcome, welcome! This is the Gypsy Tavern.

zh: ：「老伯上次你沒說完，到底發生什麼事？」
en: Sir, last time you left your tale unfinished. What happened next?

zh: ：「好吧，我要說那是很久以前的往事・・在我年輕時曾經喜歡過一名女孩叫瑪內特，她是如此美麗。在我們訂婚前瑪內特生了重病，我本來想在她身邊守候，但就在這時鄰國攻過來，國王命令所有的騎土去保護國家，我只好聽國王命令。在完成任務後，又到鄰國辦一些事情，回來時我很高興去瑪內特她家，本來想講些在鄰國發生的有趣事情，就在走入她家時，覺得一種沉重不安之氣在他們家人身上，原來是瑪內特在我到鄰國時不幸生病死了，臨死前還一直叫著我的名字。我為了忘記這件事情，就離開聖克魯茲城。在路上遇到吉普賽人，就跟著他們到這村莊。」
en: Very well, I will tell you. It is a sorrowful tale of my youth... When I was young, I loved a maiden named Manette. She was radiant beyond words. Before our betrothal, Manette fell gravely ill. I wished to stay by her bedside, but just then, a neighboring kingdom attacked. The King summoned every knight to defend the realm, and duty bound me to march. After the war, I was sent across the border on royal business. When I returned, eager to tell her of my travels, I walked into her home and felt a suffocating, mournful hush. Manette had succumbed to her illness while I was away... calling my name with her final breath. To outrun the grief, I left Santa Cruz behind forever. On the road I met the Gypsies, and I have wandered with them ever since.

zh: ：「下次你們來酒店時，我再繼續說。」
en: When next you visit the tavern, I shall share more of my journey.

zh: ：「歡迎光臨・・先生以前好像沒看見過，是第一次來吧。」
en: Welcome, sir! I don't recall seeing your face before. Is this your first visit?
It is indeed.

zh: ：「不要動・・讓我猜猜看・・嗯・・・從你的裝扮上看起來，像是聖克魯茲城的騎士，我猜的沒有錯吧。」
en: Don't move... let me guess... Mm... By the cut of your armor, you hail from Santa Cruz as a Holy Knight! Am I right?

zh: ：「老伯好眼力。」
en: Sharp eyes, sir.

zh: ：「呵呵・呵・這沒什麼・・呵呵・在我年輕時候，還是一位聖騎士，那時不知有多少少女為我著迷・呵呵・・但・・就在那時候發生了一件事，讓我從此厭惡戰爭，離開聖騎士軍團。」
en: Haha, think nothing of it! In my youth, I was a Holy Knight myself. Back then, maidens swooned over me wherever I went! But then... something happened that made me loathe war forever, and I hung up my sword.

zh: ：「老伯說說看。」
en: What happened, sir?

zh: ：「唉・這是傷心往事・・不想提了。」
en: Sigh... it is a sorrowful tale. I'd rather not speak of it.
Please, sir.

zh: ：「下次你來酒店時，我再說。」
en: Next time you visit the tavern, perhaps I will tell you.

zh: ：「請勿打擾我作生意。」
en: Please do not disrupt my business.

zh: ：「你要找的人不知道在那裡・・・。」
en: Who knows where the person you're looking for went...

zh: ：「喂！酒保，剛才坐在這裡的那個人跑到那裡去了？」
en: Hey, barkeep! Where did the man sitting here just wander off to?

zh: ：「這・・・我也不知道耶。」
en: Er... that I couldn't tell you, friend.

zh: ：「歡迎光臨・・這裡是吉普賽酒店。」
en: Welcome, welcome! This is the Gypsy Tavern.

zh: ：「歡迎光臨・・這裡是吉普賽村莊的酒店，先生要不要喝一杯呀？」
en: Welcome to our tavern! Would you care for a drink, sir?

zh: ：「謝謝，不用了。」
en: Thank you, but no.

zh: ：「我們所賣的酒都是最高級的，先生你真的不要？」
en: Our vintage is the finest in the land—are you certain you won't partake?

zh: ：「真的不用了・・・・・・對了酒保，最近幾天有沒有發生什麼重大事情？」
en: Truly, I'm fine. Tell me, barkeep: has anything significant occurred these past few days?

zh: ：「沒有耶・・・不過有件事情，不知算不算重要？」
en: Nothing comes to mind... Though there is one matter, if you could call it significant.

zh: ：「你說說看也無妨。」
en: Do tell—any news is welcome.

zh: ：「數天前，有一群怪物在村子北方築起一個圍牆，害得村民都不敢過去。」
en: A few days ago, a band of fiends erected a massive barricade north of the village. The villagers are terrified to go anywhere near it.

zh: ：「謝謝你告訴我這麼重要的事情。」
en: Thank you for sharing such crucial information.

zh: ：「不用客氣，這不算什麼。」
en: Think nothing of it—happy to help.

zh: ：「你們終於出現了。」
en: You've finally arrived!

zh: ：「還說呢，還不是你自己到處亂跑。」
en: Look who's talking! You're the one who ran off on your own!

zh: ：「別說那麼多廢話了，村外的北方就是妖魔要塞了。若是我們想要前往王國的另一邊就一定要通過這裡。」
en: Save the idle chatter! The Demon Fortress lies just north of the village. If we wish to reach the other side of the realm, we must cut through it.

zh: ：「我們出發！」
en: Move out!

zh: ：「嗯・・・讓我再考慮一下。」
en: Mm... allow me to consider it further.

zh: ：「咦？你不是艾魯嗎。」
en: Eh? Aren't you El?!

zh: ：「哎呀，是雷蒙呀，真是好久不見了。」
en: Bless my soul, Raymond! It has been ages!
And who might this be...?

zh: ：「這位是雷蒙，也是大陸上數一數二的好手，現在的身份是一個傭兵。」
en: This is Raymond, one of the premier blades on the entire continent. Nowadays he fights as a mercenary.

zh: ：「我可不像凱莉那樣都是為錢而戰，只要我心情好，就是免費也沒有問題。」
en: I'm not like Kelly, fighting solely for gold. If my spirit is moved, I'll gladly fight free of charge.

zh: ：「哼！滿口仁義道德的偽君子。」
en: Hmph! A sanctimonious hypocrite dripping with righteous piety!

zh: ：「這幾位是國王陛下的聖騎士團成員，正是為了國王陛下的命令在全國進行任務，你也來幫忙吧！」
en: These warriors belong to His Majesty's Holy Knights, carrying out vital missions across the realm by royal decree. Lend us your blade!

zh: ：「嗯・・・讓我考慮一下。」
en: Mm... let me think on it.

zh: ：「大家都沒事吧？」
en: Is everyone unharmed?
Aye... I'm unhurt.

zh: ：「好，我們向下一個地點前進。」
en: Good. Onward to our next objective!

zh: ：「等一下！」
en: Wait!

zh: ：「是誰？啊！剛才那隻奇怪的妖魔・・・」
en: Who's there?! Ah! That strange fiend from earlier...

zh: ：「他不是妖魔啦！拜倫師兄，你怎麼會在這裡？」
en: He isn't a fiend! Brother Byron, what in the world brings you here?!

zh: ：「似乎有人將我當成妖魔了。索菲亞，好久不見了。妳還是像以前一樣的頑皮嗎？」
en: It seems someone mistook me for a monster! Sophia, it has been too long. Are you still as incorrigibly mischievous as ever?
Who is he...?

zh: ：「這位是我的師兄拜倫，也是在大法師歐魯西亞手下學習魔法的。前一陣子才開始他的修業旅行。」
en: This is my senior apprentice Byron! He studied magic alongside me under Grand Mage Orsia, and embarked on his journeyman quest a while back.

zh: ：「我是接到師父的信才趕來這裡加入你們，不會有人反對吧？」
en: I received a missive from Master bidding me to join your company. Surely no one objects?

zh: ：「歡迎歡迎。」
en: You are most welcome in our ranks!

zh: ：「那就先謝了。前面就是港口，若是我們想要前往大陸的另一邊，就一定要由妖魔的手中奪回這個港口。」
en: My thanks! The port lies just ahead. If we wish to cross the northern sea, we must wrest the docks from demonic hands.

zh: ：「這裡就是妖魔要塞了，你們看看裡面，大家可要提高警覺了。」
en: Here is the Demon Fortress. Look at their numbers inside—stay sharp, everyone!

zh: ：「這種小場面，我們早就看多了。」
en: Hah! We've faced far worse than this petty rabble.

zh: ：「走，讓我們去教訓它們！」
en: Charge! Let's teach them a lesson!

zh: ：「等一下，大家先看看後面的那一隻妖魔，我總覺得它的樣子有些不太對勁，彷彿它和其他的妖魔不是一夥的。」
en: Wait! Look closely at the demon in the rear ranks. Something seems strange about it... as if it doesn't truly belong with the rest.

zh: ：「別想那麼多了，小心一點就好了。」
en: Don't overthink it now. Just stay on your guard.

zh: ：「沒有時間耽擱了，大家小心行事。」
en: There is no time to hesitate. Move with caution, everyone!

zh: ：「終於打敗她了。」
en: We finally defeated her!

zh: ：「這有什麼稀奇的？」
en: What's the big deal?

zh: ：「這傢伙就是魔軍三大軍團長之一的妖劍士卡姬，她手中的一柄蛇劍可說是相當可怕的武器，我原本還擔心・・・・・・」
en: That was Phantom Swordsman Kaji, one of the Three Legion Commanders of the Demon Host! The Serpent Sword in her hand is a terrifying weapon—I feared for a moment...

zh: ：「別擔心了，她不是已經被我們打敗了。」
en: Worry no more! She lies defeated at our feet.

zh: ：「傳說魔軍有三大軍團長，而且一個比一個要厲害。」
en: Legends say the Demon Host boasts Three Legion Commanders, each more terrifying than the last.

zh: ：「不管怎麼樣，我們都要克服的，不是嗎？」
en: No matter how formidable they are, we must overcome them all, mustn't we?

zh: ：「好，夥伴們上船了！」
en: All hands on deck! Board the ship!

zh: ：「你們就是那些一直妨礙我們行動的傢伙？來的好！」
en: So you are the insolent worms who have been hindering our glorious work? Welcome to your doom!

zh: ：「你們這些妖魔別想要控制大陸！」
en: Foul fiends! You will never conquer this continent!

zh: ：「哈哈哈・・・控制大陸？你別傻了，像這樣的大陸有什麼好控制的。我們的目標是要毀滅所有的文明。」
en: Bwahaha! Conquer this continent? Don't be naive! What is there to conquer in this pathetic dirt? Our sole purpose is the total annihilation of all mortal civilization!
What did you say?!

zh: ：「別和她囉唆，大家上呀！」
en: Don't waste words on this monster! Attack!

zh: ：「哼！這些該死的妖魔居然敢來妨礙我。」
en: Hmph! Cursed beasts, daring to ruin my moment!

zh: ：「不是有句俗話說妨礙別人談情說愛者該下地獄嗎？現在你們可以繼續了。」
en: Isn't there a saying: 'A curse upon anyone who interrupts true lovers'? Well then, you two may resume your romance!

zh: ：「說什麼繼續這・・・好丟人呀！」
en: Resume?! How... how utterly mortifying!

zh: ：「好了好了，索菲亞妳就不要鬧他們了，華特爾城就快要到了。」
en: Now, now, Sophia, cease teasing them. Water Castle is almost in sight.

zh: ：「妳唷，就是愛開別人的玩笑。」
en: You never miss a chance to poke fun at others!

zh: ：「怎麼連師兄你都這樣說我嘛！」
en: Even you, Brother Byron?! Must you gang up on me too?!

zh: ：「好舒服的海風呀！」
en: What a refreshing sea breeze!
Mm... indeed it is.

zh: ：「在這麼舒服的海風吹拂下，讓我都快要忘了自己正身在戰場中。」
en: With such a soothing wind against my face, I almost forgot we were in the midst of war.

zh: ：「對不起打擾你們，我們被敵人包圍了。」
en: Pardon the intrusion on your tender moment, but enemies have surrounded our vessel!

zh: ：「真是煞風景呀！」
en: What a dreadful mood-killer!

zh: ：「沒錯，讓我們教訓它們！」
en: Quite so! Let's send them to the depths!

zh: ：「這裡是華特爾城，是商業和航海重要營運站。」
en: This is Water Castle, the bustling hub of commerce and seafaring.

zh: ：「這裡是華特爾城，位在聖克魯茲大陸兩座大島中的一個島國，是西方到東方必經之地，也是海上貿易轉運站，所以有海上藍寶石之稱。」
en: Welcome to Water Castle! Built upon one of the twin islands off Santa Cruz, this port is the essential crossroads between east and west—the Sapphire of the Sea.

zh: ：「最近在華特爾城內，常出現有人被盜賊竊取金錢的事件發生，但一直抓不到犯案的盜賊，真是讓人很頭大，被竊取的人又不知道是誰偷他們東西。」
en: Lately, purse-snatching has plagued Water Castle, yet the city watch can't catch the elusive thief! The victims don't even realize their gold is missing until it's far too late.

zh: ：「這裡是華特爾城，繁華之都。」
en: This is Water Castle, the glittering capital of the sea.

zh: ：「我們華特爾城有如它的名字一樣，像是一顆未經琢磨的藍寶石，深深吸引來到華特爾的人，你可以看到一些冒險家和商人聚集在本島上，每天有無數的故事正在發生，因為本島有讓人一夜致富的魅力。」
en: Water Castle is true to its name—a dazzling, uncut sapphire that enchants all who visit. Merchants and adventurers flock to our shores, and legendary fortunes are made overnight.

zh: ：「有位旅行多年的商人，說他在酒店被一名女盜賊偷走身上財寶，等發現財寶被偷時盜賊早跑遠了。」
en: A veteran merchant lamented that a nimble female thief lifted his entire pouch of treasures in the tavern. By the time he noticed, she had vanished into thin air.

zh: ：「華特爾城城主聽說年輕時是位勇敢的戰士，打過無數戰爭，被那時的人喻為皇家玫瑰聖騎士。」
en: They say the Lord of Water Castle was a valiant knight in his youth, surviving countless wars under the honored title of Royal Rose Paladin.

zh: ：「北方有個叫多拉肯村的地方，因為有怪物出沒攻擊漁伕，所以沒有船員敢出海。」
en: To the north lies Draken Village. Sea monsters have been slaughtering fishermen, and no crew dares set sail.

zh: ：「西方有個不知什麼年代所建造的神殿，聽我祖父說，在這國家還沒成立以前神殿就已經存在。」
en: To the west lies an ancient sunken shrine of unknown age. Grandfather told me it stood long before our kingdom was ever founded.

zh: ：「華特爾城四周海域，常有些船隻無緣無故消失，有些神秘地方更是怪異到極點，但相反的是，這裡也是熱愛冒險的人大展身手的天堂。」
en: Vessels frequently vanish without a trace in the waters surrounding Water Castle. Certain corners of the sea are dreadfully eerie, yet it remains a paradise for bold adventurers.

zh: ：「在華特爾城附近的海域常出現怪物，如果你要在海域行走，為了萬一最好去教會記錄冒險之書，神是會保護心地聖潔的人。」
en: Horrid beasts roam the waters near Water Castle. If you venture out to sea, be sure to record your deeds at the church—heaven protects the pure of heart.

zh: ：「華特爾城是由一百多年的一位叫華特爾的青年所建立，聽說他是傳說中的四英雄後裔，在這海域上作生意獲得一大筆財富，而他的財富足以建立一國家，所以才有了華特爾城。」
en: Water Castle was founded over a century ago by a visionary youth named Walter, said to be a descendant of the legendary Four Heroes. His maritime trade amassed wealth vast enough to found an entire sovereign realm.

zh: ：「萬一海底神殿裡的寶珠被偷，那麼邪惡的怪物就會被喚醒。」
en: If the sacred orb inside the Sunken Shrine is ever stolen, unspeakable horrors will awaken from the abyss.

zh: ：「數天前，島的四周突然出現一些魔物攻擊航行中的船隻，使得商船不敢開到華特爾城來。」
en: Days ago, monstrous leviathans ambushed merchant ships around the island, preventing any vessels from reaching port.

zh: ：「小時候曾經聽老一輩說過西方海底神殿的的古老傳說故事，從前有一個大魔王在人間作惡，被四名勇士封印在六顆寶珠內，其中的藍寶珠好像就在華特爾城附近的海域之中。」
en: When I was young, the elders recounted the legend of the western Sunken Shrine. Long ago, the Archdemon ravaged mankind until four heroes sealed him away within six sacred orbs. The Blue Orb is said to rest in the waters near Water Castle.

zh: ：「在城內有位不畏懼怪物的船長，要開船到北方多拉肯村，如果你要乘坐就到酒店去。」
en: A fearless sea captain is preparing to sail north to Draken Village. If you seek passage, seek him out in the tavern.

zh: ：「在北方多拉肯村有位村長，說他曾經看過龍，我想可能是騙人的吧。」
en: The village chief of Draken Village claims he once saw a living dragon! Most likely just a fisherman's tall tale, if you ask me.

zh: ：「華特爾城西方有個謎一樣的海域，傳說裡頭有一顆寶珠。」
en: West of Water Castle lies a mysterious stretch of ocean, where legend says a sacred orb lies hidden.

zh: ：「唉・・・多年守護的寶珠沒有想到就在我手中被偷，唉・・・・・・」
en: Alas... the sacred orb I guarded for decades was stolen right under my watch! What a wretched failure I am............

zh: ：「城主，我們在神殿裡看到一個被破壞的祭壇，不知道上面原本是放著什麼？」
en: My Lord! We discovered a shattered altar within the Sunken Shrine, but what originally rested upon it?

zh: ：「祭壇？糟糕了，這麼說存放在神殿裡的藍寶珠已經被奪走了！」
en: An altar?! Disaster! That means the Blue Orb sealed within the shrine has already been plundered!

zh: ：「又是寶珠，為什麼這些妖魔的速度總是比我們快一步？」
en: Another sacred orb! Why are these demonic beasts always one step ahead of us?!

zh: ：「現在已經沒有時間懊惱這些了。城主，有沒有船可以通往大陸的另一邊？我們不能在這裡拖下去了。」
en: There is no time to lament our misfortune now. My Lord, is there a ship that can carry us across the northern sea? We cannot linger here any longer.

zh: ：「城裡的一名船長據說不在乎海上的危險，想要開航到大陸的另一邊去，我想你們可以搭他的船吧！」
en: A sea captain in town boasts he fears no monsters and plans to sail north. Perhaps you can secure passage on his vessel.

zh: ：「謝了，夥伴們快走吧。」
en: Our thanks! Move out, comrades!

zh: ：「歡迎光臨，本城可以說是海上的天堂，不知道各位來本地有什麼事呀？」
en: Welcome! Our city is a paradise of the sea. What business brings you to Water Castle?

zh: ：「城主您好，我是皇室腎者艾魯，這幾位是國王陛下的聖騎士團成員，我們準備要到大陸的另一邊。」
en: Greetings, My Lord. I am Royal Sage El, and these warriors are Holy Knights dispatched by His Majesty. We seek passage to the northern lands.

zh: ：「嗯・・・這可有些麻煩了，最近海上妖魔出沒相當的頻繁，已經沒有船隻敢在海上通行了。」
en: Mm... that presents quite a dilemma. Lately, aquatic fiends infest the waters, and no captain dares unfurl his sails.

zh: ：「這就糟了。」
en: That is ill news indeed.

zh: ：「城主！城主！不好了！」
en: My Lord! My Lord! Terrible news!

zh: ：「什麼事情這麼慌張，沒有看到我這裡有客人在嗎？」
en: What is the meaning of this frantic commotion?! Can you not see I have honored guests?

zh: ：「剛才傳來一個消息，一群妖魔進入海底神殿了。」
en: Dispatches just arrived: a host of fiends has breached the underwater Sunken Shrine!
Disaster!

zh: ：「城主，請問這個神殿在什麼地方，若是我們可以幫得上忙的話，我們願意前往神殿看看。」
en: My Lord, where is this shrine situated? If our blades can be of service, we will investigate at once.

zh: ：「那真是太好了，神殿就在西方的海裡，傳說勇者曾經到過那裡。」
en: Splendid! The Sunken Shrine lies in the western sea. Legend says the ancient hero once visited that sacred ground.

zh: ：「神殿就在西方的海中，但是不要怕沒有空氣，只要你們跳下去就會發現裡面有足夠的空氣。」
en: The shrine rests beneath the western waves, but fear not: dive in, and you will find enchanted air within the submerged halls.

zh: ：「我們出發。」
en: Move out!

zh: ：「要離開了嗎？本店有這麼好的風景可是難得的，若需要記得再來。」
en: Departing already? Such breathtaking ocean vistas are rare in this world. Come again whenever you seek rest.

zh: ：「來唷來唷！你看本店的風景有多好，在這裡休息一定可以獲得相當不錯的效果。」
en: Step right up! Behold our glorious sea view—a night here will wash away all your travel fatigue.

zh: ：「哎呀，真是對不起。」
en: Oh! My deepest apologies!

zh: ：「沒關係，沒撞傷妳吧？」
en: No harm done. Are you unhurt, miss?

zh: ：「我沒事，看樣子你也有沒事吧，那麼我先走了。」
en: I'm fine, and it looks like you're unharmed as well. I'll be on my way!

zh: ：「等一下，妳以為你能夠騙過我眼睛嗎？把錢包拿出來！
en: Hold right there, girl! Did you truly think you could fool my eyes? Hand over the coin pouch!

zh: ：「咦！我的錢包不見了。」
en: What?! My pouch is gone!

zh: ：「這位小姐在剛才撞你的時候就乘機扒走了你的錢包。但是這種小技倆可瞞不過我甘達特的眼睛。」
en: This young lady bumped into you on purpose to lift your coin pouch. But such amateur sleight-of-hand could never slip past Gandat's eyes!

zh: ：「你就是甘達特？」
en: YOU... you're Gandat the Chivalrous Thief?!

zh: ：「沒錯，我就是甘達特！」
en: Aye, none other! Gandat himself!

zh: ：「我可以把錢包還給你們，但是・・・我有個條件。」
en: I... I'll return the pouch! But... on one condition!

zh: ：「什麼條件？」
en: And what might that condition be?

zh: ：「讓我跟著你們一起走。」
en: Let me journey with your company!
What?!

zh: ：「我一向最崇拜你了，若是能夠跟著你們一起走的話，我相信我的技術一定會不斷進步的。」
en: I've admired you forever, Master Gandat! If I can travel with your party, I know my thieving skills will improve tenfold!

zh: ：「{HERO}，這要怎麼辦？」
en: {HERO}, what should we do?

zh: ：「答應她吧，人家可是你的崇拜者呢。」
en: Accept her request! After all, she is your devoted admirer.
Very well, welcome aboard!

zh: ：「萬歲！萬歲！」
en: Hooray! Hooray!

zh: ：「客人歡迎光臨，你要點些什麼酒喝？」
en: Welcome, travelers! What kind of vintage would you like today?

zh: ：「不用了，謝謝。」
en: None for us, thank you.

zh: ：「聽說海底神殿寶珠被偷，那是很不得了事情。」
en: I heard the sacred orb in the Sunken Shrine was stolen... That spells utter catastrophe.

zh: ：「最近生意越來越不好・・・唉・・・來華特爾城的人，比以往少了很多，再這樣下去，我們要如何過活？」
en: Business has plummeted lately... Sigh... Far fewer travelers visit Water Castle than in past years. If this keeps up, how are we to make a living?

zh: ：「有少數客人回來，生意慢慢恢復正常，不過華特爾城附近要是少一些怪物，可能生意會更好。」
en: A few patrons have returned, and trade is slowly recovering. But if the sea monsters cleared out, business would be so much better.

zh: ：「聽說船就快要開航了，若是你們要搭那艘船的話，最好快一點。」
en: I hear the ship is setting sail shortly! If you intend to board, you'd best hurry.

zh: ：「很少有客人來，沒什麼事作可真無聊。」
en: So few visitors lately... It's dreadful having nothing to do.

zh: ：「呵呵・・要出海了。」
en: Haha... setting sail at last!

zh: ：「哈哈・・要出海你自己去。」
en: Hah! If you want to brave the sea, go right ahead by yourself!

zh: ：「請問有沒有人，能讓我們乘坐他的船到多拉肯村？」
en: Pardon me, is there anyone willing to grant us passage to Draken Village?

zh: ：「哈哈・・・你不知道嗎？怪物在海上攻擊人，沒有一個船員膽子那麼大，敢開船出去，要去你自己去。」
en: Haha! Don't you know? Fiends are ambushing ships on the open sea! Not a single sailor has the courage to steer a vessel out of port. If you want to go, swim there yourself!

zh: ：「嗯・・・要出航了，我不能再喝酒了。」
en: Mm... we're about to set sail, so I mustn't touch another drop of rum.

zh: ：「咕嚕・・・我要喝酒・・咕嚕・・・酒・酒・・咕嚕。」
en: *Gulp*... More rum for me... *Gulp*... Drink up... *Gulp*...

zh: ：「終於有人敢出海了，我又有工作了。」
en: Someone finally has the courage to sail! I have honest work again!

zh: ：「怪物在外海，沒人敢開船出去只好在酒店喝酒・咕嚕・・又沒工作・咕嚕・」
en: Monsters prowl the open sea—no captain dares sail, so we loaf in the tavern. *Gulp*... Unemployed again... *Gulp*...

zh: ：「船長的心情好很多了，看樣子很快就會出海了。」
en: The Captain's spirits have improved immensely. It looks like we'll set sail soon.

zh: ：「這幾天船長為了不能出海，埋怨東埋怨西的。」
en: These past few days the Captain did nothing but grumble because we were stranded in port.

zh: ：「工作了。」
en: Back to work, lads!
Anchors aweigh!

zh: ：「呵呵・・走了。」
en: Heh heh... time to sail!
Wait for me...!

zh: ：「快點上船，船要開了・・・。」
en: Hurry aboard! The ship is about to cast off...!

zh: ：「趕快準備一下，我們要出航了。」
en: Look lively, crew! We're putting to sea!

zh: ：「唉・・不能出海。」
en: Sigh... stranded in port.

zh: ：「唉・・・什麼妖魔嘛，讓我這個有名的船長無法進行我的航程，真是氣死人了。」
en: Blast those cursed sea fiends! Stranding a captain of my renown in port—it infuriates me to no end!

zh: ：「船長您別生氣了，又不是只有我們不能出發呀。」
en: Calm yourself, Captain! We aren't the only crew stuck in harbor.

zh: ：「華特爾城是商業繁華之都。」
en: Water Castle is a bustling capital of maritime trade.

zh: ：「最近城裡接連著發生了幾件竊案，沒有人知道是什麼人幹的。」
en: Several brazen robberies occurred in town recently, yet no one knows who pulled them off.

zh: ：「好不容易將妖魔打敗了，大家快看看這裡有沒有受到什麼破壞？」
en: We finally defeated the fiends! Quickly, check if the sanctuary suffered any damage!

zh: ：「我這邊沒有。」
en: Nothing damaged on my end.

zh: ：「{HERO}！你過來看看。」
en: {HERO}! Come take a look at this!

zh: ：「這是怎麼一回事？怎麼這裡會變成這個樣子？」
en: What in the world happened here? Why is the altar in ruins?

zh: ：「我有一種不好的預感・・・・・・」
en: I have a terrible foreboding............

zh: ：「我們回去向城主報告這裡所發生的事，也許能夠得到答案。」
en: Let us return to the Lord of Water Castle and report our findings. He may have answers.

zh: ：「這裡就是海底神殿了，看起來水很深的樣子・・・・・・」
en: Here lies the Sunken Shrine... The depths look dreadfully dark............

zh: ：「別擔心，裡面是有空氣的。」
en: Fear not—there is breathable air within the submerged halls.

zh: ：「好，我們進去吧！」
en: Right! Let us head inside!

zh: ：「唷・・・原來你們的身手這麼了不起，各位是那裡來的？」
en: Well now! Your combat skills are truly magnificent! Where do you fine folk hail from?

zh: ：「我們是聖騎士團的成員。」
en: We are Holy Knights of Santa Cruz.

zh: ：「那難怪了，真是謝謝各位了。前面就是多拉肯村，祝你們旅程愉快。」
en: That explains everything! You have my heartfelt thanks. Draken Village lies just ahead—may fortune favor your voyage!

zh: ：「你們也要前往多拉肯村？那就搭我的船一起走吧！」
en: You seek passage to Draken Village as well? Then come aboard my ship!
Thank you, Captain.

zh: ：「這一路上可能會遇到很多妖魔，大家自己小心了。」
en: We may face heavy fiendish resistance along the voyage—keep your guard up!

zh: ：「船長船長！」
en: Captain! Captain!

zh: ：「怎麼了，什麼事大驚小怪的？」
en: What is it? Why all the frantic shouting?

zh: ：「前方有一群妖魔在航路的正中央。」
en: A swarm of aquatic fiends blocks the navigation channel directly ahead!

zh: ：「糟了，沒想到真的碰上了。」
en: Disaster! To think we'd truly encounter them!

zh: ：「船長，這種事就交給我們吧！」
en: Leave this to us, Captain!

zh: ：「妖魔的威脅越來越厲害了，你們可要多多保重。」
en: The demonic menace grows more perilous by the day. Take good care of yourselves.

zh: ：「娜塔夏，妳沒事吧？」
en: Natasha, are you unharmed?

zh: ：「嗯・・・我沒有事，但是龍穴裡的最後幾隻龍全部被妖魔殺死了。」
en: Mm... I am uninjured, but the last surviving dragons inside the Dragon Den have all been slaughtered by the fiends.

zh: ：「那真是太可惜了，不過・・・妳沒有事就好了。」
en: What a tragic loss... But what matters most is that you are safe.

zh: ：「謝謝你的關心，我決定再加入聖騎士團盡我的一份力。」
en: Thank you for your concern. I have resolved to rejoin the Holy Knights and dedicate my strength to our cause.

zh: ：「可是・・・你不是曾經為了那件事才離開的嗎？」
en: Yet... didn't you leave our ranks years ago because of that incident?

zh: ：「那已經是很久以前的事了。而且現在正是他們需要我這一份力量的時候，我不能為了自己的不愉快而不盡這一份力。」
en: That happened long ago. Right now our homeland needs every ounce of strength we can muster—I cannot let old grievances hold me back.

zh: ：「那真是難為妳了。對了，最近在村子裡的酒店來了一名精靈，她似乎知道些什麼，你們可以去看看。」
en: You are truly noble, Natasha. By the way, an elven traveler arrived at the village tavern recently. She seems to know ancient secrets—you should go speak with her.

zh: ：「我們走了，謝謝你多年的照顧。」
en: We are departing. Thank you for looking after me all these years.

zh: ：「妳自己要多保重。」
en: Look after your health, my dear.

zh: ：「龍穴就在村外的東北方，經過一塊平原就可以到了。」
en: The Dragon Den lies northeast of the village, just beyond the highland plateau.

zh: ：「我曾經在龍穴看到過龍。雖然一般人認為龍已經不存在了，但原本在龍穴中還有幾隻龍生活著。自從妖魔出現之後，這些龍也就消失了。」
en: I once saw a living dragon inside the Dragon Den. Folk believe dragons are extinct, but a small clutch lived quietly within the cavern. Ever since the demons appeared, they vanished.

zh: ：「您是說妖魔？」
en: You mean demons breached the den?!

zh: ：「是的・・・為了這件事，村裡的腎者娜塔夏也前往龍穴，希望能夠挽救這一切，但是連她也一去不回了。」
en: Aye... Sage Natasha ventured into the Dragon Den hoping to save them, but she hasn't returned since.

zh: ：「我這一生中最值得紀念的，就是我曾經在龍穴看到過龍。不過・・・現在已經沒有龍的蹤跡了。」
en: The proudest memory of my life was gazing upon a living dragon in the cavern... Alas, no dragons walk these mountains anymore.

zh: ：「真是招待不週呀，你們不會覺得本店的服務不好吧？若是有需要請再來光臨。」
en: Pardon our modest hospitality! We hope our service met your expectations. Come again whenever you need rest.

zh: ：「抱歉呀・・・本地所有的建築物都建在山裡面，所以會有些潮濕，但是請各位好好的休息。」
en: Forgive the dampness... All the dwellings here are carved right into the mountain rock, but please make yourselves at home.

zh: ：「太好了，我終於找到你們了。」
en: Thank the heavens, I finally found you!
And you are...?

zh: ：「我叫蕾娜，是一名生活在巴魯庫斯堡附近的精靈，但是妖魔在幾天前突然攻擊巴魯庫斯堡，殺光了堡內所有的人。我聽你們一行已經到了這附近，所以就來找各位，希望你們能夠幫忙。」
en: My name is Lena. I am an elf dwelling near Barukus Keep. A few days ago, demonic legions assaulted the keep and butchered everyone inside! Hearing your party was in the area, I rushed here hoping you could aid us.

zh: ：「我們能夠幫什麼忙嗎？」
en: What can we do to help?

zh: ：「我聽到妖魔的帶隊者說過，你們一行人曾經阻止過它們好幾次的行動，照這樣說你們應該有不錯的實力才對。」
en: I overheard the demon commander say your company had foiled their schemes time and again. If that's true, your combat prowess must be formidable.

zh: ：「等一下，妳說妖魔中有一名帶隊的？這怎麼可能，魔軍中應該只有我們三名軍團長才對。現在卡姬、凱茵都已經死了，我又在這裡，那麼還有誰可以指揮？」
en: Hold on! You say a commander led the assault? Impossible! There were only supposed to be the Three Legion Commanders in the demon army. Kaji and Cain are slain, and I am here—who could possibly be commanding them?!

zh: ：「不要想那麼多了，當務之急我們應該立刻前往巴魯庫斯堡。」
en: There is no time to ponder mysteries now. Our urgent priority is to march on Barukus Keep!

zh: ：「老闆現在不喜歡像你們這樣的勇士，所以最好快走。」
en: The shopkeeper despises so-called heroes like you, so you had best move along.

zh: ：「位在東南方巴魯庫斯堡被妖魔佔聚，聽說村民被殺光。」
en: Barukus Keep to the southeast was seized by fiends. Whispers say all the folk inside were slaughtered.

zh: ：「從本鎮向南走，過了被妖魔佔聚巴魯庫斯堡，再向南走你會看到安遜城，傳說很久以前，這地方村民祖先是古代人。」
en: Head south past Barukus Keep, and further south you will reach Anson City. Legend says the villagers there descend from the Ancients.

zh: ：「有位叫娜塔夏的女腎者，到東北方調查龍穴，一直沒回來，真耽心她的安全。」
en: A female sage named Natasha ventured northeast to investigate the Dragon Den and hasn't returned. I fear for her safety.

zh: ：「老闆現在不喜歡像你們這樣的勇士，所以最好快走。」
en: The shopkeeper despises so-called heroes like you, so you had best move along.

zh: ：「巴魯庫斯堡數天前好像被妖魔攻擊，村民在這次死的死，逃的逃，只有少部份幸運的人逃走。」
en: Barukus Keep was ambushed by fiends days ago. The villagers were butchered or scattered—only a lucky few escaped with their lives.

zh: ：「村裡有位精靈在找尋一個叫{HERO}的人，好像有很重要的事情。」
en: An elf in the village has been searching for someone named {HERO}. It seems dreadfully important.

zh: ：「村長總是說他看過龍，所以龍應該還存在吧！」
en: The village chief swears he saw living dragons, so surely dragons must still exist!

zh: ：「老闆現在不喜歡像你們這樣的勇士，所以最好快走。」
en: The shopkeeper despises so-called heroes like you, so you had best move along.

zh: ：「龍穴的龍被殺光，好可怕啊！」
en: All the dragons in the Dragon Den were slaughtered! How terrifying!

zh: ：「聽村長說過，東北方的龍穴裡好像有傳說中的龍，但是數量並不多。」
en: The chief says legendary dragons lived in the northeastern Dragon Den, though very few in number.

zh: ：「要坐船嗎？」
en: Do you seek passage aboard my boat?

zh: ：「只要你們一上船，我立刻就會為各位服務。」
en: The moment you step aboard, I will gladly ferry you across.

zh: ：「啊！是你們呀。如果你們需要坐船儘管說，我非常樂意為各位服務。」
en: Ah, it's you! Whenever you need the boat, just say the word—I'm delighted to serve you.

zh: ：「你們給我走，本店不歡迎你們這些自稱勇者的人！」
en: Get out! My establishment does not welcome self-proclaimed 'heroes' like you!

zh: ：「老伯您誤會了，我們是・・・」
en: Sir, you misunderstand us! We are—

zh: ：「少囉嗦！給我滾！」
en: Save your breath! Get out of my sight!

zh: ：「怪物殺的龍只是一小部份，殺的最多的還不是你們這些自稱勇者的人，每個人都想得到屠龍勇士名號。你看現在龍都滅亡了吧！」
en: Monsters only killed a tiny fraction of dragons—the ones who slaughtered the most were you hypocrites chasing 'Dragon Slayer' glory! Look around you—now the dragons are extinct!

zh: ：「以前有不少勇士來本鎮，只為了得到屠龍勇士名號而來，現在你要看隻龍都很難，還想當什麼屠龍勇士。」
en: Countless warriors came here in past years just to chase the dragon-slayer title. Nowadays you can't even spot a single dragon—what dragon slayers?!

zh: ：「客人真抱歉，老闆規定不能讓自稱勇者的人進來。」
en: Pardon us, travelers. The owner strictly forbids self-proclaimed heroes inside.

zh: ：「沒有想到龍就這樣的滅亡了，真是一件可惜的事呀！」
en: To think dragons perished just like that... What a sorrowful tragedy.

zh: ：「若是你們對龍的消息有興趣的話，應該到村長家裡去問他。」
en: If you seek news of the dragons, you should inquire with the village chief.

zh: ：「本地在數百年前曾經是個有名的地方，那時候許多有名的劍士為了獲得屠龍勇士的名號來到本地，但是隨著龍的消失，這裡也就慢慢的荒蕪了。」
en: Centuries ago, this settlement was renowned across the continent. Champions traveled from afar to seek dragon-slayer renown, but as dragons vanished, the town gradually withered.

zh: ：「龍，這東西還存在嗎？」
en: Do dragons truly still exist?

zh: ：「我是不知道，但是村長總是說他看過龍，所以・・・也許還有龍吧！」
en: I couldn't say, but our chief insists he saw them with his own eyes... so perhaps a few still survive.

zh: ：「你們是什麼人？怎麼擅自闖進別人的家裡？」
en: Who are you to barge into my home unannounced?!

zh: ：「對不起，我們馬上離開。」
en: Our apologies, we will depart at once.

zh: ：「等一下！我總覺得你看起來很眼熟，讓我想想・・・・・・・・・・・・・・・・・・・・・・・・・・・・・・・・・・・・・・・・・・・・・・・・・・・・對了！你就是那個當年打敗我的武鬥家，那時我再找你挑戰你怎麼沒有來？」
en: Hold right there! You look terribly familiar... Let me think............ By the gods! You're that martial artist who defeated me years ago! Why didn't you show up for our rematch?!
Well, you see............

zh: ：「現在你自投羅網來到我的地方，就是給我一個機會。來吧，我們分個勝負！」
en: Now that you've walked right into my turf, you've handed me my chance! Come on, let's settle this right now!

zh: ：「等一下，我現在有更重要的任務，所以我不能接受妳的挑戰。等到我的任務完成後，一定會回來接受妳的挑戰。」
en: Wait! I am bound to a vital quest right now and cannot accept your challenge. Once my mission is accomplished, I swear I will return and face you.

zh: ：「那麼我要和你一起走，免得又讓你乘機跑了。」
en: Then I'm coming along with you, so you don't slip away again!

zh: ：「現在可以繼續我們的話題了，到底會是什麼原因使她離開聖騎士團呢？」
en: Now then, back to our discussion: what could have caused her to leave the Holy Knights?

zh: ：「若是能夠見到她的話，一定能夠知道事情的原因的。」
en: If we can meet her in person, we will surely learn the truth.

zh: ：「我實在不相信師父會做這樣的事。」
en: I simply cannot believe Master would commit such deeds.

zh: ：「等知道原因再說吧！」
en: Let us go find her and ask her ourselves.

zh: ：「通過這個平原就可以到達龍穴了。對了！這個叫娜塔夏的是個怎麼樣的人，艾魯你應該聽過吧！」
en: What a terrible sight... Even the sacred dragon cavern has been desecrated by beasts.

zh: ：「嗯・・・如果我沒有記錯的話，娜塔夏曾經是王國聖騎士團的一員。」
en: Let's hurry inside!

zh: ：「什麼！為什麼聖騎士團的記錄裡沒有看過她的名字？」
en: To think that someone so renowned as a sage would turn her back on the Holy Knights.

zh: ：「這我就不清楚了，我只知道當初不知道為了什麼事，她曾經和大法師歐魯西亞吵了一架，雙方爭執了相當久，最後她就退出聖騎士團了。」
en: Could there have been some profound misunderstanding?

zh: ：「到底是什麼原因呢？」
en: What could the true reason be?

zh: ：「先不要想那些了，前面有敵人出現了！」
en: Save your pondering for later—enemies have appeared ahead!

zh: ：「娜塔夏，妳沒事吧！」
en: Natasha, are you all right?!

zh: ：「嗯・・・那些該死的妖魔居然殘殺這些毫無抵抗能力的龍。」
en: Mm... Those wretched fiends slaughtered these defenseless dragons in cold blood!

zh: ：「哈哈哈・・・這些該死的龍居然想要守護寶珠，個個都該死！只要我們魔軍再獲得另外兩個封印的寶珠，大魔王就可以由沉睡中甦醒，世界將再次陷入毀滅之中。」
en: Bwahaha! These useless lizards dared protect the sacred orb—they deserved to die! Once our army secures the remaining two sealed orbs, the Archdemon will awaken from his slumber, and the world will plunge into ruin!

zh: ：「凱茵！這是真的嗎？」
en: Cain! Is this true?!

zh: ：「卡拉哈德，你這個背叛者，反正你也只是魔法師手下的一顆棋子罷了，哈哈哈・・・末日就要來臨了，你也逃不過這一切的毀滅・・・・・・・・・・」
en: Galahad, you traitor! You were nothing more than the Sorcerer's disposable pawn! Hahaha... Doomsday is at hand, and you will not escape the coming destruction............

zh: ：「{HERO}，現在我知道我錯了，我願意加入你們阻止這一切！」
en: {HERO}, now I know how blind I was! I beg of you: let me join your company and stop this madness!

zh: ：「我也願意放下以前的一切不愉快，協助你們打倒邪惡的魔法師。」
en: I too will set aside past grievances and help you vanquish the wicked Sorcerer.

zh: ：「你們這些可惡的妖魔，居然殺了這麼多的龍，我可饒不過你們！」
en: Vile fiends! Slaughtering so many noble dragons—I will never forgive you!

zh: ：「說什麼大話，接招！」
en: Empty boasts! Taste my blade!

zh: ：「糟了，那是娜塔夏，我們快去幫她。」
en: Disaster! That is Natasha—we must reinforce her immediately!

zh: ：「看樣子你們的本事還不錯嘛，居然可以這麼輕鬆的打敗敵人。」
en: Well now! Your combat skills are quite impressive, dispatching enemies with such ease.

zh: ：「哼！精靈族的女人是妳不曉得我們經歷過多少的戰鬥。」
en: Hmph! Elven maidens know nothing of the grueling battles we've endured.

zh: ：「哼！你這個矮人族的傢伙又有什麼意見，你要是對我不滿你就直說呀。」
en: Hmph! And what complaints does a stubby dwarf have? If you take issue with me, speak it plainly!
Hmph!

zh: ：「好了好了，你們兩個先不要吵了，前面就是巴魯庫斯堡了。」
en: Cease your bickering, both of you! Barukus Keep lies just ahead.

zh: ：「再向前走就可以看到巴魯庫斯堡了，我們提高警覺，這裡可能會有敵人的埋伏。」
en: A short march ahead and Barukus Keep will come into view. Keep your guard up—enemies may be lying in ambush.

zh: ：「蕾娜說得對，大家小心。」
en: Lena speaks wisely. Stay alert, everyone.

zh: ：「前面有敵人出現！」
en: Enemies sighted ahead!

zh: ：「沒想到・・・卡拉哈德・・・你真的背叛我們了・・・我們是不會放過你的。」
en: To think... Galahad... you truly betrayed us... We will never let you leave here alive!

zh: ：「別和她囉唆了，前面是什麼地方？」
en: Don't waste words on them! What city lies ahead?

zh: ：「前面是一個名叫安遜的城市，據說是當年古代人的建築。」
en: Ahead lies Anson City, said to have been constructed by the Ancients long ago.

zh: ：「好，我們走吧！」
en: Right, let us press on!

zh: ：「卡拉哈德！你這個背叛者終於來了，我現在要為師傅將你這個叛徒除掉！」
en: Galahad! You traitorous dog, you've finally come! I shall strike down this turncoat in Master's name!

zh: ：「這傢伙是什麼人？」
en: Who in the world is she?!

zh: ：「她是魔法師的弟子，排名第三的美拉夏麗，看樣子傳說的另外的軍團長就是她。」
en: She is the Sorcerer's third disciple, Melashari! It seems she was the commander Lena spoke of.

zh: ：「等一下・・・排名第三，那麼說前面還有另外兩個？」
en: Wait... the third disciple? That means two more formidable disciples stand above her?!

zh: ：「她們的真面目我也沒有見過，但是傳說中每一個都有個相當可怕的能力。」
en: I have never seen their true faces, but legend says each wields terrifying, unnatural power.

zh: ：「你們還在囉唆些什麼？是在交待自己的遺言是嗎？」
en: Still babbling among yourselves? Are you reciting your final prayers?!

zh: ：「少廢話，就看看妳有什麼本事！」
en: Save your mockery! Let's see what you're made of!

zh: ：「要走了呀！真是可惜呀。若是有需要的話別忘了來本店。」
en: Departing already? What a pity. Do come again whenever you need rest.

zh: ：「歡迎光臨，本地是古代人的名勝地區，歡迎你們在此地好好的休息。」
en: Welcome! Our city is famed for ancestral ancient heritage—take your ease here.

zh: ：「不管世事如何變化，還是要保持希望快樂。」
en: No matter how turbulent the world becomes, one must always hold fast to hope and joy.

zh: ：「位在東南方深山中，有個毀壞不堪的古城。古城裡只有少數村民居住。」
en: Deep in the mountains to the southeast lie the crumbling ruins of an ancient city, where only a handful of souls dwell.

zh: ：「有位旅人說他從安遜城到遺忘之城的路上，看見南方天空上出現一座能夠在天上飛的城堡。這位旅人他一定是喝醉了，城堡怎麼可能飛在天上？」
en: A traveler claimed that between Anson City and the Forgotten City, he saw a castle soaring through the southern clouds! He must have been roaring drunk—how could a stone castle fly in the sky?!

zh: ：「東方沙漠深處，有一個古老的塔，聽一些學者說過，那是以前古代人所建造的。」
en: Deep within the eastern sands stands an ancient tower, constructed by the Ancients according to scholars.

zh: ：「有好些天在天空上看到怪物，難道真的是魔王復活・・不可能吧？」
en: Fiends have circled the skies for days on end... Could the Archdemon truly be awakening? Surely not...

zh: ：「有人說大魔王快要復活，哈哈・・這只不過是傳說，傳說不能當真。」
en: Folk whisper the Archdemon will soon awaken. Haha! Pure myth, nothing more—you can't take old wives' tales seriously.

zh: ：「在村子內有位忍者，名叫十兵衛，在傳授一些村民防身術，你們可以去看看。」
en: A ninja master named Jubei lives in town, instructing disciples in self-defense. You should pay him a visit.

zh: ：「據說從前古代人是個擁有一個高度文明的國家，後來不知什麼緣故，村民都消失不見。」
en: Legend says the Ancients possessed a highly advanced civilization, yet for reasons unknown, they vanished completely.

zh: ：「聽說南方遺忘之城，從前是個繁華之地，但在一次怪物攻擊下，幾乎成為廢墟，村民因為害怕而大批逃離，只有少數村民在怪物離開後又回到原本居住的地方。」
en: They say the Forgotten City to the south was once a magnificent capital, but a demonic raid reduced it to ruins. Panicked folk fled en masse; only a brave few returned after the beasts departed.

zh: ：「本地曾經是古代人所居住的地方，就連地名都是古代人的諧音。據說古代人在數百年前就完全的消失了，但是它們的後代還在本地繼續的生活著。」
en: This city was once inhabited by the Ancients—even its name echoes their tongue. Though the Ancients vanished centuries ago, their descendants still live quietly among us.

zh: ：「據說我的祖先是古代人，但是經過了這麼久的時間，連我也不知道它們到底作了些什麼事情。」
en: They say my ancestors were Ancients, but so many ages have passed that I haven't the faintest idea what they actually did.

zh: ：「東方有個古代之塔，據說有人世世代代保護它，我想在裡面一定有什麼重要物品。」
en: To the east stands an ancient spire, guarded by generations of guardians. There must be a precious treasure hidden within.

zh: ：「是嗎？是不是一顆寶珠？」
en: Could it be? A sacred orb, perhaps?

zh: ：「這我就不知道了因為我只是聽說而已。」
en: That I wouldn't know—I only repeat rumors I've heard.

zh: ：「嗚・・嗚・・忍者師父死了・・・」
en: Ugh... *Sob*... Master Jubei has passed away...

zh: ：「忍者師父所說的宿命好像是說・・・每個人的命運是已經註定的了・・・」
en: Master Jubei says our destiny is written in the stars... that every mortal's fate has already been decided...

zh: ：「喝哈！喝哈！・・・咦？涼子你要出遠門嗎？雖然我們是練武之人，但凡事小心點。」
en: Hyah! Hooh! ...Eh? Ryoko, are you setting off on a long journey? Even though we are warriors, never let your guard down.

zh: ：「喝！哈！喝哈！」
en: Hah! Hyah! Hooh!

zh: ：「涼子你要記得忍者師父所說的話，認清自己命運，努力向前走。」
en: Ryoko, remember what Master taught us: recognize your destiny and march boldly forward.

zh: ：「我看這幾天師父的身體越來越不好・・・難道這是師父的宿命？」
en: Master's health has grown worse these past few days... Could this be his destiny as well?

zh: ：「出門要保重身體。」
en: Take good care of yourself on the road.

zh: ：「喂・・不要在站這裡好不好・・我們正在鍛練武功・・哈喝！」
en: Hey! Don't stand there! We're training our forms—hyah!

zh: ：「嗚・・師父死了・・嗚・・難道這都是命・・・嗚・・嗚・・」
en: Ugh... Master has passed away... Can this truly all be fate...? *Sob*...

zh: ：「喝哈！喝哈！」
en: Hyah! Hah!

zh: ：「涼子，師父不是交待你去古代人之塔嗎？你還不快點去。」
en: Ryoko, didn't Master tell you to journey to the Ancient Tower? Make haste!

zh: ：「有重要事情嗎？沒有請走開。」
en: Do you have urgent business? If not, kindly step aside.
Master!

zh: ：「涼子・・・我不行了・・・還記得我所說的宿命的事嗎？」
en: Ryoko... I can't hold on much longer... Do you remember what I taught you about destiny?

zh: ：「我記得。」
en: I remember, Master.

zh: ：「這就是我的宿命，雖然我不能克服這個宿命的挑戰，但是我還是願意面對它。而妳，也必須面對自己宿命的挑戰。」
en: This is my fate. Though I could not conquer this trial, I faced it with honor. And you... you must face your own destiny.
Yes, Master.

zh: ：「妳的未來將會因此改變・・・・・・・・・・・・」
en: Your future will change because of this............
Master!

zh: ：「涼子，他已經死了。」
en: Ryoko... he is gone.

zh: ：「師父，我會一直記得您所說的話，向自己的命運挑戰。」
en: Master... I will forever hold your words in my heart, and defy my destiny.

zh: ：「去吧，涼子。妳的未來還具有許多未知的變化，去為自己的未來努力吧！」
en: Go, Ryoko. Your future still holds countless untold possibilities. Go fight for your tomorrow!

zh: ：「唉・・・沒想到這一切還是發生了。」
en: Alas... to think all of this has come to pass after all.

zh: ：「師父，您知道這些事會發生？」
en: Master, did you know this would happen?

zh: ：「其實這一切都在我們的預料中，但是妳的父母還是願意為了妳的未來一拼，只不過他們也爭不過命運。」
en: In truth, we foresaw all of this. Yet your parents still chose to stake everything on your future, even if they could not cheat fate.

zh: ：「這一切都在我父母的預料中？」
en: All of this was foreseen by my parents...?

zh: ：「唉・・・早在多年以前我們就知道這一切事情了。於是你的父母選擇了擔任秘境守護者的任務，決心向命運一搏，因此將妳交給我。現在是妳決定未來的時候了。」
en: Years ago, we already knew. Your parents chose to take up the duty of guarding the Sanctuary, betting everything against fate, and left you in my care. Now, the time has come for you to decide your own future.

zh: ：「我願意向命運挑戰！」
en: I will defy my destiny!

zh: ：「好，你們從這裡出城後向東南前進，可以到達一座已經荒廢的城市，在那裡可以獲得更進一步的消息。」
en: Good. Leave town and head southeast; you will reach an abandoned city. You will discover more answers there.

zh: ：「師父您不和我們一起走？」
en: Master, won't you come with us?

zh: ：「妳有妳的任務，我有我的宿命，我們各有自己的命運。」
en: You have your mission, and I have my destiny. Each of us must walk our own path.

zh: ：「師父您保重了。」
en: Take care of yourself, Master.

zh: ：「涼子，妳的身上正承擔了古代人的使命，這是妳的宿命，妳需要克服它。」
en: Ryoko, you bear the sacred legacy of the ancients upon your shoulders. It is your destiny, and you must overcome it.

zh: ：「從這裡向東北前進，可以看到一座塔，那就是古代人之塔。只要你們到了那個地方就可以知道你們的路了。」
en: Head northeast from here and you will see a spire: the Ancient Tower. Once you arrive, your path will be revealed.
Who are you...?

zh: ：「涼子，不要對客人無禮。這些是遠道而來的戰士們。」
en: Ryoko, do not be impolite. These warriors have traveled from afar.

zh: ：「您好，我叫{HERO}，請問該怎麼稱呼？」
en: Greetings, my name is {HERO}. Whom do we have the honor of addressing?

zh: ：「我的名字叫十兵衛，是一名忍法師父，這位是我的徒弟涼子。」
en: My name is Jubei, master of the ninja arts, and this is my apprentice, Ryoko.
Greetings.

zh: ：「看樣子您好像知道我們會來？」
en: It seems as though you were expecting us?

zh: ：「嗯・・・由目前大陸的局勢看來，我知道會有這樣的一天。涼子・・・你就和他們一起走吧。」
en: Mm... Given the turmoil across the realm, I knew this day would come. Ryoko... go with them.
Master!

zh: ：「我只不過是妳的師父，但是你的身上有著相當重大的任務，妳應該靠自己的力量去完成。我所能夠教妳的也都傳授給妳了，剩下的就要靠妳自己的力量了。」
en: I am merely your teacher. You bear a profound duty that you must fulfill with your own strength. I have taught you all I can; the rest is up to you.
Master, but............

zh: ：「她就拜託各位了。」
en: I entrust her to your care, brave warriors.
You have our word.

zh: ：「從這裡向東北前進，可以看到一座塔，那就是古代人之塔。只要你們到了那個地方就可以知道你們的路了。」
en: Head northeast from here and you will see a spire: the Ancient Tower. Once you reach it, your path will become clear.

zh: ：「這是怎麼一回事，這裡一向都沒有人煙的，怎麼會冒出這麼多的妖魔？」
en: What is happening here? This area is usually deserted, so why are there so many demons?

zh: ：「我有一種不好的預感，會不會・・・」
en: I have a terrible foreboding... could it be...?

zh: ：「嗯・・・妖魔在這裡出現的確是不太對勁，我看古代之塔裡一定有什麼秘密。」
en: Yes... demonic activity here is alarming. There must be a dark secret within the Ancient Tower.

zh: ：「可是我還是什麼都不知道呀！」
en: Yet I still know nothing!

zh: ：「等到了古代之塔就知道了。」
en: We will find out once we reach the Ancient Tower.

zh: ：「前面就是古代之塔了，我實在不知道師父為什麼要叫我到那個地方？」
en: The Ancient Tower is right ahead. I still can't fathom why Master told me to come here.

zh: ：「別想那麼多了，到了就知道了。」
en: Don't fret. All will be made clear once we arrive.

zh: ：「等一下，有妖魔出現了！」
en: Wait! Demons have ambushed us!

zh: ：「大家注意，開戰了！」
en: Look sharp, everyone! Prepare for battle!

zh: ：「我想起來了！」
en: I remember now!

zh: ：「怎麼樣？」
en: What is it?

zh: ：「我記得在我小的時候，我的父母就是在這裡將我交給師父的，父親和母親為了要接下守護秘境的任務不得不放棄我。」
en: I remember... When I was a child, this was where my parents placed me in Master's care. They had to leave me behind to take up the duty of guarding the Sanctuary.
The Sanctuary?

zh: ：「嗯，就是在不遠的東北方，裡面好像存放有一顆封印的寶珠。」
en: Yes, just to the northeast. A sealed sacred orb rests within!

zh: ：「寶珠！糟了，我們快點趕去秘境，恐怕妖魔已經前往那裡了。」
en: A sacred orb! Curses, we must hurry to the Sanctuary! The demons may already be heading there!
This place............

zh: ：「怎麼了？」
en: What's wrong?

zh: ：「這個地方・・・・・・我好像有一點印象自己曾經來過・・・・・・」
en: This place... I feel a faint memory of having walked here before............

zh: ：「還有呢？」
en: Can you recall anything else?

zh: ：「我想不起來了。」
en: I can't remember.

zh: ：「你們等一下再想吧，敵人又出現了！」
en: Save your pondering for later—more fiends are attacking!

zh: ：「雖然・・・雖然你們打敗了我，但是寶珠我們已經得到了・・・大魔王・・・大魔王會覺醒的・・・哈哈哈・・・・・・」
en: Though... though you defeated me, the sacred orb is already ours! The Archdemon... the Archdemon shall awaken! Ahaha haha............

zh: ：「父親！母親！」
en: Father! Mother!

zh: ：「涼子・・・妳長大了，想當初我們為了要擔任這個守護秘境的任務而不得不放棄妳，妳不會恨我們吧・・・・・・」
en: Ryoko... you've grown so strong, my child. When your father and I took up the duty to guard this sanctuary, we had no choice but to leave you behind... You don't hate us, do you...?

zh: ：「不會！不會的！」
en: Never! Never, mother!

zh: ：「涼子，這裡的封印也被奪走了，身為守護者的繼承人，妳一定要將這個封印奪回，使秘境再次發揮它的作用・・・・・・」
en: Ryoko, the sacred seal here has been stolen as well. As the heir of the Guardians, you must recover the seal and restore the Sanctuary's sacred power...
Father!

zh: ：「羅伊，快用治療法術！」
en: Roy, cast healing magic quickly!

zh: ：「來不及了，他們所受的傷太重了，我們的治療魔法是沒有辦法的。」
en: It's too late... their wounds are too deep. Even our divine magic cannot save them.

zh: ：「涼子，這是妳的使命，也是妳的宿命，妳一定要・・・・・・」
en: Ryoko, this is your duty... and your destiny. You must...

zh: ：「母親您放心，我一定會盡力的。」
en: Rest easy, mother. I swear I will do everything in my power.

zh: ：「你們這些妖魔，只要有我們在這裡就絕對不會讓你們通過的！」
en: Foul fiends! As long as we draw breath, we shall never let you pass!

zh: ：「哼哼哼・・・像你們這樣的對手我可看不在眼中呢。」
en: Heh heh heh... Worms like you aren't even worthy of being in my sight.

zh: ：「別作夢，這個地方是我們古代人的秘密地點，我可不會讓妳這麼簡單的破壞！」
en: Don't kid yourself! This is the sacred sanctuary of the ancients—I won't let you defile it so easily!

zh: ：「說的好，那就接我這一招吧！」
en: Brave words! Then taste this strike!

zh: ：「糟了，來晚了一步，大家快上！」
en: Blast it! We're too late! Charge!

zh: ：「前面應該就是師父所的那座城了。」
en: The city Master spoke of should be just ahead.

zh: ：「不管怎麼樣，先進城去看看有什麼消息再說吧。」
en: Regardless, let's head into the city first and see what information we can gather.

zh: ：「這也好。」
en: A sound plan.

zh: ：「嗯・・・我也累了，快找個地方休息一下吧。」
en: Phew... I'm exhausted too. Let's find an inn and get some rest.

zh: ：「我總覺得師父所說的話有些奇怪？」
en: I keep thinking about what Master said... Didn't something sound strange?

zh: ：「嗯・・・是有些奇怪，什麼叫妳的未來還可以改變？」
en: Yes... it was quite odd. What did he mean by 'your future can still be changed'?

zh: ：「艾魯，怎麼了？」
en: El, what's on your mind?

zh: ：「我覺得他一定知道些什麼，但是卻不願意告訴我們。」
en: I suspect he knows something crucial, yet chose not to tell us.

zh: ：「先不要想這些了，我們有伴了。」
en: Save your pondering for later—we have company!

zh: ：「東方魔物在這裡殺了不少村民，只有少部份的村民逃離這裡。數年後一些村民發現怪物離開才又回來居住。」
en: Eastern demons slaughtered many villagers here; only a handful escaped. Years later, after the fiends left, a few brave souls returned to live.

zh: ：「距今一年前，在一座無名的山中，有個繁榮城市，那個城市人民過的平靜和平的日子，但在一次魔物攻擊下，這城的城主不幸被殺，他的子民也跟城主相同命運。數年後，這城就有如鬼城般，只有一些勇敢的村民等怪物離開後，又回到這個被怪物肆瘧的城市。我所說的就是這座遺忘之城。」
en: Years ago, nestled in the mountains, stood a thriving city where people lived in peace. But during a demonic onslaught, the lord was slain, and his people met the same fate. For years it stood like a ghost town. Only a few villagers dared return. I speak of this very city: the Forgotten City.

zh: ：「這裡曾經是一個相當繁榮的城市，但是隨著時光的流逝，現在只剩下這座已經荒廢的王城了。」
en: This was once a bustling, prosperous city. But with the passage of time, only this desolate, ruined castle remains.

zh: ：「真難得，在這裡還能看到聖克魯茲騎士。」
en: A rare sight indeed! To think I'd see Holy Knights of Santa Cruz here.

zh: ：「對不起呀，這位客人。本店已經好久沒有營業了。您若是想要買東西的話請另外找地方吧！」
en: My apologies, travelers. Our shop closed down ages ago. If you seek wares, you'll have to look elsewhere!

zh: ：「哎呀呀・・・現在還有人會來這種地方買東西呀！真是太可惜了，我們已經好久沒有做買賣了。」
en: Well, bless my soul... people still visiting this forsaken place to buy goods? What a shame, we haven't traded in years.

zh: ：「好久沒有外人來光臨了，希望您不會覺得我們招待不周呀！」
en: It has been so long since outsiders came to visit! I hope you don't find our hospitality lacking.

zh: ：「客人您真是來錯地方了，本地已經好久沒有外人來了。不過若是要休息的話本店還是可以招待了，請進請進！」
en: You folks picked quite the desolate place to visit—no travelers ever come here anymore! But if you need a bed to rest your weary bones, we can manage. Step right in!

zh: ：「糟了，大魔王似乎快復活了！」
en: Disaster! It seems the Archdemon is on the verge of resurrection!

zh: ：「時間不多了，他就在東南的洞穴中，你們若是要阻止他的話就要盡快！」
en: Time is running out! He lies hidden in the cavern to the southeast. If you intend to stop him, make haste!

zh: ：「我知道你們來這裡做什麼，請坐・・・」
en: I know what brings you here. Please, be seated...
Thank you.

zh: ：「從這裡向東南望去，可以看到一個洞穴，那裡就有你們要找的人・・・・・・」
en: Gazing southeast from here, you can spot a cavern. The one you seek is waiting there............

zh: ：「那我們走吧！」
en: Then let's go at once!

zh: ：「別急！我還沒有說到重點。那個人已經獲得了他所要力量，現在所欠缺的就是時間而已，若是你們想要阻止他，現在是最好的時機・・・・・・」
en: Not so fast! I haven't reached the crucial part. That sorcerer has already obtained the dark power he sought; all he lacks now is time. If you wish to stop him, strike now............

zh: ：「在南方天空上常會看到一些怪物在那裡盤旋，會不會是什麼怪物復活？」
en: Monsters are frequently seen circling the southern skies. Could some ancient beast be awakening?

zh: ：「東方有一個開口很大的山洞，看起來極為可怕，聽說裡面有恐怖的怪物。」
en: To the east lies a cavern with a gaping maw. It looks dreadfully ominous—they say terrifying beasts lurk within.

zh: ：「先生，聽說你是從北方安遜城來的。」
en: Sir, I heard you came all the way from Anson City in the north.
That is correct.

zh: ：「像我們這個狗不拉屎，鳥不生蛋的地方，一年到頭沒什麼客人要來，你算是今年第一個外來的人，去年好像有位叫席什麼克斯的外地人來過。」
en: In a godforsaken wasteland like ours where nobody ever visits, you're the first outsider all year! Though last year, some fellow named Sil-something-ox passed through.

zh: ：「席爾福克斯？」
en: Sil Fox?

zh: ：「對！對！對！・・・你認識嗎？」
en: Aye! That's the one! Do you know him?

zh: ：「只知道有這個人，但不認識他。」
en: I know of his name, but we haven't met.

zh: ：「那個叫席爾福克斯的人怪怪的・從樣子看來像是位皇室的魔法師，但皇室的魔法師不可能會來這不毛之地。」
en: That Sil Fox fellow was bizarre. He looked like an imperial court sorcerer, but why would royalty ever visit such barren dirt?

zh: ：「後來呢？」
en: And then what happened?

zh: ：「後來，講到後來就生氣。那個叫席爾福克斯的問了一大堆問題，之後又喝了不少酒，最後竟然沒付錢就跑掉了。」
en: Don't get me started, it makes my blood boil! That Sil Fox asked a mountain of questions, drank a huge jar of our vintage wine, and then slipped out without paying a single copper coin!

zh: ：「喔・・・好久不見的客人耶！歡迎光臨，客人您想要點什麼？」
en: Oh! Customers after all this time! Welcome! What can I get for you?

zh: ：「謝謝，不過我們就要走了。」
en: Thank you, but we must be on our way.

zh: ：「客人您想要點什麼？我們有古代人時期所」留下的酒喔。」
en: What would you like, travelers? We have vintage wine preserved from the ancient era!

zh: ：「那還能喝嗎？不會鬧肚子吧？」
en: Is that still drinkable? Won't it tear up our stomachs?

zh: ：「在南方天空上常會看到一些怪物在那裡盤旋，會不會是什麼怪物復活？」
en: Fiends circle ceaselessly above the southern skies... Could some ancient terror be rising?

zh: ：「喔・・・真的好久不曾見過從外地來的客人。」
en: My, my... truly it has been ages since outsiders set foot in these parts.

zh: ：「這些妖魔怎麼老是殺不完？」
en: Why is there never an end to these blasted demons?!

zh: ：「沒有時間抱怨了，我們快進入第二層，不要讓他召喚出大魔王洛馬了。」
en: There is no time to complain! We must ascend to the second floor and stop him before he summons Archdemon Loma!

zh: ：「快走，時間不多了。」
en: Make haste! Time is slipping away!

zh: ：「我感到魔王的力量越來越接近了。」
en: I can feel the Archdemon's dark presence drawing nearer with every breath.

zh: ：「魔法師就在第二層，我們快點去阻止他瘋狂的行為。各位準備好了嗎？」
en: The Sorcerer is waiting on the second tier. We must stop his madness at once. Are you ready, everyone?

zh: ：「我沒有問題！」
en: I'm ready!
Right with you!

zh: ：「等了好久，終於到這一刻了。」
en: We've waited long for this moment. It ends today!

zh: ：「沒問題！」
en: No problem at all!
Let's go!

zh: ：「就看我的表現了。」
en: Leave the heavy lifting to me!

zh: ：「這・・・這・・・我是怎麼了？」
en: Where... where am I...? What happened to me...?

zh: ：「這是怎麼一回事？」
en: What in the world is going on?

zh: ：「我到底做了什麼？」
en: What have I done...?

zh: ：「艾魯，這到底是怎麼一回事？」
en: El, what happened to him?

zh: ：「讓我瞧瞧。福克斯，你不知道自己正打算要喚醒大魔王洛馬嗎？」
en: Let me see... Fox! Don't you know you were attempting to awaken Archdemon Loma?!

zh: ：「這怎麼可能！我怎麼可能會做這種事！」
en: Impossible! How could I have done such an atrocious thing?!

zh: ：「你仔細的想想，看看能不能想起什麼？」
en: Think carefully. Can you remember anything at all?

zh: ：「我記得自己曾經獲得了一本相當古老的文件，上面說明了大魔王的邪惡力量，在那個時候我曾經為了要獲得這樣強大的力量而到處收集相關的資料。」
en: I remember unearthing an ancient scripture detailing the supreme dark power of the Archdemon. Seduced by the promise of ultimate magic, I sought out every scrap of arcane lore I could find.

zh: ：「於是我離開了王城，找到了吉普賽人所保留的那份資料，得知六顆寶珠的力量以及它們存放的地點。」
en: I left the royal capital and located the ancestral scroll preserved by the Gypsies, learning the power of the Six Orbs and their hidden locations.

zh: ：「但是當我在一個無意的機會得到第一顆銀寶珠之後，我發覺魔王的力量絕對不是我所能控制的，於是我決定停止這個行動，但似乎有什麼力量控制了我，使我無法照自己的意志去行動，以後的事我就不太清楚了・・・・・・」
en: But the moment I touched the first Silver Orb, I realized the Archdemon's power was beyond mortal control! I resolved to stop, but a dark presence seized my soul, robbing me of my will. After that... all is a haze............

zh: ：「{HERO}，看這個樣子恐怕是大魔王的意志控制了他，使他做出了這麼多可怕的行為。」
en: {HERO}, it seems the Archdemon's foul will possessed him, driving him to commit these horrors.

zh: ：「那麼現在應該沒有事了，不是嗎？」
en: Then the danger has passed, hasn't it?

zh: ：「糟了，六顆寶珠及所有的資料都不見了，是維多莉亞！」
en: Disaster! All six sacred orbs and our research manuscripts have vanished! It's Victoria!
Who?!

zh: ：「是我的大弟子，她恐怕是帶著寶珠以及資料到浮遊要塞去喚醒大魔王了。」
en: My senior disciple! She must have fled with the orbs and manuscripts to the Floating Keep to complete the resurrection ritual!

zh: ：「要塞在那裡？」
en: Where is this keep?

zh: ：「在洞穴的西南方海上。」
en: Soaring above the southwestern sea!

zh: ：「我們快走！不過是否需要先向國王報告這件事情？」
en: Quickly, we must pursue her! But shouldn't we dispatch a messenger to inform the King?

zh: ：「哈哈哈・・・就憑你們幾個小鬼也想阻止我喚醒大魔王洛馬？」
en: Hahaha! Did you insolent brats truly believe you could stop me from awakening Archdemon Loma?!

zh: ：「魔法師，快停止你的瘋狂舉動！」
en: Sorcerer, halt your madness at once!

zh: ：「瘋狂？我看是你們不明白吧。大魔王的力量才是真正的力量，在他的眼中你們這些魔法都好像小孩子的玩意。」
en: Madness? It is you fools who cannot comprehend! The Archdemon's might is true omnipotence—your petty mortal spells are like children's toys before his glory!

zh: ：「別和他囉唆，時間不多了！」
en: Don't waste words on him! Time is running out!

zh: ：「好，我就讓你們瞧瞧大魔王的力量有多大，也讓你們瞭解自己所做的事是多麼的愚蠢！」
en: Very well! I shall show you a fraction of the Archdemon's terror, and teach you how utterly futile your resistance is!

zh: ：「{HERO}，對不起。」
en: {HERO}... I'm sorry.

zh: ：「你現在說這話，不覺得太遲了嗎？」
en: Isn't it a bit late for apologies, traitor?!

zh: ：「咳・・咳・・咳・・在和你們這段時間，是我一生中最快樂的時期・・咳・・只恨我生在魔族・・咳・・保重了，我的朋友・・・」
en: *Cough*... *Cough*... The time I spent journeying with you all was the happiest chapter of my life... *Cough*... My only curse was being born a demon... *Cough*... Farewell, my friends............

zh: ：「快上樓，這裡還只是第一層而已，我們不知道到底會在第幾層才見得到維多莉亞。」
en: Up the stairs, quickly! This is only the first tier—we don't know on which floor Victoria conducts her ritual.

zh: ：「應該上面就是了。」
en: The summit chamber should be right above!

zh: ：「那就更要快了！」
en: Then we must double our pace!

zh: ：「還是要提高警覺，若是她也和福克斯一樣被大魔王的意志控制的話，那麼將是相當可怕的一戰。」
en: Stay on your guard! If Victoria has fallen under the Archdemon's will just as Fox did, this will be a harrowing battle.

zh: ：「不管怎麼說我們都要盡力！」
en: Regardless, we will give everything we have!

zh: ：「這裡是一樓，召喚儀式在那裡實施？」
en: This is the first floor. Where is the summoning altar located?

zh: ：「應該是在最上面！」
en: It must be at the very pinnacle!
Hurry!

zh: ：「小心，前面那四隻是煙魔。」
en: Careful! Those four fiends ahead are Wraith Demons!

zh: ：「什麼是煙魔？」
en: What are Wraith Demons?

zh: ：「煙魔是一種沒有實體的妖魔，若是不小心話會遭到痛擊的。」
en: Wraith Demons are incorporeal phantoms—if you let your guard down, their spectral strikes will tear you apart.

zh: ：「沒有時間和它們在這裡拖延了，快點將它們打敗！」
en: We have no time to dawdle with them. Strike them down at once!
Bwahahaha!

zh: ：「多爾卡你怎麼了？」
en: Doruka, what's gotten into you?!

zh: ：「{HERO}，你認為你能打敗它們嗎？・・哈哈哈・・」
en: {HERO}, did you truly think you could defeat them? Hahaha...
...What do you mean?

zh: ：「你們不知道嗎？哈哈・・・其實我不是矮人族的，從頭到尾我都是魔族的人，目的是滲入你們聖騎士軍團。我沒想到你們能活到現在，哈哈・・不過你們絕對通不過我魔族戰士多爾卡的手中，受死吧！」
en: Didn't you realize? Haha... I was never a dwarf! From the very beginning, I was a demon warrior planted to infiltrate your Holy Knights! I never expected you to survive this long, but your journey ends here at the hands of Doruka, Champion of the Demon Host! Die!

zh: ：「這・・・這怎麼可能・・・我怎麼可能被他們打敗・・・大魔王呀・・・你是不是背棄我了・・・・・・」
en: How... how could this be...? How could I be defeated by mere mortals...? Archdemon... have you forsaken me............

zh: ：「這下子應該解決了吧！」
en: That should be the end of it!

zh: ：「等一下・・・我不認為這件事已經解決了，我感覺到魔王的力量越來越大了。」
en: Wait... I don't believe this is over. I feel the Archdemon's power surging with terrifying intensity!

zh: ：「沒錯・・・我也感覺到了，怎麼會有這種事情，難道它已經自己打破封印了嗎？」
en: Indeed... I feel it too! How could this be? Could he have broken the seal on his own?!

zh: ：「哈哈哈・・・我就要獲得大魔王的力量了，等大魔王洛馬復活後，我要讓這個世界再次的陷入毀滅中！」
en: Bwahaha! The Archdemon's supreme power is finally mine! When Lord Loma awakens, this wretched world will burn in ruin once more!

zh: ：「看樣子她也被大魔王控制了！」
en: Look at her eyes—she's completely under the Archdemon's control!

zh: ：「大家上呀！這將是決定王國存亡的一戰，打起精神來！」
en: Charge, comrades! The fate of the entire realm hangs upon this final hour—give everything you have!

zh: ：「啊・・・這怎麼可能・・・這怎麼可能，難道說・・・難道你也擁有勇者的血統？我不相信・・・我不相信・・・我好不容易才從沉睡中甦醒，現在・・・現在又要進入沉睡中・・・可惡呀・・・可惡的勇者・・・・・・」
en: Aaargh... Impossible... How could this happen?! Do you... do you truly carry the sacred blood of the legendary Hero?! I refuse to believe it... I fought so hard to awaken from the dark abyss, only to be cast back into slumber... Curse you... curse the Hero's bloodline............

zh: ：「哈哈哈・・・愚蠢的人類，早在六個封印離開它們所在的位置時我就已經自由了，沒想到這些被我控制的人都這麼的軟弱，這麼簡單就被你們打敗了。」
en: Bwahaha! Foolish mortals! The very moment the six seals were removed from their sanctuaries, I was already free! How pathetic that the puppets I ensnared were so frail, shattered so easily by your blades.

zh: ：「邪惡的魔王，你居然能夠用自己的力量來控制人的心智！」
en: Foul Archdemon! You used your dark magic to enslave mortal minds!

zh: ：「這種事只不過是小意思罷了，我為了預防有這麼一天，早就在許多古老的書籍中施下了控制心智的法術，只要有人翻閱這些書籍就會被我控制。」
en: A trivial trick! Foreseeing that this day might come, ages ago I bound mind-enslaving curses into ancient grimoires. Whoever dared open those pages fell beneath my absolute thrall!

zh: ：「這麼說・・・席爾福克斯以及維多莉亞都是被你所控制的！」
en: Then... Sil Fox and Victoria were merely your puppets all along!

zh: ：「那當然，你以為就憑他們那麼微小的力量就可以控制我的力量嗎，他們這麼做只不過是加深我對他們的控制罷了。現在，就讓你們瞧瞧我的力量・・・・・・」
en: Naturally! Did you truly believe their puny wills could master my omnipotence? Their delusions merely tightened my leash upon their souls! Now, worms of light, behold the true terror of Archdemon Loma!

zh: ：「使用木頭製成的木棒，在攻擊能力上實在是不怎麼樣，也許對於野獸還有一些威嚇的能力，但是若是對妖獸使用可就沒什麼效了。」
en: A simple wooden club fashioned from fallen branches. Modest striking power—sufficient perhaps to startle wild beasts, but virtually useless against hardened fiends.

zh: ：「使用堅硬的檜木所製成的木棒，在握柄的地方也做過處理，使用起來相當的順手，因此是初級魔法師的裝備。」
en: Carved from resilient cypress with a smoothed leather grip. Balanced and lightweight, making it an ideal starter weapon for novice mages.

zh: ：「前端鑲著寶石的手杖，由於本身接受過魔力的依附，所以用它埋使用咒文更是具有不同的功效，是魔法師們常用的裝備。」
en: A polished staff tipped with an enchanted gemstone. Attuned to arcane currents, it channels incantations and serves as a trusted focus for journeymen sorcerers.
